	function testCSIController($scope, $compile, $commonService, $utilService) {

		$scope.data = { mbphArNo: '010', mbphOficNo: '', mbphEnNo: '', custNo: '' };
		$scope.title = "고객만족도 설문조사 테스트 등록";
		$scope.service = 'SCustStsfRsrhInvs';
		$scope.operation = 'processCSRI';

		$scope.csiClick = function () {
			if (!$scope.data.custNo) {
				alert('고객번호를 입력해주세요.');
				return;
			}
			if (!$scope.data.mbphArNo || !$scope.data.mbphOficNo || !$scope.data.mbphEnNo) {
				alert('전화번호를 입력해주세요.');
				return;
			}

			$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson($scope.data, { service: 'SCustStsfRsrhInvs', operation: 'processCSRI' })).then(function (data) {

				if (data.SCustStsfRsrhInvsOutDto) {
					$utilService.openAlert((0, _stringify2.default)(data));
				}
			});
		};
	}

	md.controller('testYeskeyController', testYeskeyController);
	function testYeskeyController($scope, $compile, $timeout, $commonService, $utilService, $yeskeyService) {
		$scope.title = "금융인증서 테스트";
		$scope.data = { signType: '01', plainText: '{"이름": "", "고객번호":"", "대출접수번호":"", "신청금액": ""}' };
		$scope.popup = {
			sign: function sign() {
				var plainText = '';
				try {
					plainText = JSON.parse($scope.data.plainText);
				} catch (e) {
					plainText = $scope.data.plainText;
				}
				var opts = {
					signType: $scope.data.signType,
					plainTexts: [plainText],
					callback: function callback(action, result) {
						console.log('sign', result);
						$timeout(function () {
							$scope.data.signVal = result.signedVals[0];
							console.log('sign signVal', $scope.data.signVal);
						});
					}
				};
				$yeskeyService.sign(opts);
			},
			vid: function vid() {
				var plainText = '';
				try {
					plainText = JSON.parse($scope.data.plainText);
				} catch (e) {
					plainText = $scope.data.plainText;
				}
				var opts = {
					signType: $scope.data.signType,
					plainTexts: [plainText],
					callback: function callback(action, result) {
						console.log('vid', result);
						$timeout(function () {
							$scope.data.signVal = result.signedVals[0];
							console.log('vid signVal', $scope.data.signVal);
						});
					}
				};
				$yeskeyService.vid(opts);
			},
			verify: function verify() {

				$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({ signature: $scope.data.signVal, custNm: '' }, { service: 'SYeskeyService', operation: 'getVerification' })).then(function (data) {

					console.log(data);
				});
			}
		};
	}

	/*
	 *약관 
	 */
	md.controller('testProvCallController', testProvCallController);
	/* @ngInject */
	function testProvCallController($scope, $compile, $commonService, $utilService, provFactory) {
		$scope.title = "약관호출테스트";
		$scope.provInfo = '';
		$scope.delProvInfo = '';
		$scope.provCd;
		var callProvFun;
		var lengthChk = 0;

		$scope.agreeCallClick = function () {

			if ($scope.data.tempTermsGrpCd) {
				$scope.provCd = $scope.data.tempTermsGrpCd;
				callProvFun = provFactory.getProvGrpList;
			} else if ($scope.data.tempPdCd) {
				$scope.provCd = $scope.data.tempPdCd;
				callProvFun = provFactory.getProvGdsList;
			} else if ($scope.data.tempTermsMgmtCd) {
				$scope.provCd = $scope.data.tempTermsMgmtCd;
				callProvFun = provFactory.getProvOneList;
			}

			debugger;
			if ($scope.provCd) {

				callProvFun({ provCd: $scope.provCd }, function (provTreeList) {
					lengthChk = 0;
					console.log(provTreeList, 'datae');
					$scope.data.provInfo = '<ul>';
					$scope.data.provInfo += '<li>==============================================================================================</li>';
					$scope.data.provInfo += call(provTreeList, 0) + '</ul>';
					$scope.data.lengthChk = lengthChk;
					$scope.data.provTreeList = provTreeList.length;
					console.log(lengthChk, '체크길이');
					console.log(provTreeList.length, '길이');
				});
			} else {
				$utilService.openAlert('조회할 약관코드가 없습니다.');
			}

			function call(provTreeList, depth) {
				var result = '';
				var info = { 'chlViewCd': '채널view코드', 'termsMgmtCd': '약관관리코드', 'agrmntFormDscd': '동의형태구분코드', 'title': '약관명', 'subList': '' };
				$.each(provTreeList, function (idx, dto) {
					var provText = '<li>';
					//provText += depth > 0 ?'subList ==>    ' : '';
					provText += 'depth :' + depth + ' ,';
					//provText += ', provCd : ' + provCd + ' , ';
					var delProvText = '';
					lengthChk++;

					var keys = [];

					if (dto['chlViewCd']) {
						keys.push('chlViewCd');
					}
					if (dto['termsMgmtCd']) {
						keys.push('termsMgmtCd');
					}
					if (dto['agrmntFormDscd']) {
						keys.push('agrmntFormDscd');
					}
					if (dto['title']) {
						keys.push('title');
					}
					if (dto['subList']) {
						keys.push('subList');
					}

					$.each(keys, function (idx2, key) {
						//['chlViewCd','termsMgmtCd','agrmntFormDscd','title','subList']

						if ((0, _keys2.default)(info).indexOf(key) > -1) {
							//['termsDtlCntnt','termsSmryCntnt','esntYn','subYn']
							if (key === 'subList' && dto[key].length > 0) {
								provText += info[key];
								provText += call(dto[key], depth + 1);
							} else {
								provText += info[key];
								provText += ' : ' + dto[key] + ' ,';
							}
						} else {
							delProvText += info[key];
							delProvText += ' : ' + dto[key] + ' ,';
						}
					});
					//provText = provText.substring(0,provText.lastIndexOf(','));
					provText += '</li>';
					if (depth === 0) {
						provText += '<li>==============================================================================================</li>';
					}

					result += provText;
				});
				return result;
			}
		};
	}

					console.log('okkay', data);
				});
			},
			get: function get() {
				$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({ 'access_key': '', ci: $scope.data.ci }, { service: 'SOkkayTalkService', operation: 'getToken' })).then(function (data) {
					console.log('okkay', data);
				});
			},
			cert: function cert(type) {
				if (type == 'ci2') {
					$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({ 'access_key': '', ci: $scope.data.ci2 }, { service: 'SOkkayTalkService', operation: 'getCert' })).then(function (data) {
						console.log('okkay', data);
					});
				} else {
					$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({ 'access_key': '', token: $scope.data.token }, { service: 'SOkkayTalkService', operation: 'getCert' })).then(function (data) {
						console.log('okkay', data);
					});
				}
			}
		};
	}

			$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson($scope.prData, { service: 'SCmnBrdMang', operation: 'getMaCmnBrdList' })).then(function (data) {

				$scope.prDataList = [];

				if (data.SMaCmnBrd01OutDto && data.SMaCmnBrd01OutDto.sub) {

					var maxBrdCnt = data.SMaCmnBrd01OutDto.sub.length;
					if (maxBrdCnt > 3) {
						maxBrdCnt = 3;
					}

					for (var i = 0; i < maxBrdCnt; i++) {
						$scope.prDataList.push(data.SMaCmnBrd01OutDto.sub[i]);
					}
				}
			});

			// [3] 공지사항 조회 
			$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson($scope.data, { service: 'SMainGdsMang', operation: 'getMainGdsList' })).then(function (data) {

				$scope.noticeDataList = [];

				if (data.SMainGdsMang01OutDto && data.SMainGdsMang01OutDto.notice01) {

					if (maxNoticeCnt > 3) {

					}
				}
			});

								if (moveUrl.startsWith('http')) {

									evtCommonMoveToPage(moveUrl);
								} else {
									if (!$operationUtil.isEmpty(moveUrl)) {

										var params = {};
										var splUrl = moveUrl.split('?');

										if (splUrl.length > 1) {
											var arrParams = splUrl[1].split('&');
											for (var i = 0; i < arrParams.length; i++) {
												var tempArr = arrParams[i].split('=');;

												params[tempArr[0]] = tempArr[1];
											}
										}
										evtCommonMoveToPage(splUrl[0], params);
									}
								}
							});
						}

						if (btnUseYn02 == 'Y') {

		// =================================
		// 이벤트 설정
		// =================================
		function setEvent() {
			// ---------------------------------
			// 상품안내
			// ---------------------------------

			// 대출/예.적금 상품 탭
			mainTabFnc('.product-select-tab .tab-title');

			$scope.slctCdsList = new Array(3); //대출 전용 변수 - 기존 변수
			$scope.slctCdsListDeposit = new Array(2); //예금 전용 변수 - 신규 생성

			// OK 맞춤상품 대출/예.적금 탭 클릭
			$('.tab-title').on('click', function () {
				$('.product-select-tab a.tab-title').attr('aria-expanded', 'false');
				$(this).attr('aria-expanded', 'true');

				$scope.slctGubn = $(this).data('gubn');

				//선택항목이 초기화되지않는 상황에 배열만 초기화되다보니 오동작이 발생함
				//	        	$scope.slctCdsList = null;
				//	        		
				//	        	if (gubn == "lon") {
				//	        		$scope.slctCdsList = new Array(3);
				//	        		
				//	        	} else if (gubn == "deposit") {
				//	        		$scope.slctCdsList = new Array(2);
				//	        	}
			});

			$('.product-select-tab .active a.tab-title').trigger('click');

			// OK 맞춤상품 조회조건 담기
			$('button.btn-product-select').on('click', function () {

				var step = $(this).find('span.txt-sel').data('step');
				var value = $(this).find('span.txt-sel').data('value');
				var index = Number(step) - 1;

				if ($scope.slctGubn == 'lon') {

					if ($scope.slctCdsList == null) {
						$scope.slctCdsList = new Array(3);
					}

					//사용하는 속성만 남기고 내용을 비운다
					for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
						if (i >= index) {
							$scope.slctCdsList[i] = null;
						}
					}

					$scope.slctCdsList[index] = value;

					if (Number(step) === 3) {
						searchProduct(step);
					} else {
						var stepHtml = '<span aria-label="3단계 중 ' + (step + 1) + '단계">' + (step + 1) + '/3</span>';
						$('#lon_cur_step').html(stepHtml);
					}
				} else if ($scope.slctGubn == 'deposit') {

					if ($scope.slctCdsListDeposit == null) {
						$scope.slctCdsListDeposit = new Array(2);
					}

					//사용하는 속성만 남기고 내용을 비운다
					for (var i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
						if (i >= index) {
							$scope.slctCdsListDeposit[i] = null;
						}
					}

					$scope.slctCdsListDeposit[index] = value;

					if (Number(step) === 2) {
						searchProduct(step);
					} else {
						var stepHtml = '<span aria-label="2단계 중 ' + (step + 1) + '단계">' + (step + 1) + '/2</span>';
						$('#deposit_cur_step').html(stepHtml);
					}
				}
			});

			// ---------------------------------
			// 사회공헌
			// ---------------------------------

			// 사회공헌 card 클릭 이벤트
			cardFnc('.contrib-card');

			// ---------------------------------
			// 은행소식
			// ---------------------------------


			// ---------------------------------
			// 금융소비자보호
			// ---------------------------------


			// ---------------------------------
			// FOOTER 함수
			// ---------------------------------
			$('.family-area').click(function () {
				$('.family-site').toggleClass('active');
				$('.family-area').toggleClass('on');
				$('.family', $(this).parent()).slideToggle();
				if ($(this).hasClass('on')) {
					$(this).attr('aria-expanded', true);
				} else {
					$(this).attr('aria-expanded', false);
				}
				return false;
			});

			$('.family').mouseleave(function () {
				$(this).slideUp();
				$('.family-site').removeClass('active');
				$('.family-area').removeClass('on');
				$('.family-area').attr('aria-expanded', false);
			});
		}

		function evtCommonMoveToPage(url, param) {

			if (url) {

				if (url.indexOf('http:/') >= 0 || url.indexOf('https:/') >= 0) {
					window.open(url, '_blank');
				} else {
					$utilService.go(url, param);
				}
			}
		}

		// =================================	
		// 전체메뉴 MAP 형태 변환
		// =================================
		function renewalTotMenuConvertToMap(data, pMenuData) {

			var menuData = pMenuData;
			var menuList = [];
			var menuMap = {};

			if (data) {

				$.each(menuData, function (menuIdx) {

					$.each(data, function (idx) {

						if (menuData[menuIdx]['menuCd'] == data[idx]['menuCd']) {
							menuList.push(data[idx]);
						}
					});
				});

				$.each(data, function (idx) {

					if (!data[idx]['subList']) {
						data[idx]['subList'] = [];
					}

					if (menuMap[[data[idx].parentMenuCd]]) {
						menuMap[[data[idx].parentMenuCd]]['subList'].push(data[idx]);
					}

					menuMap[data[idx].menuCd] = data[idx];
				});
			}

			return menuList;
		}

		// ====================================	
		// 대메뉴 클릭 시 하위에 첫번째 url이 걸린 menuCd 반환.
		// ====================================	
		function getFirstMenuCd(parentMenuCd) {
			var resultMenuCd = '';

			var firstMenuCd = function firstMenuCd(parentMenuCd) {
				var menuInfo = $scope.allMenuList[parentMenuCd];
				var preIdx = 0;

				for (var i = 0; i < menuInfo['subMenuList'].length; i++) {

					if ($scope.allMenuList[menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].menuCd]['subMenuList'].length) {
						firstMenuCd(menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].menuCd);
					}

					if (!resultMenuCd) {
						if (menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].leafYn === 'Y' && menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].menuUrl) {
							resultMenuCd = menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].menuCd;
							continue;
						}
					}
				}
			};

			firstMenuCd(parentMenuCd);

			return resultMenuCd;
		};

		function getSlctCdsList() {

			var strResult = '';
			var comma = ',';
			var maxLength = $scope.slctCdsList.length - 1;

			var result = new Array();

			$.each($scope.slctCdsList, function (idx) {

				if (idx < maxLength) {
					strResult = strResult + $scope.slctCdsList[idx] + comma;
				} else {
					strResult = strResult + $scope.slctCdsList[idx];
				}
			});

			result.push(strResult);

			return result;
		}

		// =================================
		// 상품추천 결과 레이어 신청 버튼
		// =================================
		function evtLonLayerMoveToPage(menuUrl, menuCd, lonGdsSqno) {

			if (menuUrl) {
				if (menuCd) {
					$utilService.go(menuUrl, { 'menuCd': menuCd, 'lonGdsSqno': lonGdsSqno });
				} else {
					$utilService.go(menuUrl);
				}
			}
		}

		// =================================
		// 상품추천 결과 레이어 신청 버튼
		// =================================
		function evtDepsLayerMoveToPage(menuUrl, menuCd, depsGdsSqno) {

			if (menuUrl) {
				if (menuCd) {
					$utilService.go(menuUrl, { 'menuCd': menuCd, 'depsGdsSqno': depsGdsSqno });
				} else {
					$utilService.go(menuUrl);
				}
			}
		}

		// #####################################################################

		// 바로가기
		// =================================
		function evtGoOpenPage(arrIndex) {

			var index = Number(arrIndex);
			var _title = $scope.openPageData[index]['title'];
			var _url = $scope.openPageData[index]['url'];

			window.open(_url, '_blank');

			var url = null;
			var param = null;

			//		,regPswe : '비밀번호'
			//		,brdTl : '제목'
		};

		// 나의내역조회 정합성 체크 parameter
		var validateParam03 = {
			//		 regNm : '성명'
			//		,emadr : '이메일주소'
		};

		// ==================================================================
		// set event listener
		// ==================================================================
		$scope.event = {
			cmnInit: evtCmnInit // 공통초기화
			, init01: evtInit01 // 고객의견 접수 초기화
			, init02: evtInit02 // 민원접수 초기화
			, init03: evtInit03 // 나의내역 조회 초기화
			, init04: evtInit04 // 칭찬합니다 초기화
			, tabChange: evtTabChange // 텝 변경 시
			, msgChange: evtMsgChange // 메세지 변경
			, validateParam: evtValidateParam // 정합성 체크
			, regClick: evtRegClick // 등록
			, srchClick: evtSrchClick // 조회
			, moveToPage: evtMoveToPage // 화면이동
			, goPage03: evtGoPage03 // 나의내역 조회 페이지이동
			, goPage04: evtGoPage04 // 칭찬합니다 페이지 이동
			, srchDetail: evtSrchDetail // 상세내역 조회
			, nLogOut: evtNLogOut //비회원 로그아웃
		};

		// ==================================================================
		// set event function
		// ==================================================================
		// 화면공통 초기화 function
		function evtCmnInit() {
			// 보안프로그램 설치여부 확인
			$nosService.load(function (installed) {
				if (!installed) {
					//
				}
			});
			// 보안프로그램 실행
			$nosService.npPfsStartup(document.custSndFrm, true, true, true, true, "npkencrypt", "on");

			// 공통코드 호출[상담분류, 개인신용정보동의여부, 이메일도메인, 휴대폰앞자리]
			$commonService.getCmnCdSubList('HC102,H0046,C1096,C0171', function (data) {
				console.log('data[C1096]', data['C1096']);

				$scope.cunsClsnCd = $utilService.getDefaultChecked(data['HC102'], [data['HC102'][0].value]);
				$scope.pernInfoSfgrData = $utilService.getDefaultChecked(data['H0046'].reverse(), [data['H0046'][1].value]);
				$scope.emlData = data['C1096'];
				$scope.mbphArNo = $utilService.getDefaultChecked(data['C0171'], [data['C0171'][0].value]);
			});

			$scope.event.init01();
		}

		// 고객의견접수 초기화 function
		function evtInit01() {

			// 로그인여부 확인
			$lginService.isAuthenticated(function (hasLogin) {
				$scope.haslogin = hasLogin;
				if (hasLogin) $scope.memberYn = true;

				if (hasLogin) {
					// 로그인 되있을 경우
					$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson(null, { service: 'SMbrMang', operation: 'getBsInfoAll' })).then(function (data) {
						console.log("##########################################||||||", data.STbCuMbrMang01OutDto);
						$scope.data01.bryrMntd = data.STbCuMbrMang01OutDto.bryrMntd;
						$scope.data01.regNm = data.STbCuMbrMang01OutDto.mbrNm;
						$scope.data01.emadr = data.STbCuMbrMang01OutDto.emadr;
						$scope.data01.mbphArNo = data.STbCuMbrMang01OutDto.mbphArNo;
						$scope.data01.mbphOficNo = data.STbCuMbrMang01OutDto.mbphOficNo;
						$scope.data01.mbphEnNoEncp = data.STbCuMbrMang01OutDto.mbphEnNoEncp;
					});
				}
			});

			$scope.event.msgChange("msg01");
		}

		// 민원접수 초기화 function
		function evtInit02() {
			// 로그인여부 확인
			$lginService.isAuthenticated(function (hasLogin) {
				$scope.haslogin = hasLogin;

				if (hasLogin) {
					// 로그인 되있을 경우
					$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson(null, { service: 'SMbrMang', operation: 'getBsInfoAll' })).then(function (data) {
						console.log("##########################################||||||", data.STbCuMbrMang01OutDto);
						$scope.data02.regNm = data.STbCuMbrMang01OutDto.mbrNm;
						$scope.data02.emadr = data.STbCuMbrMang01OutDto.emadr;
						$scope.data02.mbphArNo = data.STbCuMbrMang01OutDto.mbphArNo;
						$scope.data02.mbphOficNo = data.STbCuMbrMang01OutDto.mbphOficNo;
						$scope.data02.mbphEnNoEncp = data.STbCuMbrMang01OutDto.mbphEnNoEncp;
					});
				}
			});

			$scope.event.msgChange("msg01");
		}

		// 나의내역 조회 초기화 function
		function evtInit03() {
			// 로그인여부 확인
			$lginService.isAuthenticated(function (hasLogin) {
				$scope.haslogin = hasLogin;

				if (hasLogin) {
					// 로그인 되있을 경우
					$scope.event.msgChange("msg03");
					$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson(null, { service: 'SMbrMang', operation: 'getBsInfoAll' })).then(function (data) {
						$scope.data03.regNm = data.STbCuMbrMang01OutDto.mbrNm;
						$scope.data03.emadr = data.STbCuMbrMang01OutDto.emadr;

						// 조회 바로 때려
						$scope.event.srchClick("03");
					});
				} else {
					$scope.event.msgChange("msg02");
				}
			});
		}

		// 칭찬합니다 초기화 function
		function evtInit04() {
			$scope.event.msgChange("msg04");

			$scope.event.srchClick("04");
		}

		// 탭변경 function
		function evtTabChange(tabpage) {
			if (tabpage == "01") {
				// 고객의견접수
				$scope.data01.cunsClsnCd = '00001'; // 상담분류
				$scope.data01.regNm = '';
				$scope.data01.emadr = '';
				$scope.data01.mbphArNo = '010'; // 전화번호
				$scope.data01.mbphOficNo = ''; // 전화번호
				$scope.data01.mbphEnNoEncp = ''; // 전화번호

				if (!$scope.haslogin) {
					$scope.data01.regPwse = ''; // 비밀번호
					document.custSndFrm.regPswe01.value = ''; // 비밀번호
				}

				$scope.data01.brdTl = ''; // 제목
				$scope.data01.brdCont = ''; // 내용
				$scope.data01.pernInfoSfgrData = 'N'; // 개인정보수집이용동의서

				$scope.event.init01();
			} else if (tabpage == "02") {
				// 민원접수
				$scope.data02.regNm = '';
				$scope.data02.emadr = '';
				$scope.data02.mbphArNo = '010'; // 전화번호
				$scope.data02.mbphOficNo = ''; // 전화번호
				$scope.data02.mbphEnNoEncp = ''; // 전화번호
				if (!$scope.haslogin) {
					$scope.data02.regPwse = ''; // 비밀번호
					document.custSndFrm.regPswe02.value = ''; // 비밀번호
				}

				$scope.data02.brdTl = ''; // 제목
				$scope.data02.brdCont = ''; // 내용
				$scope.data02.pernInfoSfgrData = 'N'; // 개인정보수집이용동의서

				$scope.event.init02();
			} else if (tabpage == "03") {
				// 나의내역조회
				//			$scope.data03.regNm = '';
				//			$scope.data03.emadr = '';
				//			
				//			if(!$scope.haslogin) {
				//				$scope.data03.regPwse = ''; // 비밀번호
				//				document.custSndFrm.regPswe03.value = ''; // 비밀번호
				//			}

				$scope.selectRow = false; // 상세선택 여부
				$scope.data03Detail = {}; // 상세내역 데이터

				if ($scope.data03.regNm != "" && $scope.data03.emadr != "" && $scope.data03.regPwse != "") {
					$scope.event.srchClick('03'); //로그인 했을 경우.
				} else {
					$scope.event.init03(); //로그인 안했을 경우.
				}
			} else if (tabpage == "04") {
				// 칭찬합니다
				//			$scope.selectRow2 = false; // 상세선택 여부
				//			$scope.data04Detail = {}; // 상세내역 데이터
				//			
				$scope.event.init04();
			}
		}

		function evtValidateParam(tabpage, callbackFunc) {
			if (tabpage == "01") {
				// 고객의견 접수
				if (!$scope.haslogin) {
					// 비회원접수일 경우
					$scope.data01.regPswe = document.custSndFrm.regPswe01.value;
				}
				if ($utilService.validateCheck($scope.data01, validateParam01, $scope, 'data01')) {
					if (!$scope.data01.regNm) {
						$utilService.openAlert("이름을 입력하세요.", function () {
							$timeout(function () {
								$scope.element['data01.regNm'].focus();
							}, 100);
						});
					} else if (!$scope.data01.emadr) {
						$utilService.openAlert("이메일주소를 입력하세요.", function () {
							$timeout(function () {
								$scope.element['data01.emadr'].focus();
							}, 100);
						});
					} else if (!$scope.data01.mbphArNo) {
						$utilService.openAlert("전화번호를 입력하세요.", function () {
							$timeout(function () {
								$scope.element['data01.mbphArNo'].focus();
							}, 100);
						});
					} else if (!$scope.data01.mbphOficNo) {
						$utilService.openAlert("전화번호를 입력하세요.", function () {
							$timeout(function () {
								$scope.element['data01.mbphOficNo'].focus();
							}, 100);
						});
					} else if (!$scope.data01.mbphEnNoEncp || $scope.data01.mbphEnNoEncp.length < 4) {
						$utilService.openAlert("전화번호를 입력하세요.", function () {
							$timeout(function () {
								$scope.element['data01.mbphEnNoEncp'].focus();
							}, 100);
						});
					} else if ($scope.haslogin == false && !$scope.data01.regPswe && $scope.data01.regPswe < 4) {
						console.log($scope.data01.regPswe);
						$utilService.openAlert("비밀번호를 입력하세요.", function () {
							$timeout(function () {
								$scope.element['data01.regPswe'].focus();
							}, 100);
						});
					} else if (!$scope.data01.brdTl) {
						$utilService.openAlert("제목을 입력하세요.", function () {
							$timeout(function () {
								$scope.element['data01.brdTl'].focus();
							}, 100);
						});
					} else if (!$scope.data01.brdCont) {
						$utilService.openAlert("내용을 입력하세요.", function () {
							$timeout(function () {
								$scope.element['data01.brdCont'].focus();
							}, 100);
						});
					} else if ($scope.data01.pernInfoSfgrData == "N") {
						$utilService.openAlert("개인정보 수집이용 약관에 동의해야 합니다.", function () {
							return;
						});
					} else {
						callbackFunc();
					}
				}
			} else if (tabpage == "02") {
				// 민원접수
				if (!$scope.haslogin) {
					// 비회원접수일 경우
					$scope.data02.regPswe = document.custSndFrm.regPswe02.value;
				}
				if ($utilService.validateCheck($scope.data02, validateParam01, $scope, 'data02')) {
					if (!$scope.data02.regNm) {
						$utilService.openAlert("이름을 입력하세요.", function () {
							$timeout(function () {
								$scope.element['data02.regNm'].focus();
							}, 100);
						});
					} else if (!$scope.data02.emadr) {
						$utilService.openAlert("이메일주소를 입력하세요.", function () {
							$timeout(function () {
								$scope.element['data02.emadr'].focus();
							}, 100);
						});
					} else if (!$scope.data02.mbphArNo) {
						$utilService.openAlert("전화번호를 입력하세요.", function () {
							$timeout(function () {
								$scope.element['data02.mbphArNo'].focus();
							}, 100);
						});
					} else if (!$scope.data02.mbphOficNo) {
						$utilService.openAlert("전화번호를 입력하세요.", function () {
							$timeout(function () {
								$scope.element['data02.mbphOficNo'].focus();
							}, 100);
						});
					} else if (!$scope.data02.mbphEnNoEncp || $scope.data02.mbphEnNoEncp.length < 4) {
						$utilService.openAlert("전화번호를 입력하세요.", function () {
							$timeout(function () {
								$scope.element['data02.mbphEnNoEncp'].focus();
							}, 100);
						});
					} else if ($scope.haslogin == false && !$scope.data02.regPswe && $scope.data02.regPswe < 4) {
						$utilService.openAlert("비밀번호를 입력하세요.", function () {
							$timeout(function () {
								$scope.element['data02.regPswe'].focus();
							}, 100);
						});
					} else if (!$scope.data02.brdTl) {
						$utilService.openAlert("제목을 입력하세요.", function () {
							$timeout(function () {
								$scope.element['data02.brdTl'].focus();
							}, 100);
						});
					} else if (!$scope.data02.brdCont) {
						$utilService.openAlert("내용을 입력하세요.", function () {
							$timeout(function () {
								$scope.element['data02.brdCont'].focus();
							}, 100);
						});
					} else if ($scope.data02.pernInfoSfgrData == "N") {
						$utilService.openAlert("개인정보 수집이용 약관에 동의해야 합니다.", function () {
							return;
						});
					} else {
						callbackFunc();
					}
				}
			} else if (tabpage == "03") {
				// 나의내역조회
				if (!$scope.haslogin) {
					// 비회원접수일 경우
					$scope.data03.regPswe = document.custSndFrm.regPswe03.value;
				}
				if ($utilService.validateCheck($scope.data03, validateParam03, $scope, 'data03')) {
					if (!$scope.data03.regNm) {
						$utilService.openAlert("이름을 입력하세요.", function () {
							$timeout(function () {
								$scope.element['data03.regNm'].focus();
							}, 100);
						});
					} else if (!$scope.data03.emadr) {
						$utilService.openAlert("이메일주소를 입력하세요.", function () {
							$timeout(function () {
								$scope.element['data03.emadr'].focus();
							}, 100);
						});
					} else if (!$scope.haslogin && !$scope.data03.regPswe && $scope.data03.regPswe < 4) {
						$utilService.openAlert("비밀번호를 입력하세요.", function () {
							$timeout(function () {
								$scope.element['data03.regPswe'].focus();
							}, 100);
						});
					} else {
						callbackFunc();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		// 등록 function
		function evtRegClick(tabpage) {
			if (tabpage == "01") {
				// 고객의견접수
				$scope.event.validateParam(tabpage, function () {
					$scope.data01.mbphNo = $scope.data01.mbphArNo + $scope.data01.mbphOficNo + $scope.data01.mbphEnNoEncp;

					// 고객의견등록 서비스 호출
					$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson($scope.data01, { service: 'SCunsCvapMang', operation: 'createMaCunsCvap' }, null, document.custSndFrm)).then(function (data) {
						console.log("데이터반환  =======================================seung getPostServerCall : ", data);
						if (data.SMaCunsCvapMang01OutDto) {
							if (data.SMaCunsCvapMang01OutDto.wrkReslNcnt > 0) {
								$utilService.openAlert('접수 되었습니다.\n빠른 시일 내로 연락드리겠습니다.', function () {
									$scope.event.moveToPage('R');
								});
							}
						}
					});
				});
			} else if (tabpage == "02") {
				// 민원접수
				$scope.event.validateParam(tabpage, function () {
					$scope.data02.mbphNo = $scope.data02.mbphArNo + $scope.data02.mbphOficNo + $scope.data02.mbphEnNoEncp;

					// 민원등록 서비스 호출
					$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson($scope.data02, { service: 'SCunsCvapMang', operation: 'createMaCunsCvap' }, null, document.custSndFrm)).then(function (data) {
						console.log("데이터반환  =======================================seung getPostServerCall : ", data);
						if (data.SMaCunsCvapMang01OutDto) {
							if (data.SMaCunsCvapMang01OutDto.wrkReslNcnt > 0) {
								$utilService.openAlert('접수 되었습니다.\n빠른 시일 내로 연락드리겠습니다.', function () {
									$scope.event.moveToPage('R');
								});
							}
						}
					});
				});
			}
		}

		// 조회 function
		function evtSrchClick(tabpage, pageNo) {
			if (tabpage == "03") {
				// 나의내역 조회

				$scope.event.validateParam(tabpage, function () {
					if (!pageNo) {
						$scope.data03.pageNo = 1;
						$scope.data03.totalCount = 0;
					} else {
						$scope.data03.pageNo = pageNo;
					}
					$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson($scope.data03, { service: 'SCunsCvapMang', operation: 'getMaCunsCvapList' }, null, document.custSndFrm)).then(function (data) {
						if (data.SMaCunsCvapMang01OutDto) {
							$scope.haslogin = true;
							$scope.selectRow = false;
							$scope.data03.totalCount = data.SMaCunsCvapMang01OutDto.totalCount;
							$scope.data03List = data.SMaCunsCvapMang01OutDto.sub;
						}
					});
				});
			} else if (tabpage == "04") {
				// 칭찬합니다
				if (!pageNo) {
					$scope.data04.pageNo = 1;
					$scope.data04.totalCount = 0;
				} else {
					$scope.data04.pageNo = pageNo;
				}
				$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson($scope.data04, { service: 'SCunsCvapMang', operation: 'getMaCunsCvapList' })).then(function (data) {
					if (data.SMaCunsCvapMang01OutDto) {
						$scope.selectRow2 = false;
						$scope.data04.totalCount = data.SMaCunsCvapMang01OutDto.totalCount;
						$scope.data04List = data.SMaCunsCvapMang01OutDto.sub;
					}
				});
			}
		}

		// 메세지 제어 function
		function evtMsgChange(flag) {
			if (flag == "msg01") {
				$("#msg01").removeClass("subs");
				$("#msg02").addClass("subs");
				$("#msg03").addClass("subs");
				$("#msg04").addClass("subs");
			} else if (flag == "msg02") {
				$("#msg01").addClass("subs");
				$("#msg02").removeClass("subs");
				$("#msg03").addClass("subs");
				$("#msg04").addClass("subs");
			} else if (flag == "msg03") {
				$("#msg01").addClass("subs");
				$("#msg02").addClass("subs");
				$("#msg03").removeClass("subs");
				$("#msg04").addClass("subs");
			} else if (flag == "msg04") {
				$("#msg01").addClass("subs");
				$("#msg02").addClass("subs");
				$("#msg03").addClass("subs");
				$("#msg04").removeClass("subs");
			}
		}

		// 화면이동 function
		function evtMoveToPage(flag) {
			if (flag == "R") {
				// 등록일 경우
				$utilService.go("/main");
			} else if (flag == "C") {
				// 취소일 경우
				$utilService.openConfirm("현재 작성 중인 내용이 초기화됩니다.\n작성을 취소하시겠습니까?", function () {
					$utilService.go("/main");
				});
			}
		}

		// 나의내역 조회 페이지이동 function
		function evtGoPage03(pageNo) {
			$scope.data03.pageNo = pageNo;
			$scope.event.srchClick('03');
		}

		// 칭찬합니다 페이지이동 function
		function evtGoPage04(pageNo) {
			$scope.data04.pageNo = pageNo;

	          if (val === 'K0670') {
	            //고용형태일 경우  주부/학생/무직 미노출 00010 자영업자
	            resultMap[val] = sesseionCmnCdGroMap[val].filter(function (map) {
	              return map.value != '00009' && map.value != '00010';
	            });
	          } else {
	            resultMap[val] = sesseionCmnCdGroMap[val];
	          }
	        } else {
	          params.push(val);
	        }
	      });

	      if (params.length) {

	    uploadFile: function uploadFile(url, data, option, dimFlag) {
	      dimFlag = typeof dimFlag == 'undefined' ? true : dimFlag;

	      var dim = null;
	      if (dimFlag) {
	        dim = $utilService.getDimmed($('.container1'));

	      if (option && option.noFile) {
	        $.ajax({
	          url: url,
	          type: 'post',
	          contentType: 'application/json',
	          dataType: 'json',
	          data: angular.toJson(data),
	          async: option && option.async ? true : false,
	          beforeSend: function beforeSend() {
	            console.log('beforeSend============================>');
	            if (dim) {
	              dim.show();
	            }
	          },
	          complete: function complete() {
	            console.log('complete============================>');
	            if (dim) {
	              dim.hide();
	            }
	          },
	          success: function success(data) {
	            option && option.success && option.success(data.result);
	          },
	          error: function error(data) {
	            option && option.error && option.error(data);
	          }
	        });
	      } else {
	        var formData = new FormData();
	        formData.append('uploadFile', data);

	        $.ajax({
	          url: url,
	          type: 'post',
	          processData: false,
	          contentType: false,
	          data: formData,
	          async: option && option.async ? true : false,
	          beforeSend: function beforeSend() {
	            console.log('beforeSend============================>');
	            if (dim) {
	              dim.show();
	            }
	          },
	          xhr: function xhr() {
	            //파일 업로드 구현시 퍼센트 값 마크업에 표시할때 사용
	            var xhr = $.ajaxSettings.xhr();
	            xhr.upload.addEventListener('progress', function (evt) {
	              if (evt.lengthComputable) {
	                var percentCompplete = evt.loaded / evt.total;
	                //console.log("upload", Math.round(percentCompplete*100) + "% complete");
	              }
	            }, false);
	            return xhr;
	          },
	          complete: function complete() {
	            console.log('complete============================>');
	            if (dim) {
	              dim.hide();
	            }
	          },
	          success: function success(data) {
	            option && option.success && option.success(data.result);
	          },
	          error: function error(data) {
	            option && option.error && option.error(data);
	          }
	        });
	      }
	    },

	    callFileSaveSuccess: function callFileSaveSuccess(fileGroKeyList) {

	            callFun(totMenuMap['menuMap']);

	  function chkPacketPoisoning(configHeader, dataHeader) {
	    if (configHeader && dataHeader) {
	      if (configHeader['Timestamp'] && dataHeader.authVl) {
	        if ($utilService.getNumberEncode(configHeader['Timestamp']) != dataHeader.authVl) {
	          //<p>변조된 데이타 신호가 감지되었습니다.<br>다시 시도해 주세요.</p>
	          //return false;
	        }
	      }
	    }

	    return true;
	  }

	  function callInDto(data) {
	    var isSetData = location.hostname === 'localhost' ? true : false;

	    if (!isSetData) {
	      return data;
	    }

	    data = JSON.parse(data);
	    data = data || { header: {}, data: {} };

	    try {
	      if (typeof eval(data.header.operation || '') === 'function') {
	        return (0, _stringify2.default)(eval(data.header.operation)('IN', data));
	      } else {
	        return (0, _stringify2.default)(data);
	      }
	    } catch (e) {
	      return (0, _stringify2.default)(data);
	    }
	  }

	  function callOutDto(data, inData) {
	    var isSetData = location.hostname === 'localhost' ? true : false;

	    if (!isSetData) {
	      return data;
	    }

	    data = data || { header: {} };

	    try {
	      if (!data.header.operation) {
	        inData = JSON.parse(inData);
	        data.header.operation = inData.header.operation;
	      }
	      if (typeof eval(data.header.operation || '') === 'function') {
	        return eval(data.header.operation)('OUT', data);
	      } else {
	        return data;
	      }
	    } catch (e) {
	      return data;
	    }
	  }
	}

		// 로그인 정보
		function getLgin() {
			var lgin = $sessionStorageService.get('lgin');

			return {
				mbrId: lgin ? lgin.mbrId : '',
				mbrNm: lgin ? lgin.mbrNm : '',
				mbphNo: lgin ? lgin.mbphNo : '',
				bryrMntd: lgin ? lgin.bryrMntd : '',
				mbrEtryDttm: lgin ? lgin.mbrEtryDttm : '',
				isMbr: lgin ? lgin.isMbr : false,
				custNo: lgin ? lgin.custNo : '',
				custMnno: lgin ? lgin.custMnno : '',
				ci: lgin ? lgin.ci : '',
				fnlLginDttm: lgin ? lgin.fnlLginDttm : ''
			};
		}

		// 로그인정보 셋 : private
		function setLgin(data) {
			$sessionStorageService.set('lgin', {
				mbrId: data.mbrId,
				mbrNm: data.mbrNm,
				mbphNo: data.mbphNo,
				bryrMntd: data.bryrMntd,
				mbrEtryDttm: data.mbrEtryDttm,
				isMbr: data.isMbr,
				custNo: data.custNo,
				custMnno: data.custMnno,
				ci: data.ci,
				fnlLginDttm: data.fnlLginDttm
			});
		}

		// 로그인정보 삭제 : private
		function removeLgin() {
			$sessionStorageService.set('lgin', undefined);
		}

		function evtNextStep() {

		function rqusMakeProv() {
			var provCont = new Array();
			provCont.push($('#title_cunsagree_01').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.cunsAgree_01) + ', ');

			provCont.push($('#title_cunsagree_04').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.cunsAgree_04) + ', ');
			provCont.push($('#title_cunsagree_05').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.cunsAgree_05) + ', ');
			provCont.push($('#title_cunsagree_06').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.cunsAgree_06) + ', ');
			provCont.push($('#title_cunsagree_07').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.cunsAgree_07) + ', ');

	          if ($scope.dtlSmryDvcd == '00002') {

	          if ($scope.dtlSmryDvcd == '00002') {

	            provReset(['agree_01', 'agree_20', 'agree_21', 'agree_04', 'agree_22', 'agree_06', 'agree_07', 'agree_08', 'agree_09', 'agree_13', 'agree_14', 'agree_17', 'agree_18']);

	      }
	      /*

	      function provCheckMbrPnt(lonNo, custNo) {
	        $eaiCmnService.getAgrmCnfmInqr({ custNo: custNo, lonNo: lonNo }, function (data) {
	          var dto = data.SAgrmCnfmInqrOutDto;
	          if (dto && dto.subEai.resultCode == '00') {
	            debugger;
	            var utlzAgrmYn = dto.subEai.utlzAgrmYn;
	            var ofrAgrmYn = dto.subEai.ofrAgrmYn;
	            var pntAgrmYn = dto.subEai.pntAgrmYn;
	            $scope.dtlSmryDvcd = dto.subEai.dtlSmryDvcd || $scope.dtlSmryDvcd || '00002';
	            $scope.agreeData.lonRcvNo = dto.subEai.lonRcvNo;

	            var agreeRetNm = 'agree_05';
	            if ($scope.dtlSmryDvcd == '00002') {
	              agreeRetNm = 'agree_22';
	            }

	            if (utlzAgrmYn == 'Y' && ofrAgrmYn == 'Y') {
	              provDisableAgree(agreeRetNm);
	              $scope.gdsGdCdCont = dto.subEai.gdsGdCdCont; // 이용동의
	              $scope.utlzAgrmYn = utlzAgrmYn;
	              $scope.ofrAgrmYn = ofrAgrmYn;
	            } else if (utlzAgrmYn == 'Y' || ofrAgrmYn == 'Y') {
	              if (utlzAgrmYn == 'Y') {
	                // 이용동의
	                $scope.gdsGdCdCont = dto.subEai.gdsGdCdCont; // 이용동의
	                $scope.utlzAgrmYn = utlzAgrmYn;
	                var utlzAgrmNm_01 = agreeRetNm + '_01';
	                var utlzAgrmNm_03 = agreeRetNm + '_03';
	                provDisableAgree(utlzAgrmNm_01);
	                provDisableAgree(utlzAgrmNm_03);
	              }
	              if (ofrAgrmYn == 'Y') {
	                // 제공동의
	                $scope.ofrAgrmYn = ofrAgrmYn;
	                var utlzAgrmNm_02 = agreeRetNm + '_02';
	                provDisableAgree(utlzAgrmNm_02);
	              }
	            }

	            if (pntAgrmYn == 'Y') {
	              $scope.data.hasMbrCivl = true;
	              var pntUtlzAgrmYn = dto.subEai.pntUtlzAgrmYn;
	              var pntGdCdCont = dto.subEai.pntGdCdCont;
	              provDisableAgree('agree_06');

	              $scope.agreeData.agree_06 = '';
	              $scope.agreeData.agree_06_01 = '';
	              $scope.agreeData.agree_06_02 = '';

	              $scope.agreeData.pntAgrmYn = "Y";
	            }
	          }
	        }, function (data) {
	          // fail
	        }, false);
	      }

	      function provDisableAgree(agree) {
	        $timeout(function () {
	          $scope.useAgree[agree] = false;
	        });
	      }

	      function provDataBind() {
	        $.each($($element).find('input[name^=agree_]'), function (key, val) {
	          var name = val.name;
	          var depth = $(this).data('depth');
	          if (depth > 0) {
	            console.log('$scope.agreeData[name]', $scope.agreeData[name], $(this).attr('type'));
	            if ($(this).attr('type') == 'checkbox') {
	              var yn = $(this).is(':checked') ? $(this).val() : 'N';
	              $scope.agreeData[name] = yn;
	            } else {
	              var $input = $('input[name=' + name + ']:checked');
	              $scope.agreeData[name] = $input.val();
	            }
	          }
	        });

	        {
	          // 마케팅 약관이 비노출 & 마케팅 정보가 있을시
	          var retAgreeDataNm = 'agree_05';
	          if ($scope.dtlSmryDvcd == '00002') {
	            retAgreeDataNm = 'agree_22';
	          }
	          if ($scope.utlzAgrmYn && $scope.gdsGdCdCont) {
	            // agree_05_01, agree_05_03
	            $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_01'] = 'N';
	            $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_03'] = 'N';
	            $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_03_01'] = 'N';
	            $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_03_02'] = 'N';
	            $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_03_03'] = 'N';
	            $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_03_04'] = 'N';

	            if ($scope.utlzAgrmYn == 'Y') {
	              $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_01'] = 'Y';
	            }

	            var gdsGdCdContArr = $scope.gdsGdCdCont.split(',');
	            if (gdsGdCdContArr.indexOf('00001') != -1) {
	              $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_03_03'] = 'Y';
	            }
	            if (gdsGdCdContArr.indexOf('00002') != -1) {
	              $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_03_01'] = 'Y';
	            }
	            if (gdsGdCdContArr.indexOf('00003') != -1) {
	              $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_03_04'] = 'Y';
	            }
	            if (gdsGdCdContArr.indexOf('00004') != -1) {
	              $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_03_02'] = 'Y';
	            }

	            if (gdsGdCdContArr.length == 4) {
	              $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_03'] = 'Y';
	            } else {
	              $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_03'] = 'S';
	            }
	          }

	          if ($scope.ofrAgrmYn) {
	            // agree_05_02
	            $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_02'] = 'N';

	            if ($scope.ofrAgrmYn == 'Y') {
	              $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_02'] = 'Y';
	            }
	          }

	          if ($scope.utlzAgrmYn || $scope.ofrAgrmYn) {
	            if ($scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_01'] && $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_01'] == 'N' && $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_02'] && $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_02'] == 'N') {
	              $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm] = 'N';
	            } else {
	              $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm] = 'Y';
	            }
	          }

	          //agree_05
	        }
	      }

	      function provCheckMbrCi() {
	        console.log('$scope', $scope);
	        if ($scope.useAgree.agree_06) {
	          $commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({ ci: $scope.data.ciVl }, { service: 'SMbrMang', operation: 'checkMbrCivl' }, null, null)).then(function (data) {
	            var dto = data.STbCuMbrMang01OutDto;
	            console.log(dto);
	            if (dto && dto.ci) {
	              $timeout(function () {
	                $scope.data.hasMbrCivl = true;

	                provDisableAgree('agree_06');
	              });
	            }
	          });
	        }
	      }

	      function provCheckJoinMbr() {
	        console.log('$scope', $scope);
	        $commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({ ci: $scope.data.ciVl }, { service: 'SEaiCmnService2', operation: 'cnfmPntEtry' }, null, null), function () {}).then(function (reData) {
	          var reDto = reData.SCnfmPntEtryOutDto;
	          console.log(reDto);
	          if (reDto && reDto.subEai && reDto.subEai.resultCode == "11") {
	            $timeout(function () {
	              $scope.data.hasMbrCivl = true;
	              $scope.agreeData.agree_06 = '';
	              $scope.agreeData.agree_06_01 = '';
	              $scope.agreeData.agree_06_02 = '';

	              provDisableAgree('agree_06');
	            });
	          }
	        });
	      }

	      function provCheckAgreeAll(modelNm, val) {
	        if (val === 'Y') {
	          $($element).find('input[name^=agree_][value=Y]').prop('checked', true);

	          //전체동의 -> 전체 약관 상세보기 팝업 
	          provDetailListPop();
	        } else {
	          $($element).find('input[name^=agree_]').prop('checked', false);
	        }
	      }

	      function provDtlSmryDvcd(modelNm, val) {
	        $scope.dtlSmryDvcd = val;
	        provResetForBspCd($scope.provBspCd);
	      }

	      //전체 약관 상세보기 팝업 
	      function provDetailListPop() {
	        var codes = {
	          'agree_01': '00001', //(주)오케이저축은행 서비스 이용약관
	          'agree_02': '00015', //개인(신용)정보 수집·이용·제공 동의서(여신금융거래용)
	          'agree_03': '00012', //개인(신용)정보 수집·이용·제공·조회 동의서
	          'agree_04': '00005', //대출 거절사유 고지 동의서
	          'agree_05': '00014', //개인(신용)정보 수집·이용·제공 동의서(상품서비스 안내 등)
	          'agree_06': '00054', //OK멤버십 서비스 가입 동의서
	          'agree_07': '00064', //계약 체결·이행 등을 위한 상세 동의서(개인금융성 신용보험용)
	          'agree_08': '00062', //개인(신용)정보 수집·이용·제공 동의서(신용보증재단용)
	          'agree_09': '00037', //채권수임사실 통보에 관한 동의서
	          'agree_10': '00039', //대출모집업무에 관한 동의서
	          'agree_11': '00081', //개인(신용)정보 제3자 제공에 대한 동의(통신관련정보이용)
	          'agree_13': '00087', //개인(신용)정보 수집·이용·제공 동의서(국토교통부 주택소유확인 이용 관련)
	          'agree_14': '00044', //개인(신용)정보 조회 동의서(신용보증재단용)
	          'agree_16': '00054', //OK멤버십 서비스 이용 약관(멤버십 가입 동의 로직이 없는 기본약관)
	          'agree_20': '00045', //개인(신용)정보 수집·이용·제공 요약 동의서(여신금융거래용)
	          'agree_21': '00046', //개인(신용)정보 수집·이용·제공·조회 요약 동의서
	          'agree_22': '00047', //개인(신용)정보 수집·이용·제공 요약 동의서(상품서비스 안내 등)
	          'agree_17': '00089', //개인(신용)정보 수집·이용 동의서(보증료우대서비스)
	          'agree_18': '00090' //개인(신용)정보 수집·이용 동의서(상품서비스 안내 등)
	        };
	        var provDvcdList = new Array();
	        $.each(codes, function (key, val) {
	          //약관목록 순서 유지
	          $.each($scope.useAgree, function (useAgreeKey, useAgreeVal) {
	            if (key === useAgreeKey && useAgreeVal) {
	              provDvcdList.push({ provDvcd: codes[key] });
	              return false;
	            }
	          });
	        });

	        $popupService.cmnPopProvList($scope, { provDvcdList: provDvcdList }, function () {
	          //전체 동의
	        });
	      }

	      function provItemPopClick(code, title, e) {
	        e.preventDefault();
	        e.stopImmediatePropagation();
	        $popupService.cmnPopProv($scope, { code: code, title: title }, function () {
	          var codes = {
	            '00001': '01',
	            '00015': '02',
	            '00012': '03',
	            '00005': '04',
	            '00014': '05',
	            '00054': '06',
	            '00064': '07',
	            '00062': '08',
	            '00037': '09',
	            '00039': '10',
	            '00081': '11',
	            '00087': '13',
	            '00044': '14',
	            '00045': '20',
	            '00046': '21',
	            '00047': '22'
	          };
	          var no = codes[code];
	          if (no) {
	            $($element).find('input[name^=agree_' + no + '][value=Y]').click();
	          }
	        });
	      }

	      function provDoneCheck(callback) {
	        provDataBind();

	        if ($scope.useAgree.agree_01) {
	          // agree_01 사용중
	          if ($scope.agreeData.agree_01 != 'Y') {
	            $utilService.openAlert('(주)오케이저축은행 서비스 이용약관에 동의해야 합니다.');
	            provCallback(callback, false);
	            return;
	          }
	        }

	        if ($scope.useAgree.agree_02) {
	          // agree_02 사용중
	          if ($scope.agreeData.agree_02 != 'Y') {
	            $utilService.openAlert('개인(신용)정보 수집ㆍ이용ㆍ제공 동의서(여신금융거래용, 개인신용대출)에 동의해야 합니다.');
	            provCallback(callback, false);
	            return;
	          }
	        }

	        if ($scope.useAgree.agree_20) {
	          // agree_20 사용중
	          if ($scope.agreeData.agree_20 != 'Y') {
	            $utilService.openAlert('개인(신용)정보 수집ㆍ이용ㆍ제공 요약 동의서(여신금융거래용, 개인신용대출)에 동의해야 합니다.');
	            provCallback(callback, false);
	            return;
	          }
	        }

	        if ($scope.useAgree.agree_03) {
	          // agree_03 사용중
	          if ($scope.agreeData.agree_03 != 'Y') {
	            $utilService.openAlert('개인(신용)정보 조회 동의서에 동의해야 합니다.');
	            provCallback(callback, false);
	            return;
	          }
	        }

	        if ($scope.useAgree.agree_21) {
	          // agree_21 사용중
	          if ($scope.agreeData.agree_21 != 'Y') {
	            $utilService.openAlert('개인(신용)정보 조회 요약 동의서에 동의해야 합니다.');
	            provCallback(callback, false);
	            return;
	          }
	        }

	        if ($scope.useAgree.agree_10) {
	          // agree_10 사용중
	          if ($scope.agreeData.agree_10 != 'Y') {
	            $utilService.openAlert('대출모집업무에 관한 동의사항을 선택해야 합니다.');
	            provCallback(callback, false);
	            return;
	          }
	        }

	        if ($scope.useAgree.agree_07) {
	          // agree_07 사용중
	          if ($scope.agreeData.agree_07 != 'Y') {
	            $utilService.openAlert('계약체결ㆍ이행등을 위한 동의서(개인금융성 신용보험용)에 동의해야 합니다.');
	            provCallback(callback, false);
	            return;
	          }
	        }

	        if ($scope.useAgree.agree_08) {
	          // agree_08 사용중
	          if ($scope.agreeData.agree_08 != 'Y') {
	            $utilService.openAlert('개인정보 수집&middot;이용 제공동의서(신용보증재단 용)에 동의해야 합니다.');
	            provCallback(callback, false);
	            return;
	          }
	        }

	        if ($scope.useAgree.agree_13) {
	          // agree_13 사용중

	          if (!$scope.agreeData.agree_16) {
	            $utilService.openAlert('OK멤버십 서비스 이용 약관을 선택해야 합니다.');

	            return;

	          if ($scope.agreeData.agree_16_01 != 'Y') {
	            $utilService.openAlert('OK멤버십 서비스 약관 동의여부를 동의해야 합니다.');

	            return;
	          } else if ($scope.agreeData.agree_16_04 != 'Y') {
	            $utilService.openAlert('OK멤버십 서비스 개인정보 수집이용제공 동의 여부를 동의해야 합니다.');
	            provCallback(callback, false);
	            return;
	          } else if (!$scope.agreeData.agree_16_06) {

	            return;

	            $utilService.openAlert('멤버십 올리고 서비스 개인정보 수집이용제공 동의 여부를 선택해야 합니다.');
	            callback(false);
	            return;

	            provCallback(callback, false);
	            return;
	          } else if (!$scope.agreeData.agree_16_03) {

	        if ($scope.useAgree.agree_tlph) {

	        if ($scope.data.hasMbrCivl) {
	          $scope.agreeData.agree_06 = $scope.agreeData.agree_06 ? $scope.agreeData.agree_06 : '';
	          $scope.agreeData.agree_06_01 = $scope.agreeData.agree_06_01 ? $scope.agreeData.agree_06_01 : '';
	          $scope.agreeData.agree_06_02 = $scope.agreeData.agree_06_02 ? $scope.agreeData.agree_06_02 : '';
	          $scope.agreeData.provCont = provMakeProv();
	          $scope.agreeData.lonProvAgrmCont = lonProvMakeProv();
	          $scope.agreeData.provAgrmList = provAgrmListMakeProv();
	          $scope.agreeData.pntAgrmYn = $scope.agreeData.pntAgrmYn ? $scope.agreeData.pntAgrmYn : 'Y';
	          $scope.agreeData.dtlSmryDvcd = $scope.dtlSmryDvcd;
	          provCallback(callback, true);
	          return;

	          if ($scope.useAgree.agree_06) {
	            // agree_06 사용중
	            if (!$scope.agreeData.agree_06) {
	              $utilService.openAlert('OK멤버십 서비스 가입안내를 선택해야 합니다.');
	              provCallback(callback, false);
	              return;
	            }
	            if (!$scope.agreeData.agree_06_01) {
	              $utilService.openAlert('OK멤버십 서비스 약관 동의를 선택해야 합니다.');
	              provCallback(callback, false);
	              return;
	            } else if (!$scope.agreeData.agree_06_04) {
	              $utilService.openAlert('OK멤버십 서비스 개인정보 수집이용제공 동의 여부를 선택해야 합니다.');
	              provCallback(callback, false);
	              return;
	            } else if ($scope.agreeData.agree_06_01 != 'Y' && $scope.agreeData.agree_06_04 == 'Y') {
	              $utilService.openAlert('OK멤버십 서비스 약관 동의 여부를 동의해야 합니다.');
	              provCallback(callback, false);
	              return;
	            } else if ($scope.agreeData.agree_06_01 == 'Y' && $scope.agreeData.agree_06_04 != 'Y') {
	              $utilService.openAlert('OK멤버십 서비스 개인정보 수집이용 동의 여부를 동의해야 합니다.');
	              provCallback(callback, false);
	              return;
	            } else if (!$scope.agreeData.agree_06_06) {
	              $utilService.openAlert('대출한도 안내 서비스를 선택해야 합니다.');
	              callback(false);
	              return;
	            } else if ($scope.plProv && !$scope.agreeData.agree_06_07) {
	              $utilService.openAlert('멤버십 올리고 서비스 개인정보 수집이용제공 동의 여부를 선택해야 합니다.');
	              provCallback(callback, false);
	              return;
	            } else if (!$scope.agreeData.agree_06_02) {
	              $utilService.openAlert('OK멤버십 서비스 개인정보 수집이용 동의 여부(상품서비스 안내 등)를 선택해야 합니다.');
	              provCallback(callback, false);
	              return;
	            } else if (!$scope.agreeData.agree_06_03) {
	              $utilService.openAlert('OK멤버십 서비스 안내 수단을 선택해야 합니다.');
	              provCallback(callback, false);
	              return;
	            } else if ($scope.agreeData.agree_06_06 == "Y" || $scope.agreeData.agree_06_07 == "Y" || $scope.agreeData.agree_06_02 == "Y" || $scope.agreeData.agree_06_03 == "Y" || $scope.agreeData.agree_06_03 == "S") {
	              if ($scope.agreeData.agree_06_01 != "Y") {
	                $utilService.openAlert('OK멤버십 서비스 약관 동의 여부를 동의해야 합니다.');
	                provCallback(callback, false);
	                return;
	              } else if ($scope.agreeData.agree_06_04 != "Y") {
	                $utilService.openAlert('OK멤버십 서비스 개인정보 수집이용 동의 여부를 동의해야 합니다.');
	                provCallback(callback, false);
	                return;
	              }
	            }

	            if ($scope.agreeData.agree_06_01 == 'N') {
	              $popupService.cmnPopMbrDisAgree($scope, function (flag) {
	                // OK멤버십 동의 팝업
	                if (flag) {
	                  $scope.agreeData.agree_06 = 'Y';
	                  $scope.agreeData.agree_06_01 = 'Y';
	                  $scope.agreeData.agree_06_02 = 'Y';
	                  $scope.agreeData.agree_06_03 = 'Y';
	                  $scope.agreeData.agree_06_03_01 = 'Y';
	                  $scope.agreeData.agree_06_03_02 = 'Y';
	                  $scope.agreeData.agree_06_04 = 'Y';
	                  $scope.agreeData.agree_06_06 = 'Y';
	                  if ($scope.plProv) {
	                    $scope.agreeData.agree_06_07 = 'Y';
	                    $scope.agreeData.agree_06_07_crntDttm = $dateUtil.getToday('yyyymmddhhmmss');
	                  }
	                  // CI 회원가입
	                  $scope.agreeData.pntAgrmYn = 'Y';
	                  $commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({ ci: $scope.data.ciVl, mbrNm: $scope.data.custNm, cmncCmDvcd: $scope.data.cmncCmDvcd, mbphArNo: $scope.data.mbphArNo, mbphOficNo: $scope.data.mbphOficNo, mbphEnNo: $scope.data.mbphEnNo }, { service: 'SMbrMang', operation: 'createMbrForCi' }, null, null), function (data) {}, false).then(function (data) {});
	                }
	                $scope.agreeData.provCont = provMakeProv();
	                $scope.agreeData.lonProvAgrmCont = lonProvMakeProv();
	                $scope.agreeData.provAgrmList = provAgrmListMakeProv();
	                $scope.agreeData.dtlSmryDvcd = $scope.dtlSmryDvcd;
	                provCallback(callback, true);
	              });
	              return;
	            } else {
	              // $scope.agreeData.agree_06_01 == Y
	              $scope.agreeData.provCont = provMakeProv();
	              $scope.agreeData.lonProvAgrmCont = lonProvMakeProv();
	              $scope.agreeData.provAgrmList = provAgrmListMakeProv();
	              $scope.agreeData.dtlSmryDvcd = $scope.dtlSmryDvcd;
	              // CI 회원가입
	              $scope.agreeData.pntAgrmYn = 'Y';
	              $commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({ ci: $scope.data.ciVl, mbrNm: $scope.data.custNm, cmncCmDvcd: $scope.data.cmncCmDvcd, mbphArNo: $scope.data.mbphArNo, mbphOficNo: $scope.data.mbphOficNo, mbphEnNo: $scope.data.mbphEnNo }, { service: 'SMbrMang', operation: 'createMbrForCi' }, null, null), function (data) {}, false).then(function (data) {});
	              provCallback(callback, true);
	              return;
	            }
	          } else {
	            $scope.agreeData.provCont = provMakeProv();
	            $scope.agreeData.lonProvAgrmCont = lonProvMakeProv();
	            $scope.agreeData.provAgrmList = provAgrmListMakeProv();
	            $scope.agreeData.dtlSmryDvcd = $scope.dtlSmryDvcd;
	            provCallback(callback, true);
	            return;
	          }
	        }
	      }

	      function provCallback(callback, flag) {
	        $scope.data = $.extend({}, $scope.data, $scope.agreeData);
	        console.log('callback', $scope.data);
	        callback(flag);
	      }

	      function provMakeProv() {
	        var provCont = new Array();
	        if ($scope.useAgree.agree_01) {
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_01]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_01) + ', ');
	        }
	        if ($scope.useAgree.agree_02) {
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_02]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_02) + ' (');
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_02_01]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_02_01) + ', ');
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_02_03]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_02_03) + ', ');
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_02_04]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_02_04) + ', ');
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_02_05]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_02_05) + '), ');
	        }
	        if ($scope.useAgree.agree_20) {
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_20]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_20) + ' (');
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_20_01]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_20_01) + ', ');
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_20_03]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_20_03) + ', ');
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_20_04]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_20_04) + ', ');
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_20_05]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_20_05) + '), ');
	        }
	        if ($scope.useAgree.agree_03) {
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_03]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_03) + ' (');
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_03_01]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_03_01) + ', ');
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_03_02]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_03_02) + ', ');
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_03_03]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_03_03) + ', ');
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_03_04]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_03_04) + '), ');
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_03_05]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_03_05) + '), ');
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_03_06]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_03_06) + '), ');
	        }
	        if ($scope.useAgree.agree_21) {
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_21]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_21) + ' (');
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_21_01]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_21_01) + ', ');
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_21_02]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_21_02) + ', ');
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_21_03]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_21_03) + ', ');
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_21_04]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_21_04) + '), ');
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_21_05]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_21_05) + '), ');
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_21_06]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_21_06) + '), ');
	        }
	        if ($scope.useAgree.agree_10) {
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_10]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_10) + ', ');
	        }
	        if ($scope.useAgree.agree_07) {
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_07]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_07) + ' (');
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_07_01]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_07_01) + ', ');
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_07_02]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_07_02) + ', ');
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_07_03]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_07_03) + ', ');
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_07_04]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_07_04) + '), ');
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_07_05]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_07_05) + '), ');
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_07_06]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_07_06) + '), ');
	        }
	        if ($scope.useAgree.agree_08) {
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_08]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_08) + ' (');
	          provCont.push($('[data-id=title_agree_08_06]').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.agreeData.agree_08_06) + ', ');

	      function provCheckMbrPnt(lonNo, custNo) {
	        $eaiCmnService.getAgrmCnfmInqr({ custNo: custNo, lonNo: lonNo }, function (data) {
	          var dto = data.SAgrmCnfmInqrOutDto;
	          if (dto && dto.subEai.resultCode == '00') {
	            debugger;
	            var utlzAgrmYn = dto.subEai.utlzAgrmYn;
	            var ofrAgrmYn = dto.subEai.ofrAgrmYn;
	            var pntAgrmYn = dto.subEai.pntAgrmYn;
	            $scope.dtlSmryDvcd = dto.subEai.dtlSmryDvcd || $scope.dtlSmryDvcd || '00002';
	            $scope.agreeData.lonRcvNo = dto.subEai.lonRcvNo;

	            var agreeRetNm = 'agree_05';
	            if ($scope.dtlSmryDvcd == '00002') {
	              agreeRetNm = 'agree_22';
	            }

	            if (utlzAgrmYn == 'Y' && ofrAgrmYn == 'Y') {
	              provDisableAgree(agreeRetNm);
	              $scope.gdsGdCdCont = dto.subEai.gdsGdCdCont; // 이용동의
	              $scope.utlzAgrmYn = utlzAgrmYn;
	              $scope.ofrAgrmYn = ofrAgrmYn;
	            } else if (utlzAgrmYn == 'Y' || ofrAgrmYn == 'Y') {
	              if (utlzAgrmYn == 'Y') {
	                // 이용동의
	                $scope.gdsGdCdCont = dto.subEai.gdsGdCdCont; // 이용동의
	                $scope.utlzAgrmYn = utlzAgrmYn;
	                var utlzAgrmNm_01 = agreeRetNm + '_01';
	                var utlzAgrmNm_03 = agreeRetNm + '_03';
	                provDisableAgree(utlzAgrmNm_01);
	                provDisableAgree(utlzAgrmNm_03);
	              }
	              if (ofrAgrmYn == 'Y') {
	                // 제공동의
	                $scope.ofrAgrmYn = ofrAgrmYn;
	                var utlzAgrmNm_02 = agreeRetNm + '_02';
	                provDisableAgree(utlzAgrmNm_02);
	              }
	            }

	            if (pntAgrmYn == 'Y') {
	              $scope.data.hasMbrCivl = true;
	              var pntUtlzAgrmYn = dto.subEai.pntUtlzAgrmYn;
	              var pntGdCdCont = dto.subEai.pntGdCdCont;
	              provDisableAgree('agree_06');

	              $scope.agreeData.agree_06 = '';
	              $scope.agreeData.agree_06_01 = '';
	              $scope.agreeData.agree_06_02 = '';

	              $scope.agreeData.pntAgrmYn = "Y";
	            }
	          }
	        }, function (data) {
	          // fail
	        }, false);
	      }

	      function provDisableAgree(agree) {
	        $timeout(function () {
	          $scope.useAgree[agree] = false;
	        });
	      }

	      function provDataBind() {
	        $.each($($element).find('input[name^=agree_]'), function (key, val) {
	          var name = val.name;
	          var depth = $(this).data('depth');
	          if (depth > 0) {
	            console.log('$scope.agreeData[name]', $scope.agreeData[name], $(this).attr('type'));
	            if ($(this).attr('type') == 'checkbox') {
	              var yn = $(this).is(':checked') ? $(this).val() : 'N';
	              $scope.agreeData[name] = yn;
	            } else {
	              var $input = $('input[name=' + name + ']:checked');
	              $scope.agreeData[name] = $input.val();
	            }
	          }
	        });

	        {
	          // 마케팅 약관이 비노출 & 마케팅 정보가 있을시
	          var retAgreeDataNm = 'agree_05';
	          if ($scope.dtlSmryDvcd == '00002') {
	            retAgreeDataNm = 'agree_22';
	          }
	          if ($scope.utlzAgrmYn && $scope.gdsGdCdCont) {
	            // agree_05_01, agree_05_03
	            $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_01'] = 'N';
	            $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_03'] = 'N';
	            $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_03_01'] = 'N';
	            $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_03_02'] = 'N';
	            $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_03_03'] = 'N';
	            $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_03_04'] = 'N';

	            if ($scope.utlzAgrmYn == 'Y') {
	              $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_01'] = 'Y';
	            }

	            var gdsGdCdContArr = $scope.gdsGdCdCont.split(',');
	            if (gdsGdCdContArr.indexOf('00001') != -1) {
	              $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_03_03'] = 'Y';
	            }
	            if (gdsGdCdContArr.indexOf('00002') != -1) {
	              $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_03_01'] = 'Y';
	            }
	            if (gdsGdCdContArr.indexOf('00003') != -1) {
	              $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_03_04'] = 'Y';
	            }
	            if (gdsGdCdContArr.indexOf('00004') != -1) {
	              $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_03_02'] = 'Y';
	            }

	            if (gdsGdCdContArr.length == 4) {
	              $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_03'] = 'Y';
	            } else {
	              $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_03'] = 'S';
	            }
	          }

	          if ($scope.ofrAgrmYn) {
	            // agree_05_02
	            $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_02'] = 'N';

	            if ($scope.ofrAgrmYn == 'Y') {
	              $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_02'] = 'Y';
	            }
	          }

	          if ($scope.utlzAgrmYn || $scope.ofrAgrmYn) {
	            if ($scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_01'] && $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_01'] == 'N' && $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_02'] && $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm + '_02'] == 'N') {
	              $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm] = 'N';
	            } else {
	              $scope.agreeData[retAgreeDataNm] = 'Y';
	            }
	          }

	          //agree_05
	        }
	      }

	      function provCheckMbrCi() {
	        console.log('$scope', $scope);
	        if ($scope.useAgree.agree_06) {
	          $commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({ ci: $scope.data.ciVl }, { service: 'SMbrMang', operation: 'checkMbrCivl' }, null, null)).then(function (data) {
	            var dto = data.STbCuMbrMang01OutDto;
	            console.log(dto);
	            if (dto && dto.ci) {
	              $timeout(function () {
	                $scope.data.hasMbrCivl = true;

	                provDisableAgree('agree_06');
	              });
	            }
	          });
	        }
	      }

	      function provCheckJoinMbr() {
	        console.log('$scope', $scope);
	        $commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({ ci: $scope.data.ciVl }, { service: 'SEaiCmnService2', operation: 'cnfmPntEtry' }, null, null), function () {}).then(function (reData) {
	          var reDto = reData.SCnfmPntEtryOutDto;
	          console.log(reDto);
	          if (reDto && reDto.subEai && reDto.subEai.resultCode == "11") {
	            $timeout(function () {
	              $scope.data.hasMbrCivl = true;
	              $scope.agreeData.agree_06 = '';
	              $scope.agreeData.agree_06_01 = '';
	              $scope.agreeData.agree_06_02 = '';

	              provDisableAgree('agree_06');
	            });
	          }
	        });
	      }

	      function provCheckAgreeAll(modelNm, val) {
	        if (val === 'Y') {
	          $($element).find('input[name^=agree_][value=Y]').prop('checked', true);

	          //전체동의 -> 전체 약관 상세보기 팝업 
	          provDetailListPop();
	        } else {
	          $($element).find('input[name^=agree_]').prop('checked', false);
	        }
	      }

	      function provDtlSmryDvcd(modelNm, val) {
	        $scope.dtlSmryDvcd = val;
	        provResetForBspCd($scope.provBspCd);
	      }

	      //전체 약관 상세보기 팝업 
	      function provDetailListPop() {
	        var codes = {
	          'agree_01': '00001', //(주)오케이저축은행 서비스 이용약관
	          'agree_02': '00015', //개인(신용)정보 수집·이용·제공 동의서(여신금융거래용)

	          'agree_04': '00005', //대출 거절사유 고지 동의서
	          'agree_05': '00014', //개인(신용)정보 수집·이용·제공 동의서(상품서비스 안내 등)
	          'agree_06': '00054', //OK멤버십 서비스 가입 동의서
	          'agree_07': '00064', //계약 체결·이행 등을 위한 상세 동의서(개인금융성 신용보험용)
	          'agree_08': '00062', //개인(신용)정보 수집·이용·제공 동의서(신용보증재단용)
	          'agree_09': '00037', //채권수임사실 통보에 관한 동의서
	          'agree_10': '00039', //대출모집업무에 관한 동의서
	          'agree_11': '00081', //개인(신용)정보 제3자 제공에 대한 동의(통신관련정보이용)
	          'agree_13': '00087', //개인(신용)정보 수집·이용·제공 동의서(국토교통부 주택소유확인 이용 관련)
	          'agree_14': '00044', //개인(신용)정보 조회 동의서(신용보증재단용)
	          'agree_16': '00054', //OK멤버십 서비스 이용 약관(멤버십 가입 동의 로직이 없는 기본약관)
	          'agree_20': '00045', //개인(신용)정보 수집·이용·제공 요약 동의서(여신금융거래용)
	          'agree_21': '00046', //개인(신용)정보 수집·이용·제공·조회 요약 동의서
	          'agree_22': '00047', //개인(신용)정보 수집·이용·제공 요약 동의서(상품서비스 안내 등)
	          'agree_17': '00089', //개인(신용)정보 수집·이용 동의서(보증료우대서비스)
	          'agree_18': '00090' //개인(신용)정보 수집·이용 동의서(상품서비스 안내 등)
	        };
	        var provDvcdList = new Array();
	        $.each(codes, function (key, val) {
	          //약관목록 순서 유지
	          $.each($scope.useAgree, function (useAgreeKey, useAgreeVal) {
	            if (key === useAgreeKey && useAgreeVal) {
	              provDvcdList.push({ provDvcd: codes[key] });
	              return false;
	            }
	          });
	        });

	        $popupService.cmnPopProvList($scope, { provDvcdList: provDvcdList }, function () {
	          //전체 동의
	        });
	      }

	      function provItemPopClick(code, title, e) {
	        e.preventDefault();
	        e.stopImmediatePropagation();
	        $popupService.cmnPopProv($scope, { code: code, title: title }, function () {
	          var codes = {
	            '00001': '01',
	            '00015': '02',
	            '00012': '03',
	            '00005': '04',
	            '00014': '05',
	            '00054': '06',
	            '00064': '07',
	            '00062': '08',
	            '00037': '09',
	            '00039': '10',
	            '00081': '11',
	            '00087': '13',
	            '00044': '14',
	            '00045': '20',
	            '00046': '21',
	            '00047': '22'
	          };
	          var no = codes[code];
	          if (no) {
	            $($element).find('input[name^=agree_' + no + '][value=Y]').click();
	          }
	        });
	      }

	            return;
	          }

	          $scope.agreeData.dtlSmryDvcd = $scope.dtlSmryDvcd;
	          provCallback(callback, true);
	          return;
	        } else {
	          if ($scope.useAgree.agree_06) {
	            // agree_06 사용중
	            if (!$scope.agreeData.agree_06) {
	              $utilService.openAlert('OK멤버십 서비스 가입안내를 선택해야 합니다.');
	              provCallback(callback, false);
	              return;
	            }
	            if (!$scope.agreeData.agree_06_01) {
	              $utilService.openAlert('OK멤버십 서비스 약관 동의를 선택해야 합니다.');
	              provCallback(callback, false);
	              return;
	            } else if (!$scope.agreeData.agree_06_04) {
	              $utilService.openAlert('OK멤버십 서비스 개인정보 수집이용제공 동의 여부를 선택해야 합니다.');
	              provCallback(callback, false);
	              return;
	            } else if ($scope.agreeData.agree_06_01 != 'Y' && $scope.agreeData.agree_06_04 == 'Y') {
	              $utilService.openAlert('OK멤버십 서비스 약관 동의 여부를 동의해야 합니다.');
	              provCallback(callback, false);
	              return;
	            } else if ($scope.agreeData.agree_06_01 == 'Y' && $scope.agreeData.agree_06_04 != 'Y') {

	              provCallback(callback, false);
	              return;

/***/ function(module, exports, __webpack_require__) {

	'use strict';

	var md = __webpack_require__(/*! ../../app_module */ "./app_module.js");

	md.controller('cmnPopKbAddrSrchController', __controller);

	/* @ngInject */
	function __controller($scope, $state, $window, $timeout, $operationUtil, $commonService, $utilService, $popupService, $chlBizCmnService) {

		$scope.view = {
			firstChoiceWdarCtdoNmIndex: 8,
			wdarCtdoNm: [],
			cggNm: [],
			tmdNm: [],
			hsngNm: [],
			totalcount: 0
		};

		$scope.data = {};

		$scope.codes = {};

		$scope.event = {
			init: evtInit,
			choiceHsngNm: evtChoiceHsngNm,
			close: evtOnClose
		};

		function evtInit() {
			console.log('$scope', $scope);

			$scope.data = $scope.$parent.popData || {};

			$scope.pager = $scope.$parent.pager;

			evtWdarCtdoNm();

			//주소1 라디오 버튼 클릭
			$(document).on('click.radio', 'input[name=addr1]', function (e) {
				var lrclArNm = this.value;
				evtCggNm(lrclArNm);
			});

			//주소2 라디오 버튼 클릭
			$(document).on('click.radio', 'input[name=addr2]', function (e) {
				var lrclArNm = $('input[name=addr1]:checked').val();
				var mdcfArNm = this.value;
				evtTmdNm(lrclArNm, mdcfArNm);
			});

			//주소3 라디오 버튼 클릭
			$(document).on('click.radio', 'input[name=addr3]', function (e) {
				var lrclArNm = $('input[name=addr1]:checked').val();
				var mdcfArNm = $('input[name=addr2]:checked').val();
				var smclArNm = this.value;
				evtHsngNm(lrclArNm, mdcfArNm, smclArNm);
			});
		}

		// 시도 조회
		function evtWdarCtdoNm() {
			$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({}, { service: 'SCmnPopAddrSerch', operation: 'getTbEx3720mList01' }), function (data) {}, false).then(function (data) {
				var list = data.STbEx3720m01OutDto.sub;

				var lrclArNm = list[$scope.view.firstChoiceWdarCtdoNmIndex].value;
				evtCggNm(lrclArNm);

				$timeout(function () {
					$scope.view.wdarCtdoNm = list;
				}, 100);
			});
		}

		// 시군구
		function evtCggNm(lrclArNm) {
			$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({ lrclArNm: lrclArNm }, { service: 'SCmnPopAddrSerch', operation: 'getTbEx3720mList02' }), function (data) {}, false).then(function (data) {
				var list = data.STbEx3720m01OutDto.sub;

				var mdcfArNm = list[0].value;
				evtTmdNm(lrclArNm, mdcfArNm);

				$timeout(function () {
					$scope.view.cggNm = list;
				}, 100);
			});
		}

		// 읍면동
		function evtTmdNm(lrclArNm, mdcfArNm) {
			$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({ lrclArNm: lrclArNm, mdcfArNm: mdcfArNm }, { service: 'SCmnPopAddrSerch', operation: 'getTbEx3720mList03' }), function (data) {}, false).then(function (data) {

			});

		// 단지명
		function evtHsngNm(lrclArNm, mdcfArNm, smclArNm) {

		// 시세조회
		function evtKbMrvlService(obj) {
			var eaiData = {
				lonCretNo: $scope.data.lonCretNo,
				thngDscnDivs: obj.sqno
			};

			var intrSrch = obj.lrclArNm + ' ' + obj.mdcfArNm + ' ' + obj.smclArNm + ' ' + obj.value;

			$chlBizCmnService.getRealEstateCond(eaiData, function (data) {
				var dto = data.SRealEstateCondOutDto;
				if (dto && dto.subEai.resultCode == '00') {
					var mrvlLst = dto.subEai.mrvlLst;

					$popupService.cmnPopAddrSrch($scope, { intrSrch: intrSrch, isKbMrvNext: true, isCvrgHsYn: $scope.data.isCvrgHsYn, kbMrvData: obj }, function (data) {
						evtOnCallback(mrvlLst, obj.value, data);
					});
				}
			}, function (data) {
				console.log('fail', data);
				$popupService.cmnPopAddrSrch($scope, { intrSrch: intrSrch, isKbMrvNext: true, isCvrgHsYn: $scope.data.isCvrgHsYn, kbMrvData: obj }, function (data) {
					evtOnCallback(null, obj.value, data);
				});
			});
		}

		// 시세정보
		// 추후 등기부 관련개발 추가해야함
		function evtOnCallback(mrvlLst, aptNm, addr) {
			var callbackData = {
				isMrvl: !!mrvlLst, //	true 인경우, 시세 있음, false 인경우 오류로 시세/평형정보 예외처리 진행
				mrvlLst: !!mrvlLst ? mrvlLst : [{ sqms: '0㎡', dlngGnrlAvrgPovs: '0' }],
				aptNm: aptNm
			};

			if (addr) {
				var dongHo = (addr.inpuDtadr || '').replace(/\((.*?)\)/ig, '').replace(/(^s*)|(\s*$)/g, '').split(' ');
				if (dongHo.length == 1) {
					addr.ho = dongHo[0].indexOf('호') > -1 ? dongHo[0].replace('호', '') : '';
				} else if (dongHo.length == 2) {
					addr.dong = dongHo[0].indexOf('동') > -1 ? dongHo[0].replace('동', '') : '';
					addr.ho = dongHo[1].indexOf('호') > -1 ? dongHo[1].replace('호', '') : '';
				}

				callbackData.addr = addr;
			}

			console.log('callbackData', callbackData);

			$scope.$parent.callbackAthz(callbackData);
			evtOnClose();
		}

		function evtOnClose() {
			try {
				$scope.$parent.pager.close();
			} catch (e) {
				$scope.pager.close();
			}
		}

		$scope.event.init();
	}

	module.exports = md;
