	md.service('$xecureService', __service);

	function __service($timeout, $q, $commonService, $utilService) {

		var service = {};

		service.load = load; // Anysign4PC 기본 로드 : 필히 호출해주어야 한다.
		service.isInstall = isInstall; // Anysign 설치 여부
		service.createServerCert = createServerCert; // BXM SXecureService을 통해 서버S(보안키)를 생성하여 가져온다.

		service.vid = vid; // VID(주민번호) 공동인증서 실행
		service.vid_web = vid_web; // VID(주민번호) 공동인증서 실행
		service.getVerifier = getVerifier; // 공동인증서 결과를 BXM SXecureService를 통해 검증한다.
		service.getPostServerCall = post; // POST : JSON 데이터 값을 xgate를 통해 암호화 후 Ajax 통신한다.
		service.getServerCall = get; // GET : JSON 데이터 값을 xgate를 통해 암호화 후 Ajax 통신한다.
		service.isLoaded = anySignLoad;

		return service;

		/**
	  * Anysign4PC 기본 로드 : 필히 호출해주어야 한다.
	  * (installCheck and LoadCallback)
	  */
		function load(install_callback, isNotInstallPop) {
			var anySign4PC = document.getElementById('anySign4PC');
			if (anySign4PC == null) {
				var head = document.getElementsByTagName('head')[0] || document.documentElement;
				anySign4PC = document.createElement('script');
				anySign4PC.id = 'anySign4PC';
				anySign4PC.src = '/assets/AnySign4PC/anySign4PCInterface.custom.js';
				head.appendChild(anySign4PC);

				anySign4PC.onload = function () {
					console.log('AnySign4PC', 'script load finish', AnySign);
					PrintObjectTag();

					isInstall(install_callback, isNotInstallPop);
					/*
	    getSessionId(function(sessionId) {
	    	console.log('sessionId', sessionId);
	    	$timeout(function() {
	    		AnySign.mAnySignSID = sessionId;
	    	}, 1000);
	    });
	    */
				};
			} else {
				if (typeof AnySign !== 'undefined') {
					if (!AnySign.mAnySignLoad) {
						$timeout(function () {

							/**************** 프로그램 설치 확인중 수정한 부분 START ***/ //////////
							AnySign.mExtensionSetting.mInstallCheck_CB = function (result) {
								if (result == "ANYSIGN4PC_NORMAL") {
									console.log('AnySign4PC _CB', 'ANYSIGN4PC_NORMAL');
									install_callback(true);
								} else {
									console.log('AnySign4PC _CB', 'NOT INSTALLED');
									install_callback(false);

									if (!isNotInstallPop) {
										$utilService.openAlert('공동인증서프로그램의 설치가 필요합니다.', function () {
											$utilService.go('wrap.custScrtPrgm');
										});
									}
								}
							};
							/**************** 프로그램 설치 확인중 수정한 부분 END***/ //////////

							AnySign4PC_LoadCallback(function () {});
							PrintObjectTag();
							/*
	      getSessionId(function(sessionId) {
	      	console.log('sessionId', sessionId);
	      	$timeout(function() {
	      		AnySign.mAnySignSID = sessionId;
	      	}, 1000);
	      });
	      */
						});
					} else {
						$timeout(function () {
							isInstall(install_callback, isNotInstallPop);
						}, 100);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		function isInstall(install_callback, isNotInstallPop) {
			$timeout(function () {
				AnySign4PC_installCheck(function (result) {
					if (result == "ANYSIGN4PC_NORMAL") {
						console.log('AnySign4PC', 'ANYSIGN4PC_NORMAL');
						install_callback(true);
					} else {
						console.log('AnySign4PC', 'NOT INSTALLED');
						install_callback(false);

						if (!isNotInstallPop) {
							$utilService.openAlert('공동인증서프로그램의 설치가 필요합니다.', function () {
								$utilService.go('wrap.custScrtPrgm');
								angularPopupCloseAll();
							});
						}
					}
				});
			}, 100);
		}

		function anySignLoad() {
			try {
				if (AnySign && AnySign.mAnySignLoad) {
					return true;
				}
			} catch (e) {
				console.log(e);
			}
			return false;
		}

		/**
	  * BXM SXecureService을 통해 서버S(보안키)를 생성하여 가져온다.
	  * @param s
	  */
		function createServerCert(s) {
			$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({ verifier: 'vid' }, { service: 'SXecureService', operation: 'createServerCert' })).then(function (data) {
				s(data.VerifierOutDto.serverCertWriteString);
			});
		}

		/**
	  * 기본 공동인증서 실행
	  * @param option : 기본 0 또는 2
	  * @param cont : 기본 ''
	  * @param callback
	  */
		function sign(option, cont, callback) {
			Sign_with_option(option, cont, function (aResult) {
				callback({ aResult: aResult });
			});
		}

		/**
	  * VID(주민번호) 공동인증서 실행
	  * @param s
	  * @param option : 기본 0
	  * @param cont : 기본 ''
	  * @param callback
	  */
		function vid(s, option, cont, callback) {
			Sign_with_vid_user(option, cont, s, function (aResult) {
				send_vid_info(function (aResultVid) {
					callback({ aResult: aResult, aVidMsg: aResultVid, verifier: 'vid' });
				});
			});
		}

		/**
	  * 공동인증서 VID 웹 실행
	  * @param s
	  * @param option : 기본 0
	  * @param cont : 기본 ''
	  * @param callback
	  */
		function vid_web(option, cont, rrno, callback) {
			createServerCert(function (s) {
				debugger;
				var aIdn = null;
				Sign_with_vid_web(option, cont, aIdn, s, function (aResult) {
					send_vid_info(function (aResultVid) {
						callback({ aResult: aResult, aVidMsg: aResultVid, aIdn: aIdn, verifier: 'vid' });
					});
				});
			});
		}

		/**
	  * 공동인증서용 세션아이디.
	  * @param result
	  * @param callback
	  */
		function getSessionId(callback) {
			$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({}, { service: 'SXecureService', operation: 'getHashedSessionId' })).then(function (data) {
				if (callback) {
					callback(data.VerifierOutDto.hashedSessionId);
				}
			});
		}

		/**
	  * 공동인증서 결과를 BXM SXecureService를 통해 검증한다.
	  * @param result
	  * @param callback
	  */
		function getVerifier(result, callback) {
			var form = arguments[2] || null;
			$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson(result, { service: 'SXecureService', operation: 'getVerifier' }, null, form)).then(function (data) {
				if (callback) {
					callback(data);
				}
			});
		}

		/**
	  * private xgate와 통신하여 q & p 값을 받아온다.
	  * @param qs
	  * @param aUserCallback
	  */
		function XecureAjaxPost(qs, aUserCallback) {
			console.log('$xecureService origin', qs);

			var xecure_value = '';
			AnySign.BlockEncEx('/', '', "GET", AnySign.mCharset, fn_BlockEncExGet_Callback);

			function fn_BlockEncExGet_Callback(aResult) {
				xecure_value = "q=" + Escape(aResult);
				console.log('$xecureService enc q', xecure_value); // &q 암호화데이터
				AnySign.BlockEncEx('/', qs, "POST", AnySign.mCharset, fn_BlockEncExPost_Callback); // p값 생성
			}

			function fn_BlockEncExPost_Callback(aResult) {
				if (!aResult || aResult == '') {
					$utilService.openAlert('구간 암호화 서버와 연결되지 않습니다.');
					return;
				}
				xecure_value += "&p=" + Escape(aResult);
				xecure_value += "&charset=UTF-8";
				aUserCallback(xecure_value);
				console.log('$xecureService enc q.p', xecure_value); // &p=&q=&charset=UTF-8 형태의 암호화데이터
			}
		}

		/**
	  * private Escape
	  */
		function Escape(url) {
			// url특수문자 변환
			var i;
			var ch;
			var out = '';
			var url_string = '';

			url_string = String(url);

			for (i = 0; i < url_string.length; i++) {
				ch = url_string.charAt(i);
				if (ch == ' ') out += '%20';else if (ch == '%') out += '%25';else if (ch == '&') out += '%26';else if (ch == '+') out += '%2B';else if (ch == '=') out += '%3D';else if (ch == '?') out += '%3F';else out += ch;
			}
			return out;
		}

		/**
	  * POST : JSON 데이터 값을 xgate를 통해 암호화 후 Ajax 통신한다.
	  * @param data
	  * @param callFn
	  */
		function post(data, callFn, dimFlag) {
			var defer = $q.defer();
			XecureAjaxPost(data, function (serializedData) {
				$commonService.getPostServerCall(serializedData, callFn, dimFlag).then(function (data) {
					defer.resolve(data);
				});
			});

			return defer.promise;
		}

		/**
	  * GET : JSON 데이터 값을 xgate를 통해 암호화 후 Ajax 통신한다..
	  * @param data
	  * @param callFn
	  */
		function get(data, callFn, dimFlag) {
			var defer = $q.defer();
			XecureAjaxPost(data, function (serializedData) {
				$commonService.getServerCall(serializedData, callFn, dimFlag).then(function (data) {
					defer.resolve(data);
				});
			});

			return defer.promise;
		}

		function angularPopupCloseAll() {

			$('.-bx-ui-paper .close-btn .-bx-ui-button').trigger('click');
		}
	}

		function evtCmnInit() {

			// 공통코드 호출[상담분류, 개인신용정보동의여부, 이메일도메인, 휴대폰앞자리]
			$commonService.getCmnCdSubList('HC102,HC104,HC105,H0046,C1096,C0171', function (data) {

				var cunsClsnCdList = $utilService.selectRemoveCd(data['HC102'], ['00005', '00006', '00007']);
				$scope.cunsClsnCd = $utilService.getDefaultChecked(cunsClsnCdList, [cunsClsnCdList[0].value]);
				$scope.cunsClsnCd2 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked(data['HC104'], [data['HC104'][0].value]);
				$scope.recvTpCd = $utilService.getDefaultChecked(data['HC105'], [data['HC105'][0].value]);
				$scope.pernInfoSfgrData = $utilService.getDefaultChecked(data['H0046'].reverse(), [data['H0046'][1].value]);
				$scope.emadrData = $utilService.getDefaultChecked(data['C1096'], [data['C1096'][0].label]);
				$scope.mbphArNo = $utilService.getDefaultChecked(data['C0171'], [data['C0171'][0].value]);
			});

			// 로그인 여부 
			$lginService.isAuthenticated(function (hasLogin) {
				$scope.haslogin = hasLogin;
			});

			// 초기 탭 세팅
			if ($scope.data.mbrYn || $scope.data.myLst) {
				$timeout(function () {
					$('#bxuip_tab_bind').find('a.ui-tabs-anchor').eq(1).trigger('click');
				}, 50);
			} else if ($scope.data.mbrYn || $scope.data.regYn) {
				$timeout(function () {
					$('#bxuip_tab_bind').find('a.ui-tabs-anchor').eq(0).trigger('click');
				}, 50);
			}

			// 탭 구분
			$(document).ready(function () {
				$('#bxuip_tab_bind').bxTab({
					heightStyle: '',
					onRender: function onRender() {
						$('.ui-tabs-nav').click(function (e) {
							var aTagArr = e.currentTarget.querySelectorAll('a');

							$.each(aTagArr, function (key, val) {
								val.removeAttribute('title');
							});

							e.target.title = '선택됨';

							titleFactory.addSubTitle(e.target.innerText, true, 100);
						});
					}
				}).bind();
			});
		}

		// 고객의견접수 초기화 function
		function evtInit01() {
			// 비회원 접수
			if ($scope.data.regYn == 'N') {
				$popupService.cmnCustSnd($scope);
				if ($scope.haslogin) {
					userInfo();
				}
			} else if ($scope.data.regYn == 'Y') {
				if (!$scope.haslogin) {
					$utilService.go("/lon/mbrLgin", { 'custSndReg': 'Y' });
				} else {
					$popupService.cmnCustSnd($scope);
					userInfo();

					// 회원내역조회일때
					if ($scope.data.mbrYn) {
						$scope.event.init03();
					}
				}
			}

		// 회원정보 조회
		function userInfo() {
			$chlBizCustService.getMbrCustInfoInqr({ cachSlct: true, customOutpuKeyList: ["bryrMntd", "custNm", "emadr", "mbphArNo", "mbphOficNo", "mbphEnNo"] }, function (data) {
				var dto = data.SMbrCustInfoInqrOutDto.subEai;

				$scope.data01.bryrMntd = dto.bryrMntd;
				$scope.data01.regNm = dto.custNm;
				$scope.data01.emadr = dto.emadr || '';
				$scope.data01.mbphArNo = dto.mbphArNo;
				$scope.data01.mbphOficNo = dto.mbphOficNo;
				$scope.data01.mbphEnNo = dto.mbphEnNo;

				if ($scope.data01.emadr) {
					$scope.hasloginEmadr = true;
					$scope.data01.emadrId = $scope.data01.emadr.split('@')[0];
					$scope.data01.emadrDmn = $scope.data01.emadr.split('@')[1];
					$scope.data01.emadrData = labToVal($scope.data01.emadrDmn, 'label');
				}
			});
		}

		// 나의내역 조회 초기화 function
		function evtInit03() {

			// 비회원 조회
			if ($scope.data.myLst == 'N' || $scope.data.regYn == 'N') {
				if (!$scope.haslogin) {

					$scope.areaType = 'I';
				} else {
					$chlBizCustService.getMbrCustInfoInqr({ cachSlct: true, customOutpuKeyList: ["custNm", "emadr"] }, function (data) {
						var dto = data.SMbrCustInfoInqrOutDto.subEai;

						$scope.data03.regNm = dto.custNm;
						$scope.data03.emadr = dto.emadr || '';
						$scope.data03.mbphArNo = dto.mbphArNo;
						$scope.data03.mbphOficNo = dto.mbphOficNo;
						$scope.data03.mbphEnNo = dto.mbphEnNo;

						evtSrchClick('03');
					});
				}
			} else {
				if (!$scope.haslogin) {

		// 조회 function
		function evtSrchClick(tabpage, pageNo) {
			if (tabpage == "03") {

				$scope.event.validateParam(tabpage, function () {
					if (!pageNo) {
						$scope.data03.pageNo = 1;
						$scope.data03.totalCount = 0;
						$scope.data03.mbphNo = $scope.data03.mbphArNo + '' + $scope.data03.mbphOficNo + '' + $scope.data03.mbphEnNo;
					} else {
						$scope.data03.pageNo = pageNo;
						$scope.data03.mbphNo = $scope.data01.mbphArNo + '' + $scope.data01.mbphOficNo + '' + $scope.data01.mbphEnNo;
					}

					if ($scope.data03.regPswe) {
						$scope.data03.regPswe = $scope.data03.regPswe.toLocaleLowerCase();
					}

					$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson($scope.data03, { service: 'SCunsCvapMang2', operation: 'getMaCunsCvapList' }, null, document.custSndFrm03)).then(function (data) {
						var dto = data.SMaCunsCvapMang01OutDto;

								$('#bxuip_tab_bind').find('a.ui-tabs-anchor').eq(0).trigger('click');
								window.scrollTo(0, 0);
							});
						} else {
							$scope.data03.totalCount = dto.totalCount;
							$scope.data03List = dto.sub;

							document.getElementById("tabs_1").style.display = "none";
							document.getElementById("tabs_3").style.display = "block";

							$scope.areaType = 'L';
						}
					});

		function evtMoveToPage(flag) {

						$utilService.go("/custSnd01000");
					}
				});
			} else {
				$scope.areaType = flag;
			}
		}

		// 정합성 검사
		function evtValidateParam(tabpage, callbackFunc) {

			var ckData1 = /[\{\}\[\]\/?.,;:|\)*~`!^\-+<>@\#$%&\\\=\(\'|"]/gi;
			var ckData4 = /[^0-9]/gi;

			// 고객의견 접수
			if (tabpage == "01") {
				if ($utilService.validateCheck($scope.data01, validateCheckParam01, $scope, 'data01', true)) {
					var msg = null;
					var elementKey = null;

					if ($scope.data01.regPswe.length != 4) {
						msg = "비밀번호는 숫자 4자리를 입력해 주세요.";
						elementKey = "data01.regPswe";
					} else if ($scope.data01.recvTpYn != "Y") {
						msg = "문자(SMS)/카카오 알리톡 알림에 동의해 주시기 바랍니다.";
						elementKey = "data01.recvTpYn";
					} else if ($scope.data01.pernInfoSfgrData != "Y") {
						msg = "약관에 동의해 주셔야 등록이 가능합니다.";
						elementKey = "data01.recvTpYn";
					} else if (ckData1.test($scope.data01.emadrId)) {
						msg = "이메일 아이디를 다시 확인해 주세요.";
						elementKey = "data01.recvTpYn";
					} else if (ckData4.test($scope.data01.emadrDmn)) {
						msg = "이메일 주소를 다시 확인해 주세요.";
						elementKey = "data01.recvTpYn";
					}

					if (msg) {
						$utilService.openAlert(msg, { skipAlertFocusEvt: true }, function () {
							$timeout(function () {
								$scope.element[elementKey].focus();
							}, 100);
						});
					} else {
						callbackFunc();
					}
				}
				callbackFunc();
			}
			// 나의내역조회

			if (tabpage == "03") {
				if (!$scope.haslogin) {
					// 비회원 조회

					if ($utilService.validateCheck($scope.data03, validateCheckParam03, $scope, 'data03', true)) {
						var msg = null;

						if (!$scope.haslogin) {
							if ($scope.data03.regPswe.length != 4) {
								msg = "비밀번호는 숫자 4자리를 입력해 주세요.";
							}
						}

						if (msg) {
							$utilService.openAlert(msg, function () {
								$timeout(function () {
									$scope.element['data03.regPswe'].focus();
								}, 100);
							});
						} else {
							callbackFunc();
						}
					}
				} else {
					callbackFunc();
				}
			}
		}

		function labToVal(obj, defal) {

			var ret, trans;
			if (defal == 'label') {
				for (var k in $scope.emadrData) {
					if (obj == $scope.emadrData[k].label) {
						ret = $scope.emadrData[k].value;
						return ret;
					}
				}
			} else if (defal == 'value') {
				for (var k in $scope.emadrData) {
					if (obj == $scope.emadrData[k].value) {
						ret = $scope.emadrData[k].label;
						return ret;
					}
				}
			}

			return obj;
		}

		// selectBox 선택시
		function evtSelectFun(modelNm, label, val) {

			// 이메일 콤보 선택시
			if (modelNm === 'data01.emadrData') {
				// 직접입력
				if (val == "00000") {
					$scope.data01.emadrData = "";
				} else {
					$scope.data01.emadrDmn = label;
				}
			}
		}

		$scope.event.cmnInit(); // 초기화
	}

	module.exports = md;

	                        $scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_01'] = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_01'], [val]);
	                        $scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_02'] = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_02'], [val]);
	                        $scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_03'] = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_03'], [val]);
	                        $scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_04'] = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_04'], [val]);
	                        $scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_05'] = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_05'], [val]);
	                    } else if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_03') != -1) {
	                        $scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_01'] = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_01'], [val]);
	                        $scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_02'] = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_02'], [val]);
	                        $scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_03'] = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_03'], [val]);
	                        $scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_04'] = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_04'], [val]);
	                    } else if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_05') != -1) {
	                        $scope.agree_05Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_01, [val]);
	                        $scope.agree_05Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_02, [val]);
	                        $scope.agree_05Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_03, [val === 'N' ? '' : val]);
	                        $scope.agree_05Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_04, [val]);

	                        $scope.data.agree_05_03_01 = val;
	                        $scope.data.agree_05_03_02 = val;
	                        $scope.data.agree_05_03_03 = val;
	                        $scope.data.agree_05_03_04 = val;
	                    } else if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_06') != -1) {
	                        $scope.agree_06Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_01, [val]);
	                        $scope.agree_06Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_02, [val]);
	                        $scope.agree_06Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03, [val === 'N' ? '' : val]);
	                        $scope.agree_06Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_04, [val]);

	                        $scope.data.agree_06_03_01 = val;
	                        $scope.data.agree_06_03_02 = val;
	                    }

	                    var allYn = 'N';
	                    allYn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_01', 'agree_02', 'agree_03', 'agree_04', 'agree_05', 'agree_06'], 'Y');

	                    var yn = allYn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                    $scope.data.agree_All = yn;
	                });
	            }

	            function provChoiceRadioFun(modelNm, val) {
	                console.log('provChoiceRadioFun', modelNm, val);
	                $timeout(function () {

	                    if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_02') != -1) {
	                        var a02Yn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_02_01', 'agree_02_02', 'agree_02_03', 'agree_02_04', 'agree_02_05'], 'Y');
	                        var yn02 = a02Yn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                        $scope.agree_02Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_02Data, [yn02]);
	                    } else if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_03') != -1) {
	                        var a03Yn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_03_01', 'agree_03_02', 'agree_03_03', 'agree_03_04'], 'Y');
	                        var yn03 = a03Yn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                        $scope.agree_03Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_03Data, [yn03]);
	                    } else if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_05') != -1) {
	                        if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_05_01') != -1) {
	                            $scope.data.agree_05_03_01 = val;
	                            $scope.data.agree_05_03_02 = val;
	                            $scope.data.agree_05_03_03 = val;
	                            $scope.data.agree_05_03_04 = val;

	                            $scope.data.agree_05_03 = val;
	                            $scope.data.agree_05_04 = val;
	                            $scope.agree_05Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_03, [val]);
	                            $scope.agree_05Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_04, [val]);
	                        } else if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_05_03') != -1) {
	                            $scope.data.agree_05_03_01 = val;
	                            $scope.data.agree_05_03_02 = val;
	                            $scope.data.agree_05_03_03 = val;
	                            $scope.data.agree_05_03_04 = val;

	                            var yn05_03 = val == 'Y' || val == 'S' ? 'Y' : 'N';

	                            $scope.data.agree_05_01 = val;
	                            $scope.agree_05Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_01, [yn05_03]);
	                        }

	                        var a05Yn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_05_01', 'agree_05_02', 'agree_05_03'], ['Y', 'S']);
	                        var yn05 = a05Yn ? 'Y' : 'N';

	                        $scope.agree_05Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data, [yn05]);
	                    } else if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_06') != -1) {
	                        if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_06_02') != -1) {
	                            $scope.data.agree_06_03_01 = val;
	                            $scope.data.agree_06_03_02 = val;

	                            $scope.data.agree_06_03 = val;
	                            $scope.data.agree_06_04 = val;
	                            $scope.agree_06Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03, [val]);
	                            $scope.agree_06Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_04, [val]);
	                        } else if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_06_03') != -1) {
	                            $scope.data.agree_06_03_01 = val;
	                            $scope.data.agree_06_03_02 = val;
	                            var yn06_03 = val == 'Y' || val == 'S' ? 'Y' : 'N';

	                            $scope.data.agree_06_02 = val;
	                            $scope.agree_06Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_02, [yn06_03]);
	                        }

	                        var a06Yn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_06_01', 'agree_06_02', 'agree_06_03'], ['Y', 'S']);
	                        var yn06 = a06Yn ? 'Y' : 'N';

	                        $scope.agree_06Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data, [yn06]);
	                    }

	                    $timeout(function () {
	                        // 데이타 바인딩 속도차로 지연시간 추가    					
	                        var allYn = 'N';
	                        allYn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_01', 'agree_02', 'agree_03', 'agree_04', 'agree_05', 'agree_06'], 'Y');
	                        var yn = allYn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                        $scope.data.agree_All = yn;
	                    }, 100);
	                });
	            }

	            function provItemCheckFun(modelNm, val, val2) {
	                $timeout(function () {
	                    if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_05') != -1) {
	                        if ($('input[name^=agree_05_03_0]:checked').length == 4) {
	                            $scope.agree_05Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_03, ['Y']);
	                            $scope.agree_05Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_01, ['Y']);
	                        } else if ($('input[name^=agree_05_03_0]:checked').length > 0) {
	                            $scope.agree_05Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_03, ['S']);
	                            $scope.agree_05Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_01, ['Y']);
	                        }

	                        $timeout(function () {
	                            // 데이타 바인딩 속도차로 지연시간 추가
	                            var a05Yn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_05_01', 'agree_05_02', 'agree_05_03'], ['Y', 'S']);
	                            var yn05 = a05Yn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                            $scope.agree_05Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data, [yn05]);

	                            $timeout(function () {
	                                // 데이타 바인딩 속도차로 지연시간 추가
	                                var allYn = 'N';
	                                allYn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_01', 'agree_02', 'agree_03', 'agree_04', 'agree_05', 'agree_06'], 'Y');
	                                var yn = allYn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                                $scope.data.agree_All = yn;
	                            }, 100);
	                        }, 100);
	                    } else if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_06') != -1) {
	                        if ($('input[name^=agree_06_03_0]:checked').length == 2) {
	                            $scope.agree_06Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03, ['Y']);
	                            $scope.agree_06Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_02, ['Y']);
	                        } else if ($('input[name^=agree_06_03_0]:checked').length > 0) {
	                            $scope.agree_06Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03, ['S']);
	                            $scope.agree_06Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_02, ['Y']);
	                        }

	                        $timeout(function () {
	                            // 데이타 바인딩 속도차로 지연시간 추가
	                            var a06Yn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_06_01', 'agree_06_02', 'agree_06_03'], ['Y', 'S']);
	                            var yn06 = a06Yn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                            $scope.agree_06Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data, [yn06]);

	                            $timeout(function () {
	                                // 데이타 바인딩 속도차로 지연시간 추가
	                                var allYn = 'N';
	                                allYn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_01', 'agree_02', 'agree_03', 'agree_04', 'agree_05', 'agree_06'], 'Y');
	                                var yn = allYn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                                $scope.data.agree_All = yn;
	                            }, 100);
	                        }, 100);
	                    }
	                });
	            }

	            function provItemPopClick(code, title, e) {
	                e.preventDefault();
	                e.stopImmediatePropagation();
	                $popupService.cmnPopProv($scope, { code: code, title: title }, function () {
	                    var yn = 'Y';
	                    if (code == '00001') {
	                        // agree_01
	                        $scope.agree_01Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_01Data, [yn]);
	                    } else if (code == '00015') {
	                        // agree_02
	                        $scope.agree_02Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_02Data, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_02Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_02Data_01, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_02Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_02Data_02, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_02Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_02Data_03, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_02Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_02Data_04, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_02Data_05 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_02Data_05, [yn]);
	                    } else if (code == '00012') {
	                        // agree_03
	                        $scope.agree_03Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_03Data, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_03Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_03Data_01, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_03Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_03Data_02, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_03Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_03Data_03, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_03Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_03Data_04, [yn]);
	                    } else if (code == '00054') {
	                        // agree_06
	                        $scope.agree_06Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_06Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_01, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_06Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_02, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_06Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_06Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_04, [yn]);
	                    } else if (code == '00005') {
	                        // agree_04
	                        $scope.agree_04Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_04Data, [yn]);
	                    } else if (code == '00002') {
	                        // agree_05
	                        $scope.agree_05Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_05Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_01, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_05Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_02, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_05Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_03, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_05Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_04, [yn]);
	                    }

	                    $timeout(function () {
	                        // 데이타 바인딩 속도차로 지연시간 추가    					
	                        var allYn = 'N';
	                        allYn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_01', 'agree_02', 'agree_03', 'agree_04', 'agree_05', 'agree_06'], 'Y');

	                        var yn = allYn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                        $scope.data.agree_All = yn;
	                    }, 100);
	                });
	            }

	            function provDoneCheck(callback) {
	                if ($scope.data.agree_01 != 'Y') {
	                    $utilService.openAlert('(주)오케이저축은행 서비스 이용약관에 동의해야 합니다.');
	                    callback(false);
	                    return;
	                }
	                if ($scope.data.agree_02 != 'Y') {
	                    $utilService.openAlert('개인(신용)정보 수집ㆍ이용ㆍ제공 동의서(여신금융거래용, 개인신용대출)에 동의해야 합니다.');
	                    callback(false);
	                    return;
	                }
	                if ($scope.data.agree_03 != 'Y') {
	                    $utilService.openAlert('개인(신용)정보 조회 동의서에 동의해야 합니다.');
	                    callback(false);
	                    return;
	                }
	                if (!$scope.data.agree_04) {
	                    $utilService.openAlert('대출거절 사유 고지요청을 선택해야 합니다.');
	                    callback(false);
	                    return;
	                }
	                if (!$scope.data.agree_05) {
	                    $utilService.openAlert('개인(신용)정보 수집 ㆍ이용 동의서(상품서비스 안내등)를 선택해야 합니다.');
	                    callback(false);
	                    return;
	                }
	                if ($scope.data.agree_05_03 == 'S') {
	                    if ($scope.data.agree_05_03_01 != 'Y' && $scope.data.agree_05_03_02 != 'Y' && $scope.data.agree_05_03_03 != 'Y' && $scope.data.agree_05_03_04 != 'Y') {
	                        $utilService.openAlert('상품서비스 안내 수단은 (SMS, 이메일, 전화, DM)중 한개는 필수로 선택해야 합니다.');
	                        callback(false);
	                        return;
	                    }
	                }
	                /* else if ($scope.data.agree_05_03 == 'N'){
	                	$utilService.openAlert('상품서비스 안내 수단은 (SMS, 이메일, 전화, DM)중 한개는 필수로 선택해야 합니다.');
	                	callback(false);
	                }*/

	                if ($scope.data.hasMbrCivl) {
	                    $scope.data.agree_06 = 'N';
	                    $scope.data.provCont = provMakeProv();
	                    $scope.data.pntAgrmYn = 'Y';
	                    callback(true);
	                    return;
	                } else {
	                    if (!$scope.data.agree_06) {
	                        $utilService.openAlert('OK멤버십 서비스 가입안내를 선택해야 합니다.');
	                        callback(false);
	                        return;
	                    } else if ($scope.data.agree_06 == 'N') {
	                        $popupService.cmnPopMbrDisAgree($scope, function (flag) {
	                            // OK멤버십 동의 팝업
	                            if (flag) {
	                                $scope.data.agree_06 = 'Y';
	                                $scope.data.agree_06_01 = 'Y';
	                                $scope.data.agree_06_02 = 'Y';
	                                $scope.data.agree_06_03 = 'Y';
	                                $scope.data.agree_06_03_01 = 'Y';
	                                $scope.data.agree_06_03_02 = 'Y';
	                                $scope.data.agree_06_04 = 'Y';

	                                $scope.agree_06Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data, 'Y');
	                                $scope.agree_06Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_01, 'Y');
	                                $scope.agree_06Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_02, 'Y');
	                                $scope.agree_06Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03, 'Y');
	                                $scope.agree_06Data_03_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03_01, 'Y');
	                                $scope.agree_06Data_03_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03_02, 'Y');
	                                $scope.agree_06Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_04, 'Y');

	                                // CI 회원가입
	                                $scope.data.pntAgrmYn = 'Y';
	                                $commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({ ci: $scope.data.ciVl, mbrNm: $scope.data.custNm, cmncCmDvcd: $scope.data.cmncCmDvcd, mbphArNo: $scope.data.mbphArNo, mbphOficNo: $scope.data.mbphOficNo, mbphEnNo: $scope.data.mbphEnNo }, { service: 'SMbrMang', operation: 'createMbrForCi' }, null, null), function (data) {}, false).then(function (data) {});
	                            }
	                            $scope.data.provCont = provMakeProv();

	                            callback(true);
	                            return;
	                        });
	                    } else {
	                        $scope.data.provCont = provMakeProv();
	                        // CI 회원가입
	                        $scope.data.pntAgrmYn = 'Y';
	                        $commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({ ci: $scope.data.ciVl, mbrNm: $scope.data.custNm, cmncCmDvcd: $scope.data.cmncCmDvcd, mbphArNo: $scope.data.mbphArNo, mbphOficNo: $scope.data.mbphOficNo, mbphEnNo: $scope.data.mbphEnNo }, { service: 'SMbrMang', operation: 'createMbrForCi' }, null, null), function (data) {}, false).then(function (data) {});
	                        callback(true);
	                        return;
	                    }
	                }
	            }

	            function provMakeProv() {
	                var provCont = new Array();
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_01').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_01) + ', ');

	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_02_01').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_02_01) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_02_02').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_02_02) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_02_03').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_02_03) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_02_04').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_02_04) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_02_05').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_02_05) + '), ');

	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_03').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_03) + ' (');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_03_01').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_03_01) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_03_02').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_03_02) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_03_03').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_03_03) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_03_04').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_03_04) + '), ');

	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_06').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_06) + ' (');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_06_01').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_06_01) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_06_02').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_06_02) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_06_03').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_06_03) + ' (');
	                provCont.push('(전화=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_06_03_01) + ', SMS=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_06_03_02) + ')), ');

	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_04').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_04) + ', ');

	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_05').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_05) + ' (');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_05_01').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_05_01) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_05_02').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_05_02) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_05_03').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_05_03) + ' (');
	                provCont.push('(SMS=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_05_03_01) + ', 이메일=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_05_03_02) + ', 전화=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_05_03_03) + ', DM=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_05_03_04) + '))');

	                var reProvCont = provCont.join('');

	                return reProvCont.replace(/(\t|\s+\s|\n|\r\n)/g, '');
	            }

	            $scope.prov.init();
	        },
	        link: function link(scope, iElement, iAttrs) {

	            var labelWrap = $(iElement).find('.label-wrap');
	            labelWrap.on('click.toggle', function (e) {
	                this.classList.toggle("active");

	                var panel = this.nextElementSibling;
	                if (panel && panel.style) {
	                    if (panel.style.display === "block") {
	                        panel.style.display = "none";
	                    } else {
	                        panel.style.display = "block";
	                    }
	                }
	            });

	            $(".box-scroll").mCustomScrollbar({
	                theme: "my-theme",
	                setHeight: 265
	            });
	        }
	    };
	}

	            function provChoiceRadioFun(modelNm, val) {

	                            $scope.data.agree_05_03_01 = val;

	                            var yn05_03 = val == 'Y' || val == 'S' ? 'Y' : 'N';

	                            $scope.data.agree_05_01 = val;
	                            $scope.agree_05Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_01, [yn05_03]);
	                        }

	                        var a05Yn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_05_01', 'agree_05_02', 'agree_05_03'], ['Y', 'S']);
	                        var yn05 = a05Yn ? 'Y' : 'N';

	                        $scope.agree_05Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data, [yn05]);
	                    } else if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_06') != -1) {
	                        if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_06_02') != -1) {
	                            $scope.data.agree_06_03_01 = val;
	                            $scope.data.agree_06_03_02 = val;

	                            $scope.data.agree_06_03 = val;
	                            $scope.data.agree_06_04 = val;
	                            $scope.agree_06Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03, [val]);

	            function provItemCheckFun(modelNm, val, val2) {
	                $timeout(function () {
	                    if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_05') != -1) {
	                        if ($('input[name^=agree_05_03_0]:checked').length == 4) {
	                            $scope.agree_05Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_03, ['Y']);
	                            $scope.agree_05Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_01, ['Y']);
	                        } else if ($('input[name^=agree_05_03_0]:checked').length > 0) {
	                            $scope.agree_05Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_03, ['S']);
	                            $scope.agree_05Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_01, ['Y']);
	                        }

	                        $timeout(function () {
	                            // 데이타 바인딩 속도차로 지연시간 추가
	                            var a05Yn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_05_01', 'agree_05_02', 'agree_05_03'], ['Y', 'S']);
	                            var yn05 = a05Yn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                            $scope.agree_05Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data, [yn05]);

	                            $timeout(function () {
	                                // 데이타 바인딩 속도차로 지연시간 추가
	                                var allYn = 'N';
	                                allYn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_01', 'agree_02', 'agree_03', 'agree_04', 'agree_05', 'agree_06'], 'Y');
	                                var yn = allYn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                                $scope.data.agree_All = yn;
	                            }, 100);
	                        }, 100);
	                    } else if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_06') != -1) {
	                        if ($('input[name^=agree_06_03_0]:checked').length == 2) {
	                            $scope.agree_06Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03, ['Y']);
	                            $scope.agree_06Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_02, ['Y']);
	                        } else if ($('input[name^=agree_06_03_0]:checked').length > 0) {
	                            $scope.agree_06Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03, ['S']);
	                            $scope.agree_06Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_02, ['Y']);
	                        }

	                        $timeout(function () {
	                            // 데이타 바인딩 속도차로 지연시간 추가
	                            var a06Yn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_06_01', 'agree_06_02', 'agree_06_03'], ['Y', 'S']);
	                            var yn06 = a06Yn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                            $scope.agree_06Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data, [yn06]);

	                            $timeout(function () {
	                                // 데이타 바인딩 속도차로 지연시간 추가
	                                var allYn = 'N';
	                                allYn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_01', 'agree_02', 'agree_03', 'agree_04', 'agree_05', 'agree_06'], 'Y');
	                                var yn = allYn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                                $scope.data.agree_All = yn;
	                            }, 100);

	                    }
	                });
	            }

	            function provItemPopClick(code, title, e) {
	                e.preventDefault();
	                e.stopImmediatePropagation();
	                $popupService.cmnPopProv($scope, { code: code, title: title }, function () {
	                    var yn = 'Y';
	                    if (code == '00001') {
	                        // agree_01
	                        $scope.agree_01Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_01Data, [yn]);
	                    } else if (code == '00015') {
	                        // agree_02
	                        $scope.agree_02Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_02Data, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_02Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_02Data_01, [yn]);

	                        $scope.agree_02Data_05 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_02Data_05, [yn]);
	                    } else if (code == '00012') {
	                        // agree_03
	                        $scope.agree_03Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_03Data, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_03Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_03Data_01, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_03Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_03Data_02, [yn]);

	                        // agree_04
	                        $scope.agree_04Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_04Data, [yn]);
	                    } else if (code == '00002') {
	                        // agree_05
	                        $scope.agree_05Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_05Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_01, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_05Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_02, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_05Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_03, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_05Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_04, [yn]);
	                    }

	                    $timeout(function () {
	                        // 데이타 바인딩 속도차로 지연시간 추가    					
	                        var allYn = 'N';
	                        allYn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_01', 'agree_02', 'agree_03', 'agree_04', 'agree_05', 'agree_06'], 'Y');
	                        var yn = allYn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                        $scope.data.agree_All = yn;
	                    }, 100);
	                });
	            }

	            function provDoneCheck(callback) {
	                if ($scope.data.agree_01 != 'Y') {
	                    $utilService.openAlert('(주)오케이저축은행 서비스 이용약관에 동의해야 합니다.');
	                    callback(false);
	                    return;
	                }
	                if ($scope.data.agree_02 != 'Y') {
	                    $utilService.openAlert('개인(신용)정보 수집ㆍ이용ㆍ제공 동의서(여신금융거래용, 개인신용대출)에 동의해야 합니다.');
	                    callback(false);
	                    return;
	                }
	                if ($scope.data.agree_03 != 'Y') {
	                    $utilService.openAlert('개인(신용)정보 조회 동의서에 동의해야 합니다.');
	                    callback(false);
	                    return;
	                }

	                if (!$scope.data.agree_04) {
	                    $utilService.openAlert('대출거절 사유 고지요청을 선택해야 합니다.');
	                    callback(false);
	                    return;
	                }
	                if (!$scope.data.agree_05) {
	                    $utilService.openAlert('개인(신용)정보 수집 ㆍ이용 동의서(상품서비스 안내등)를 선택해야 합니다.');
	                    callback(false);
	                    return;
	                }
	                if ($scope.data.agree_05_03 == 'S') {
	                    if ($scope.data.agree_05_03_01 != 'Y' && $scope.data.agree_05_03_02 != 'Y' && $scope.data.agree_05_03_03 != 'Y' && $scope.data.agree_05_03_04 != 'Y') {
	                        $utilService.openAlert('상품서비스 안내 수단은 (SMS, 이메일, 전화, DM)중 한개는 필수로 선택해야 합니다.');
	                        callback(false);
	                        return;
	                    }
	                }
	                /* else if ($scope.data.agree_05_03 == 'N'){
	                	$utilService.openAlert('상품서비스 안내 수단은 (SMS, 이메일, 전화, DM)중 한개는 필수로 선택해야 합니다.');
	                	callback(false);
	                }*/

	                if ($scope.data.hasMbrCivl) {
	                    $scope.data.agree_06 = 'N';
	                    $scope.data.provCont = provMakeProv();
	                    $scope.data.pntAgrmYn = 'Y';
	                    callback(true);
	                    return;
	                } else {
	                    if (!$scope.data.agree_06) {
	                        $utilService.openAlert('OK멤버십 서비스 가입안내를 선택해야 합니다.');
	                        callback(false);
	                        return;
	                    } else if ($scope.data.agree_06 == 'N') {
	                        $popupService.cmnPopMbrDisAgree($scope, function (flag) {
	                            // OK멤버십 동의 팝업
	                            if (flag) {
	                                $scope.data.agree_06 = 'Y';
	                                $scope.data.agree_06_01 = 'Y';
	                                $scope.data.agree_06_02 = 'Y';
	                                $scope.data.agree_06_03 = 'Y';
	                                $scope.data.agree_06_03_01 = 'Y';
	                                $scope.data.agree_06_03_02 = 'Y';
	                                $scope.data.agree_06_04 = 'Y';

	                                $scope.agree_06Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data, 'Y');
	                                $scope.agree_06Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_01, 'Y');
	                                $scope.agree_06Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_02, 'Y');
	                                $scope.agree_06Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03, 'Y');
	                                $scope.agree_06Data_03_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03_01, 'Y');
	                                $scope.agree_06Data_03_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03_02, 'Y');
	                                $scope.agree_06Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_04, 'Y');

	                                // CI 회원가입
	                                $scope.data.pntAgrmYn = 'Y';
	                                $commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({ ci: $scope.data.ciVl, mbrNm: $scope.data.custNm, cmncCmDvcd: $scope.data.cmncCmDvcd, mbphArNo: $scope.data.mbphArNo, mbphOficNo: $scope.data.mbphOficNo, mbphEnNo: $scope.data.mbphEnNo }, { service: 'SMbrMang', operation: 'createMbrForCi' }, null, null), function (data) {}, false).then(function (data) {});
	                            }
	                            $scope.data.provCont = provMakeProv();

	                            callback(true);
	                            return;
	                        });
	                    } else {
	                        $scope.data.provCont = provMakeProv();
	                        // CI 회원가입
	                        $scope.data.pntAgrmYn = 'Y';
	                        $commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({ ci: $scope.data.ciVl, mbrNm: $scope.data.custNm, cmncCmDvcd: $scope.data.cmncCmDvcd, mbphArNo: $scope.data.mbphArNo, mbphOficNo: $scope.data.mbphOficNo, mbphEnNo: $scope.data.mbphEnNo }, { service: 'SMbrMang', operation: 'createMbrForCi' }, null, null), function (data) {}, false).then(function (data) {});
	                        callback(true);
	                        return;
	                    }
	                }
	            }

	            function provMakeProv() {
	                var provCont = new Array();
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_01').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_01) + ', ');

	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_02').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_02) + ' (');

	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_02_01').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_02_01) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_02_02').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_02_02) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_02_03').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_02_03) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_02_04').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_02_04) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_02_05').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_02_05) + '), ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_03').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_03) + ' (');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_03_01').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_03_01) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_03_02').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_03_02) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_03_03').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_03_03) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_03_04').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_03_04) + '), ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_06').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_06) + ' (');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_06_01').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_06_01) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_06_02').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_06_02) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_06_03').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_06_03) + ' (');
	                provCont.push('(전화=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_06_03_01) + ', SMS=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_06_03_02) + ')), ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_04').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_04) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_05').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_05) + ' (');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_05_01').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_05_01) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_05_02').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_05_02) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_05_03').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_05_03) + ' (');
	                provCont.push('(SMS=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_05_03_01) + ', 이메일=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_05_03_02) + ', 전화=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_05_03_03) + ', DM=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_05_03_04) + '))');

	                var reProvCont = provCont.join('');

	                return reProvCont.replace(/(\t|\s+\s|\n|\r\n)/g, '');
	            }

	            $scope.prov.init();
	        },
	        link: function link(scope, iElement, iAttrs) {

	            var labelWrap = $(iElement).find('.label-wrap');
	            labelWrap.on('click.toggle', function (e) {
	                this.classList.toggle("active");

	                var panel = this.nextElementSibling;
	                if (panel && panel.style) {
	                    if (panel.style.display === "block") {
	                        panel.style.display = "none";
	                    } else {
	                        panel.style.display = "block";
	                    }
	                }
	            });

	            $(".box-scroll").mCustomScrollbar({
	                theme: "my-theme",
	                setHeight: 265
	            });
	        }
	    };
	}

	            function provRadioAgreeFun(modelNm, val) {

	                $timeout(function () {
