	                        $scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_05'] = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_05'], [val]);
	                    } else if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_03') != -1 || modelNm.indexOf('agree_07') != -1) {
	                        $scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_01'] = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_01'], [val]);
	                        $scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_02'] = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_02'], [val]);
	                        $scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_03'] = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_03'], [val]);
	                        $scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_04'] = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_04'], [val]);
	                    } else if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_05') != -1) {
	                        $scope.agree_05Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_01, [val]);
	                        $scope.agree_05Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_02, [val]);
	                        $scope.agree_05Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_03, [val === 'N' ? '' : val]);
	                        $scope.agree_05Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_04, [val]);

	                        $scope.data.agree_05_03_01 = val;
	                        $scope.data.agree_05_03_02 = val;
	                        $scope.data.agree_05_03_03 = val;
	                        $scope.data.agree_05_03_04 = val;
	                    } else if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_06') != -1) {
	                        $scope.agree_06Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_01, [val]);
	                        $scope.agree_06Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_02, [val]);
	                        $scope.agree_06Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03, [val === 'N' ? '' : val]);
	                        $scope.agree_06Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_04, [val]);

	                        $scope.data.agree_06_03_01 = val;
	                        $scope.data.agree_06_03_02 = val;
	                    }

	                    var allYn = 'N';
	                    allYn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_01', 'agree_02', 'agree_03', 'agree_07', 'agree_04', 'agree_05', 'agree_06'], 'Y');
	                    var yn = allYn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                    $scope.data.agree_All = yn;
	                });
	            }

	            function provChoiceRadioFun(modelNm, val) {
	                console.log('provChoiceRadioFun', modelNm, val);
	                $timeout(function () {

	                    if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_02') != -1) {
	                        var a02Yn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_02_01', 'agree_02_02', 'agree_02_03', 'agree_02_04', 'agree_02_05'], 'Y');
	                        var yn02 = a02Yn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                        $scope.agree_02Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_02Data, [yn02]);
	                    } else if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_03') != -1) {
	                        var a03Yn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_03_01', 'agree_03_02', 'agree_03_03', 'agree_03_04'], 'Y');
	                        var yn03 = a03Yn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                        $scope.agree_03Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_03Data, [yn03]);
	                    } else if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_07') != -1) {
	                        var a07Yn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_07_01', 'agree_07_02', 'agree_07_03', 'agree_07_04'], 'Y');
	                        var yn07 = a07Yn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                        $scope.agree_07Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_07Data, [yn07]);
	                    } else if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_05') != -1) {
	                        if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_05_01') != -1) {
	                            $scope.data.agree_05_03_01 = val;
	                            $scope.data.agree_05_03_02 = val;
	                            $scope.data.agree_05_03_03 = val;
	                            $scope.data.agree_05_03_04 = val;

	                            $scope.data.agree_05_03 = val;
	                            $scope.data.agree_05_04 = val;
	                            $scope.agree_05Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_03, [val]);
	                            $scope.agree_05Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_04, [val]);
	                        } else if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_05_03') != -1) {
	                            $scope.data.agree_05_03_01 = val;
	                            $scope.data.agree_05_03_02 = val;
	                            $scope.data.agree_05_03_03 = val;
	                            $scope.data.agree_05_03_04 = val;

	                            var yn05_03 = val == 'Y' || val == 'S' ? 'Y' : 'N';

	                            $scope.data.agree_05_01 = val;
	                            $scope.agree_05Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_01, [yn05_03]);
	                        }

	                        var a05Yn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_05_01', 'agree_05_02', 'agree_05_03'], ['Y', 'S']);
	                        var yn05 = a05Yn ? 'Y' : 'N';

	                        $scope.agree_05Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data, [yn05]);
	                    } else if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_06') != -1) {
	                        if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_06_02') != -1) {
	                            $scope.data.agree_06_03_01 = val;
	                            $scope.data.agree_06_03_02 = val;

	                            $scope.data.agree_06_03 = val;
	                            $scope.data.agree_06_04 = val;
	                            $scope.agree_06Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03, [val]);
	                            $scope.agree_06Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_04, [val]);
	                        } else if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_06_03') != -1) {
	                            $scope.data.agree_06_03_01 = val;
	                            $scope.data.agree_06_03_02 = val;
	                            var yn06_03 = val == 'Y' || val == 'S' ? 'Y' : 'N';

	                            $scope.data.agree_06_02 = val;
	                            $scope.agree_06Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_02, [yn06_03]);
	                        }

	                        var a06Yn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_06_01', 'agree_06_02', 'agree_06_03'], ['Y', 'S']);
	                        var yn06 = a06Yn ? 'Y' : 'N';

	                        $scope.agree_06Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data, [yn06]);
	                    }

	                    $timeout(function () {
	                        // 데이타 바인딩 속도차로 지연시간 추가    					
	                        var allYn = 'N';
	                        allYn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_01', 'agree_02', 'agree_03', 'agree_07', 'agree_04', 'agree_05', 'agree_06'], 'Y');
	                        var yn = allYn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                        $scope.data.agree_All = yn;
	                    }, 100);
	                });
	            }

	            function provItemCheckFun(modelNm, val, val2) {
	                $timeout(function () {
	                    if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_05') != -1) {
	                        if ($('input[name^=agree_05_03_0]:checked').length == 4) {
	                            $scope.agree_05Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_03, ['Y']);
	                            $scope.agree_05Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_01, ['Y']);
	                        } else if ($('input[name^=agree_05_03_0]:checked').length > 0) {
	                            $scope.agree_05Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_03, ['S']);
	                            $scope.agree_05Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_01, ['Y']);
	                        }

	                        $timeout(function () {
	                            // 데이타 바인딩 속도차로 지연시간 추가
	                            var a05Yn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_05_01', 'agree_05_02', 'agree_05_03'], ['Y', 'S']);
	                            var yn05 = a05Yn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                            $scope.agree_05Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data, [yn05]);

	                            $timeout(function () {
	                                // 데이타 바인딩 속도차로 지연시간 추가
	                                var allYn = 'N';
	                                allYn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_01', 'agree_02', 'agree_03', 'agree_07', 'agree_04', 'agree_05', 'agree_06'], 'Y');
	                                var yn = allYn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                                $scope.data.agree_All = yn;
	                            }, 100);
	                        }, 100);
	                    } else if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_06') != -1) {
	                        if ($('input[name^=agree_06_03_0]:checked').length == 2) {
	                            $scope.agree_06Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03, ['Y']);
	                            $scope.agree_06Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_02, ['Y']);
	                        } else if ($('input[name^=agree_06_03_0]:checked').length > 0) {
	                            $scope.agree_06Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03, ['S']);
	                            $scope.agree_06Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_02, ['Y']);
	                        }

	                        $timeout(function () {
	                            // 데이타 바인딩 속도차로 지연시간 추가
	                            var a06Yn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_06_01', 'agree_06_02', 'agree_06_03'], ['Y', 'S']);
	                            var yn06 = a06Yn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                            $scope.agree_06Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data, [yn06]);

	                            $timeout(function () {
	                                // 데이타 바인딩 속도차로 지연시간 추가
	                                var allYn = 'N';
	                                allYn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_01', 'agree_02', 'agree_03', 'agree_07', 'agree_04', 'agree_05', 'agree_06'], 'Y');
	                                var yn = allYn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                                $scope.data.agree_All = yn;
	                            }, 100);
	                        }, 100);
	                    }
	                });
	            }

	            function provItemPopClick(code, title, e) {
	                e.preventDefault();
	                e.stopImmediatePropagation();
	                $popupService.cmnPopProv($scope, { code: code, title: title }, function () {
	                    var yn = 'Y';
	                    if (code == '00001') {
	                        // agree_01
	                        $scope.agree_01Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_01Data, [yn]);
	                    } else if (code == '00015') {
	                        // agree_02
	                        $scope.agree_02Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_02Data, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_02Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_02Data_01, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_02Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_02Data_02, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_02Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_02Data_03, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_02Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_02Data_04, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_02Data_05 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_02Data_05, [yn]);
	                    } else if (code == '00012') {
	                        // agree_03
	                        $scope.agree_03Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_03Data, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_03Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_03Data_01, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_03Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_03Data_02, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_03Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_03Data_03, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_03Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_03Data_04, [yn]);
	                    } else if (code == '00064') {
	                        // agree_07
	                        $scope.agree_07Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_07Data, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_07Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_07Data_01, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_07Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_07Data_02, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_07Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_07Data_03, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_07Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_07Data_04, [yn]);
	                    } else if (code == '00054') {
	                        // agree_06
	                        $scope.agree_06Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_06Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_01, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_06Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_02, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_06Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_06Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_04, [yn]);
	                    } else if (code == '00005') {
	                        // agree_04
	                        $scope.agree_04Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_04Data, [yn]);
	                    } else if (code == '00002') {
	                        // agree_05
	                        $scope.agree_05Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_05Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_01, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_05Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_02, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_05Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_03, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_05Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_04, [yn]);
	                    }

	                    $timeout(function () {
	                        // 데이타 바인딩 속도차로 지연시간 추가    					
	                        var allYn = 'N';
	                        allYn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_01', 'agree_02', 'agree_03', 'agree_07', 'agree_04', 'agree_05', 'agree_06'], 'Y');
	                        var yn = allYn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                        $scope.data.agree_All = yn;
	                    }, 100);
	                });
	            }

	            function provDoneCheck(callback) {
	                if ($scope.data.agree_01 != 'Y') {
	                    $utilService.openAlert('(주)오케이저축은행 서비스 이용약관에 동의해야 합니다.');
	                    callback(false);
	                    return;
	                }
	                if ($scope.data.agree_02 != 'Y') {
	                    $utilService.openAlert('개인(신용)정보 수집ㆍ이용ㆍ제공 동의서(여신금융거래용, 개인신용대출)에 동의해야 합니다.');
	                    callback(false);
	                    return;
	                }
	                if ($scope.data.agree_03 != 'Y') {
	                    $utilService.openAlert('개인(신용)정보 조회 동의서에 동의해야 합니다.');
	                    callback(false);
	                    return;
	                }
	                if ($scope.data.agree_07 != 'Y') {
	                    $utilService.openAlert('계약체결ㆍ이행등을 위한 동의서(개인금융성 신용보험용)에 동의해야 합니다.');
	                    callback(false);
	                    return;
	                }
	                if (!$scope.data.agree_04) {
	                    $utilService.openAlert('대출거절 사유 고지요청을 선택해야 합니다.');
	                    callback(false);
	                    return;
	                }
	                if (!$scope.data.agree_05) {
	                    $utilService.openAlert('개인(신용)정보 수집 ㆍ이용 동의서(상품서비스 안내등)를 선택해야 합니다.');
	                    callback(false);
	                    return;
	                }
	                if ($scope.data.agree_05_03 == 'S') {
	                    if ($scope.data.agree_05_03_01 != 'Y' && $scope.data.agree_05_03_02 != 'Y' && $scope.data.agree_05_03_03 != 'Y' && $scope.data.agree_05_03_04 != 'Y') {
	                        $utilService.openAlert('상품서비스 안내 수단은 (SMS, 이메일, 전화, DM)중 한개는 필수로 선택해야 합니다.');
	                        callback(false);
	                        return;
	                    }
	                }
	                /* else if ($scope.data.agree_05_03 == 'N'){
	                	$utilService.openAlert('상품서비스 안내 수단은 (SMS, 이메일, 전화, DM)중 한개는 필수로 선택해야 합니다.');
	                	callback(false);
	                }*/

	                if ($scope.data.hasMbrCivl) {
	                    $scope.data.agree_06 = 'N';
	                    $scope.data.provCont = provMakeProv();
	                    $scope.data.pntAgrmYn = 'Y';
	                    callback(true);
	                    return;
	                } else {
	                    if (!$scope.data.agree_06) {
	                        $utilService.openAlert('OK멤버십 서비스 가입안내를 선택해야 합니다.');
	                        callback(false);
	                        return;
	                    } else if ($scope.data.agree_06 == 'N') {
	                        $popupService.cmnPopMbrDisAgree($scope, function (flag) {
	                            // OK멤버십 동의 팝업
	                            if (flag) {
	                                $scope.data.agree_06 = 'Y';
	                                $scope.data.agree_06_01 = 'Y';
	                                $scope.data.agree_06_02 = 'Y';
	                                $scope.data.agree_06_03 = 'Y';
	                                $scope.data.agree_06_03_01 = 'Y';
	                                $scope.data.agree_06_03_02 = 'Y';
	                                $scope.data.agree_06_04 = 'Y';

	                                $scope.agree_06Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data, 'Y');
	                                $scope.agree_06Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_01, 'Y');
	                                $scope.agree_06Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_02, 'Y');
	                                $scope.agree_06Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03, 'Y');
	                                $scope.agree_06Data_03_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03_01, 'Y');
	                                $scope.agree_06Data_03_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03_02, 'Y');
	                                $scope.agree_06Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_04, 'Y');

	                                // CI 회원가입
	                                $scope.data.pntAgrmYn = 'Y';
	                                $commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({ ci: $scope.data.ciVl, mbrNm: $scope.data.custNm, cmncCmDvcd: $scope.data.cmncCmDvcd, mbphArNo: $scope.data.mbphArNo, mbphOficNo: $scope.data.mbphOficNo, mbphEnNo: $scope.data.mbphEnNo }, { service: 'SMbrMang', operation: 'createMbrForCi' }, null, null), function (data) {}, false).then(function (data) {});
	                            }
	                            $scope.data.provCont = provMakeProv();

	                            callback(true);
	                            return;
	                        });
	                    } else {
	                        $scope.data.provCont = provMakeProv();
	                        // CI 회원가입
	                        $scope.data.pntAgrmYn = 'Y';
	                        $commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({ ci: $scope.data.ciVl, mbrNm: $scope.data.custNm, cmncCmDvcd: $scope.data.cmncCmDvcd, mbphArNo: $scope.data.mbphArNo, mbphOficNo: $scope.data.mbphOficNo, mbphEnNo: $scope.data.mbphEnNo }, { service: 'SMbrMang', operation: 'createMbrForCi' }, null, null), function (data) {}, false).then(function (data) {});
	                        callback(true);
	                        return;
	                    }
	                }
	            }

	            function provMakeProv() {
	                var provCont = new Array();
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_01').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_01) + ', ');

	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_02').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_02) + ' (');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_02_01').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_02_01) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_02_02').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_02_02) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_02_03').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_02_03) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_02_04').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_02_04) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_02_05').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_02_05) + '), ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_03').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_03) + ' (');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_03_01').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_03_01) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_03_02').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_03_02) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_03_03').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_03_03) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_03_04').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_03_04) + '), ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_07').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_07) + ' (');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_07_01').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_07_01) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_07_02').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_07_02) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_07_03').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_07_03) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_07_04').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_07_04) + '), ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_06').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_06) + ' (');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_06_01').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_06_01) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_06_02').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_06_02) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_06_03').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_06_03) + ' (');
	                provCont.push('(전화=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_06_03_01) + ', SMS=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_06_03_02) + ')), ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_04').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_04) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_05').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_05) + ' (');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_05_01').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_05_01) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_05_02').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_05_02) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_05_03').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_05_03) + ' (');
	                provCont.push('(SMS=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_05_03_01) + ', 이메일=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_05_03_02) + ', 전화=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_05_03_03) + ', DM=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_05_03_04) + '))');

	                var reProvCont = provCont.join('');

	                return reProvCont.replace(/(\t|\s+\s|\n|\r\n)/g, '');
	            }

	            $scope.prov.init();
	        },
	        link: function link(scope, iElement, iAttrs) {

	            var labelWrap = $(iElement).find('.label-wrap');
	            labelWrap.on('click.toggle', function (e) {
	                this.classList.toggle("active");

	                var panel = this.nextElementSibling;
	                if (panel && panel.style) {
	                    if (panel.style.display === "block") {
	                        panel.style.display = "none";
	                    } else {
	                        panel.style.display = "block";
	                    }
	                }
	            });

	            $(".box-scroll").mCustomScrollbar({
	                theme: "my-theme",
	                setHeight: 265
	            });
	        }
	    };
	}

	            function provRadioAgreeFun(modelNm, val) {
	                console.log('provRadioAgreeFun', modelNm, val);

	                    } else if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_05') != -1) {
	                        $scope.agree_05Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_01, [val]);
	                        $scope.agree_05Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_02, [val]);
	                        $scope.agree_05Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_03, [val === 'N' ? '' : val]);

	                        $scope.data.agree_05_03_01 = val;
	                        $scope.data.agree_05_03_02 = val;
	                        $scope.data.agree_05_03_03 = val;
	                        $scope.data.agree_05_03_04 = val;
	                    } else if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_06') != -1) {
	                        $scope.agree_06Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_01, [val]);
	                        $scope.agree_06Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_02, [val]);

	                        $scope.agree_06Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_04, [val]);

	                        $scope.data.agree_06_03_01 = val;
	                        $scope.data.agree_06_03_02 = val;
	                    }

	                    var allYn = 'N';

	                    allYn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_01', 'agree_03', 'agree_04', 'agree_05', 'agree_06'], 'Y');

	                    var yn = allYn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                    $scope.data.agree_All = yn;
	                });

	            function provChoiceRadioFun(modelNm, val) {

	                            $scope.agree_06Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_04, [val]);

	                            $scope.data.agree_06_03_02 = val;

	                        var yn06 = a06Yn ? 'Y' : 'N';

	                    }

	                    $timeout(function () {
	                        // 데이타 바인딩 속도차로 지연시간 추가    					
	                        var allYn = 'N';
	                        allYn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_01', 'agree_03', 'agree_04', 'agree_05', 'agree_06'], 'Y');

	            function provItemCheckFun(modelNm, val, val2) {
	                $timeout(function () {
	                    if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_05') != -1) {
	                        if ($('input[name^=agree_05_03_0]:checked').length == 4) {
	                            $scope.agree_05Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_03, ['Y']);
	                            $scope.agree_05Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_01, ['Y']);
	                        } else if ($('input[name^=agree_05_03_0]:checked').length > 0) {
	                            $scope.agree_05Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_03, ['S']);
	                            $scope.agree_05Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_01, ['Y']);
	                        }

	                        $timeout(function () {
	                            // 데이타 바인딩 속도차로 지연시간 추가
	                            var a05Yn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_05_01', 'agree_05_02', 'agree_05_03'], ['Y', 'S']);
	                            var yn05 = a05Yn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                            $scope.agree_05Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data, [yn05]);

	                            $timeout(function () {
	                                // 데이타 바인딩 속도차로 지연시간 추가
	                                var allYn = 'N';
	                                if ($scope.saisdol) {
	                                    allYn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_01', 'agree_02', 'agree_03', 'agree_07', 'agree_04', 'agree_05', 'agree_06'], 'Y');
	                                } else {
	                                    allYn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_01', 'agree_02', 'agree_03', 'agree_04', 'agree_05', 'agree_06'], 'Y');
	                                }
	                                var yn = allYn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                                $scope.data.agree_All = yn;
	                            }, 100);
	                        }, 100);
	                    } else if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_06') != -1) {
	                        if ($('input[name^=agree_06_03_0]:checked').length == 2) {
	                            $scope.agree_06Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03, ['Y']);
	                            $scope.agree_06Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_02, ['Y']);
	                        } else if ($('input[name^=agree_06_03_0]:checked').length > 0) {
	                            $scope.agree_06Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03, ['S']);
	                            $scope.agree_06Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_02, ['Y']);
	                        }

	                        $timeout(function () {
	                            // 데이타 바인딩 속도차로 지연시간 추가
	                            var a06Yn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_06_01', 'agree_06_02', 'agree_06_03'], ['Y', 'S']);
	                            var yn06 = a06Yn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                            $scope.agree_06Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data, [yn06]);

	                            $timeout(function () {
	                                // 데이타 바인딩 속도차로 지연시간 추가
	                                var allYn = 'N';
	                                if ($scope.saisdol) {
	                                    allYn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_01', 'agree_02', 'agree_03', 'agree_07', 'agree_04', 'agree_05', 'agree_06'], 'Y');
	                                } else {
	                                    allYn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_01', 'agree_02', 'agree_03', 'agree_04', 'agree_05', 'agree_06'], 'Y');
	                                }
	                                var yn = allYn ? 'Y' : 'N';

	            function provItemPopClick(code, title, e) {
	                e.preventDefault();
	                e.stopImmediatePropagation();
	                $popupService.cmnPopProv($scope, { code: code, title: title }, function () {
	                    var yn = 'Y';
	                    if (code == '00001') {
	                        // agree_01
	                        $scope.agree_01Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_01Data, [yn]);
	                    } else if (code == '00012') {
	                        // agree_03
	                        $scope.agree_03Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_03Data, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_03Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_03Data_01, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_03Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_03Data_02, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_03Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_03Data_03, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_03Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_03Data_04, [yn]);
	                    } else if (code == '00054') {
	                        // agree_06
	                        $scope.agree_06Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_06Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_01, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_06Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_02, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_06Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_06Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_04, [yn]);
	                    } else if (code == '00005') {
	                        // agree_04
	                        $scope.agree_04Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_04Data, [yn]);
	                    } else if (code == '00002') {
	                        // agree_05
	                        $scope.agree_05Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_05Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_01, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_05Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_02, [yn]);

	                        $scope.agree_05Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_04, [yn]);
	                    }

	                    $timeout(function () {
	                        // 데이타 바인딩 속도차로 지연시간 추가    					
	                        var allYn = 'N';
	                        allYn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_01', 'agree_03', 'agree_04', 'agree_05', 'agree_06'], 'Y');

	                        $scope.data.agree_All = yn;
	                    }, 100);
	                });
	            }

	            function provDoneCheck(callback) {
	                if ($scope.data.agree_01 != 'Y') {
	                    $utilService.openAlert('(주)오케이저축은행 서비스 이용약관에 동의해야 합니다.');
	                    callback(false);
	                    return;
	                }
	                if ($scope.data.agree_03 != 'Y') {
	                    $utilService.openAlert('개인(신용)정보 조회 동의서에 동의해야 합니다.');
	                    callback(false);
	                    return;
	                }
	                if (!$scope.data.agree_04) {
	                    $utilService.openAlert('대출거절 사유 고지요청을 선택해야 합니다.');
	                    callback(false);
	                    return;
	                }
	                if (!$scope.data.agree_05) {
	                    $utilService.openAlert('개인(신용)정보 수집 ㆍ이용 동의서(상품서비스 안내등)를 선택해야 합니다.');
	                    callback(false);
	                    return;
	                }
	                if ($scope.data.agree_05_03 == 'S') {
	                    if ($scope.data.agree_05_03_01 != 'Y' && $scope.data.agree_05_03_02 != 'Y' && $scope.data.agree_05_03_03 != 'Y' && $scope.data.agree_05_03_04 != 'Y') {
	                        $utilService.openAlert('상품서비스 안내 수단은 (SMS, 이메일, 전화, DM)중 한개는 필수로 선택해야 합니다.');
	                        callback(false);
	                        return;
	                    }
	                }
	                /* else if ($scope.data.agree_05_03 == 'N'){
	                	$utilService.openAlert('상품서비스 안내 수단은 (SMS, 이메일, 전화, DM)중 한개는 필수로 선택해야 합니다.');
	                	callback(false);
	                }*/

	                if ($scope.data.hasMbrCivl) {
	                    $scope.data.agree_06 = 'N';
	                    $scope.data.provCont = provMakeProv();
	                    $scope.data.pntAgrmYn = 'Y';
	                    callback(true);
	                    return;
	                } else {
	                    if (!$scope.data.agree_06) {
	                        $utilService.openAlert('OK멤버십 서비스 가입안내를 선택해야 합니다.');
	                        callback(false);
	                        return;
	                    } else if ($scope.data.agree_06 == 'N') {
	                        $popupService.cmnPopMbrDisAgree($scope, function (flag) {
	                            // OK멤버십 동의 팝업
	                            if (flag) {
	                                $scope.data.agree_06 = 'Y';
	                                $scope.data.agree_06_01 = 'Y';
	                                $scope.data.agree_06_02 = 'Y';
	                                $scope.data.agree_06_03 = 'Y';
	                                $scope.data.agree_06_03_01 = 'Y';
	                                $scope.data.agree_06_03_02 = 'Y';
	                                $scope.data.agree_06_04 = 'Y';

	                                $scope.agree_06Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data, 'Y');
	                                $scope.agree_06Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_01, 'Y');
	                                $scope.agree_06Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_02, 'Y');
	                                $scope.agree_06Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03, 'Y');
	                                $scope.agree_06Data_03_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03_01, 'Y');
	                                $scope.agree_06Data_03_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03_02, 'Y');
	                                $scope.agree_06Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_04, 'Y');

	                                // CI 회원가입
	                                $scope.data.pntAgrmYn = 'Y';
	                                $commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({ ci: $scope.data.ciVl, mbrNm: $scope.data.custNm, cmncCmDvcd: $scope.data.cmncCmDvcd, mbphArNo: $scope.data.mbphArNo, mbphOficNo: $scope.data.mbphOficNo, mbphEnNo: $scope.data.mbphEnNo }, { service: 'SMbrMang', operation: 'createMbrForCi' }, null, null), function (data) {}, false).then(function (data) {});
	                            }
	                            $scope.data.provCont = provMakeProv();

	                            callback(true);
	                            return;
	                        });
	                    } else {
	                        $scope.data.provCont = provMakeProv();
	                        // CI 회원가입
	                        $scope.data.pntAgrmYn = 'Y';
	                        $commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({ ci: $scope.data.ciVl, mbrNm: $scope.data.custNm, cmncCmDvcd: $scope.data.cmncCmDvcd, mbphArNo: $scope.data.mbphArNo, mbphOficNo: $scope.data.mbphOficNo, mbphEnNo: $scope.data.mbphEnNo }, { service: 'SMbrMang', operation: 'createMbrForCi' }, null, null), function (data) {}, false).then(function (data) {});
	                        callback(true);
	                        return;
	                    }
	                }
	            }

	            function provMakeProv() {
	                var provCont = new Array();
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_01').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_01) + ', ');

	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_03').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_03) + ' (');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_03_01').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_03_01) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_03_02').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_03_02) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_03_03').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_03_03) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_03_04').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_03_04) + '), ');

	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_06').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_06) + ' (');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_06_01').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_06_01) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_06_02').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_06_02) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_06_03').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_06_03) + ' (');
	                provCont.push('(전화=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_06_03_01) + ', SMS=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_06_03_02) + ')), ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_04').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_04) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_05').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_05) + ' (');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_05_01').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_05_01) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_05_02').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_05_02) + ', ');
	                provCont.push($('#title_agree_05_03').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_05_03) + ' (');
	                provCont.push('(SMS=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_05_03_01) + ', 이메일=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_05_03_02) + ', 전화=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_05_03_03) + ', DM=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_05_03_04) + '))');

	                var reProvCont = provCont.join('');

	                return reProvCont.replace(/(\t|\s+\s|\n|\r\n)/g, '');
	            }

	            $scope.prov.init();
	        },
	        link: function link(scope, iElement, iAttrs) {

	            var labelWrap = $(iElement).find('.label-wrap');
	            labelWrap.on('click.toggle', function (e) {
	                this.classList.toggle("active");

	                var panel = this.nextElementSibling;
	                if (panel && panel.style) {
	                    if (panel.style.display === "block") {
	                        panel.style.display = "none";
	                    } else {
	                        panel.style.display = "block";
	                    }
	                }
	            });

	            $(".box-scroll").mCustomScrollbar({
	                theme: "my-theme",
	                setHeight: 265
	            });
	        }
	    };
	}

	            function provCheckAgreeAll(modelNm, val) {

	                    $scope.agree_05Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_04, [yn]);
	                    $scope.agree_05Data_04_ = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_04_, [yn]);

	                    $scope.data.agree_05_04_01 = yn;
	                    $scope.data.agree_05_04_02 = yn;

	                    $scope.agree_06Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data, [yn]);
	                    $scope.agree_06Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_01, [yn]);
	                    $scope.agree_06Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_02, [yn]);
	                    $scope.agree_06Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03, [yn]);
	                    $scope.agree_06Data_03_ = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03_, [yn]);
	                    $scope.agree_06Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_04, [yn]);

	                    $scope.data.agree_06_03_01 = yn;
	                    $scope.data.agree_06_03_02 = yn;

	                    $scope.agree_08Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_08Data, [yn]); //개인정보 수집ㆍ이용 제공동의서(신용보증재단 용)
	                    $scope.agree_08Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_08Data_01, [yn]);
	                    $scope.agree_08Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_08Data_02, [yn]);
	                    $scope.agree_08Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_08Data_03, [yn]);
	                    $scope.agree_08Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_08Data_04, [yn]);
	                    $scope.agree_08Data_05 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_08Data_05, [yn]);
	                    $scope.agree_08Data_06 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_08Data_06, [yn]);
	                    $scope.agree_08Data_07 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_08Data_07, [yn]);

	                    $scope.agree_09Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_09Data, [yn]); //대출모집업무에 관한 동의사항
	                });
	            }

	            function provRadioAgreeFun(modelNm, val) {
	                console.log('provRadioAgreeFun', modelNm, val);
	                $timeout(function () {
	                    $scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data'] = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data'], [val]);

	                    if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_02') != -1) {
	                        $scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_01'] = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_01'], [val]);
	                        $scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_02'] = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_02'], [val]);
	                        $scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_03'] = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_03'], [val]);
	                        $scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_04'] = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_04'], [val]);
	                        $scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_05'] = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_05'], [val]);
	                    } else if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_03') != -1 || modelNm.indexOf('agree_07') != -1) {
	                        $scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_01'] = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_01'], [val]);
	                        $scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_02'] = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_02'], [val]);
	                        $scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_03'] = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_03'], [val]);
	                        $scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_04'] = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_04'], [val]);
	                    } else if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_08') != -1) {
	                        $scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_01'] = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_01'], [val]);
	                        $scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_02'] = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_02'], [val]);
	                        $scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_03'] = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_03'], [val]);
	                        $scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_04'] = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_04'], [val]);
	                        $scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_05'] = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_05'], [val]);
	                        $scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_06'] = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_06'], [val]);
	                        $scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_07'] = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope[modelNm.substring(modelNm.indexOf('.') + 1) + 'Data_07'], [val]);
	                    } else if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_05') != -1) {
	                        $scope.agree_05Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_01, [val]);
	                        $scope.agree_05Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_02, [val]);
	                        $scope.agree_05Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_03, [val === 'N' ? '' : val]);
	                        $scope.agree_05Data_03_ = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_03_, [val]);

	                        $scope.data.agree_05_03_01 = val;
	                        $scope.data.agree_05_03_02 = val;
	                        $scope.data.agree_05_03_03 = val;
	                        $scope.data.agree_05_03_04 = val;

	                        $scope.agree_05Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_04, [val === 'N' ? '' : val]);
	                        $scope.agree_05Data_04_ = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_04_, [val]);

	                        $scope.data.agree_05_04_01 = val;
	                        $scope.data.agree_05_04_02 = val;
	                    } else if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_06') != -1) {
	                        $scope.agree_06Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_01, [val]);
	                        $scope.agree_06Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_02, [val]);
	                        $scope.agree_06Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03, [val === 'N' ? '' : val]);
	                        $scope.agree_06Data_03_ = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03_, [val === 'N' ? '' : val]);
	                        $scope.agree_06Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_04, [val]);

	                        $scope.data.agree_06_03_01 = val;
	                        $scope.data.agree_06_03_02 = val;
	                    }

	                    var allYn = 'N';
	                    if ($scope.useAgree02) {
	                        allYn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_01', 'agree_02', 'agree_03', 'agree_07', 'agree_06', 'agree_04', 'agree_05', 'agree_09'], 'Y'); //신용, 사잇돌
	                    } else if ($scope.useAgree06) {
	                        allYn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_01', 'agree_03', 'agree_08', 'agree_06', 'agree_04', 'agree_05', 'agree_09'], 'Y'); //햇살
	                    } else if ($scope.useAgree04) {
	                        allYn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_01', 'agree_02', 'agree_03', 'agree_06', 'agree_04', 'agree_05', 'agree_09'], 'Y'); //오토
	                    }

	                    var yn = allYn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                    $scope.data.agree_All = yn;
	                });
	            }

	                        $scope.agree_06Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data, [yn06]);
	                    }

	                        // 데이타 바인딩 속도차로 지연시간 추가

	                        }
	                        var yn = allYn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                        $scope.data.agree_All = yn;
	                    }, 100);
	                });
	            }

	            function provItemCheckFun(modelNm, val, val2) {
	                $timeout(function () {
	                    if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_05') != -1) {
	                        if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_05_03') != -1) {
	                            if ($('input[name^=agree_05_03_0]:checked').length == 4) {
	                                $scope.agree_05Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_03, ['Y']);
	                                $scope.agree_05Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_01, ['Y']);
	                            } else if ($('input[name^=agree_05_03_0]:checked').length > 0) {
	                                $scope.agree_05Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_03, ['S']);
	                                $scope.agree_05Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_01, ['Y']);
	                            }
	                        }

	                        if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_05_03') != -1) {
	                            if ($('input[name^=agree_05_04_0]:checked').length == 2) {
	                                $scope.agree_05Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_04, ['Y']);
	                            } else if ($('input[name^=agree_05_04_0]:checked').length > 0) {
	                                $scope.agree_05Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data_04, ['S']);
	                            }
	                        }

	                        $timeout(function () {
	                            // 데이타 바인딩 속도차로 지연시간 추가
	                            var a05Yn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_05_01', 'agree_05_02', 'agree_05_03', 'agree_05_04'], ['Y', 'S']);
	                            var yn05 = a05Yn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                            $scope.agree_05Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_05Data, [yn05]);

	                            $timeout(function () {
	                                // 데이타 바인딩 속도차로 지연시간 추가
	                                var allYn = 'N';
	                                if ($scope.useAgree02) {
	                                    allYn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_01', 'agree_02', 'agree_03', 'agree_07', 'agree_06', 'agree_04', 'agree_05', 'agree_09'], 'Y'); //신용, 사잇돌
	                                } else if ($scope.useAgree06) {
	                                    allYn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_01', 'agree_03', 'agree_08', 'agree_06', 'agree_04', 'agree_05', 'agree_09'], 'Y'); //햇살
	                                } else if ($scope.useAgree04) {
	                                    allYn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_01', 'agree_02', 'agree_03', 'agree_06', 'agree_04', 'agree_05', 'agree_09'], 'Y'); //오토
	                                }
	                                var yn = allYn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                                $scope.data.agree_All = yn;
	                            }, 100);
	                        }, 100);
	                    } else if (modelNm.indexOf('agree_06') != -1) {
	                        if ($('input[name^=agree_06_03_0]:checked').length == 2) {
	                            $scope.agree_06Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03, ['Y']);
	                            $scope.agree_06Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_02, ['Y']);
	                        } else if ($('input[name^=agree_06_03_0]:checked').length > 0) {
	                            $scope.agree_06Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03, ['S']);
	                            $scope.agree_06Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_02, ['Y']);
	                        }

	                        $timeout(function () {
	                            // 데이타 바인딩 속도차로 지연시간 추가
	                            var a06Yn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_06_01', 'agree_06_02', 'agree_06_03', 'agree_06_04'], ['Y', 'S']);
	                            var yn06 = a06Yn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                            $scope.agree_06Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data, [yn06]);

	                            $timeout(function () {
	                                // 데이타 바인딩 속도차로 지연시간 추가
	                                var allYn = 'N';
	                                if ($scope.useAgree02) {
	                                    allYn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_01', 'agree_02', 'agree_03', 'agree_07', 'agree_06', 'agree_04', 'agree_05', 'agree_09'], 'Y'); //신용, 사잇돌
	                                } else if ($scope.useAgree06) {
	                                    allYn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_01', 'agree_03', 'agree_08', 'agree_06', 'agree_04', 'agree_05', 'agree_09'], 'Y'); //햇살
	                                } else if ($scope.useAgree04) {
	                                    allYn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_01', 'agree_02', 'agree_03', 'agree_06', 'agree_04', 'agree_05', 'agree_09'], 'Y'); //오토
	                                }
	                                var yn = allYn ? 'Y' : 'N';
	                                $scope.data.agree_All = yn;
	                            }, 100);
	                        }, 100);

	                });

	            function provItemPopClick(code, title, e) {
	                e.preventDefault();
	                e.stopImmediatePropagation();
	                $popupService.cmnPopProv($scope, { code: code, title: title }, function () {
	                    var yn = 'Y';
	                    if (code == '00001') {
	                        // agree_01
	                        $scope.agree_01Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_01Data, [yn]);
	                    } else if (code == '00015') {
	                        // agree_02
	                        $scope.agree_02Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_02Data, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_02Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_02Data_01, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_02Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_02Data_02, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_02Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_02Data_03, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_02Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_02Data_04, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_02Data_05 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_02Data_05, [yn]);
	                    } else if (code == '00012') {
	                        // agree_03
	                        $scope.agree_03Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_03Data, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_03Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_03Data_01, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_03Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_03Data_02, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_03Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_03Data_03, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_03Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_03Data_04, [yn]);
	                    } else if (code == '00064') {
	                        // agree_07
	                        $scope.agree_07Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_07Data, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_07Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_07Data_01, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_07Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_07Data_02, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_07Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_07Data_03, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_07Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_07Data_04, [yn]);
	                    } else if (code == '00054') {
	                        // agree_06
	                        $scope.agree_06Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_06Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_01, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_06Data_02 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_02, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_06Data_03 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_06Data_03_ = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_03_, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_06Data_04 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_06Data_04, [yn]);
	                    } else if (code == '00005') {
	                        // agree_04
	                        $scope.agree_04Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_04Data, [yn]);
	                    } else if (code == '00062') {
	                        // agree_08
	                        $scope.agree_08Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_08Data, [yn]);
	                        $scope.agree_08Data_01 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_08Data_01, [yn]);

/***/ "./common/rsrhDirective/rsrh_directive.js":
/*!************************************************!*\

MATCHED_DEFINITION_PATTERNS=["getJson\\s*=\\s*function"]

/***/ function(module, exports, __webpack_require__) {

	'use strict';

	var _typeof2 = __webpack_require__(/*! babel-runtime/helpers/typeof */ "../../node_modules/babel-runtime/helpers/typeof.js");

	var _typeof3 = _interopRequireDefault(_typeof2);

	function _interopRequireDefault(obj) { return obj && obj.__esModule ? obj : { default: obj }; }

	var md = __webpack_require__(/*! ../../app_module */ "./app_module.js");

	md.service('$utilService', __service);

	function __service($dateUtil, $operationUtil, $state, $stateParams, $cmnUtil, $timeout, $rootScope, $sce, $compile, $location, httpHeader, $window, $sessionStorageService) {

		var $utilService = this;

		$utilService.go = function (path, param, $scope, callback) {
			console.log("path =========== ", path);
			if (path == "/mbrPntMallLanding") {
				$utilService.openAlert("포인트몰 점검중입니다.\n이용에 불편드려 죄송합니다.");
				return;
			}

			param = param ? param : {};
			$timeout(function () {

				if (path.indexOf('/') === 0) {
					// URL 접근
					if (path.indexOf($location.$$path) === 0) {
						$location.path(path, false).search(param);
						if ($scope) {
							$scope.$on('$locationChangeSuccess', function () {
								if (path.indexOf($location.$$path) === 0) {
									if (typeof callback === 'function') {
										var isCallback = false;
										$.each($location.$$search, function (key) {
											if ($location.$$search[key] != $scope.data[key]) {
												isCallback = true;
											}
										});

										if (isCallback) {
											$.extend($scope.data, $location.$$search);
											callback();
										}
									}
								}
							});
						}
					} else {
						$location.path(path).search(param);
					}
				} else {
					// WRAP 접근
					if (path.indexOf('wrap.conts') == 0) {
						var isSwitch = !param.isNotSwitch;
						if (isSwitch) {
							var pageSeq = path.replace('wrap.conts', '');
							if ($state.current.name.indexOf('wrap.auto') == 0) {
								// 오토 통합한도조회 접근
								path = 'wrap.auto' + pageSeq;
							} else if ($state.current.name.indexOf('wrap.sdst') == 0) {
								// 오토 통합한도조회 접근
								path = 'wrap.sdst' + pageSeq;
							} else if ($state.current.name.indexOf('wrap.snsn') == 0) {
								// 오토 통합한도조회 접근
								path = 'wrap.snsn' + pageSeq;
							}
						}
						$state.go(path, { params: param });
					} else {
						$state.go(path, { params: param });
					}
				}
			});
		};

		$utilService.getServerDate = function () {
			return $sessionStorageService.get('serverDate') ? $sessionStorageService.get('serverDate') : '';
		};

		$utilService.isMobile = function () {
			console.log('isMobile===========>', navigator.userAgent);
			var mobileArry = ['iPhone', 'iPod', 'BlackBerry', 'Android', 'Windows CE', 'LG', 'MOT', 'SAMSUNG', 'SonyEricsson', 'opera min', 'webos', 'nokia', 'opera mobi', 'iemobile'];
			for (var div in mobileArry) {
				if (navigator.userAgent.match(mobileArry[div]) != null) {
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		};

		$utilService.getParamVal = function (param, skipParam) {
			skipParam = !skipParam ? 'totalCount' : skipParam + ',totalCount';

			if ($location.$$search) {
				if (typeof param === 'boolean' && param) {
					if (skipParam && typeof skipParam === 'string') {
						var params = {};
						skipParam = ',' + skipParam;
						$.each($location.$$search, function (key) {
							if (skipParam.indexOf("," + key) === -1) {
								params[key] = $location.$$search[key];
							}
						});
						return params;
					} else {
						return $location.$$search;
					}
				} else {
					var value = $location.$$search[param];

					if (!value && $location.$$absUrl) {
						var paramStr = /[^/#/]*/.exec(/[^?]*$/.exec($location.$$absUrl)[0])[0];
						if (paramStr && paramStr.indexOf('http') != 0) {
							var value = '';
							paramStr.split('&').map(function (val) {
								var valArray = val.split('=');
								if (param == valArray[0]) {
									try {
										value = decodeURIComponent(valArray[1]);
									} catch (e) {
										value = valArray[1];
									}
									return false;
								}
							});
						}
					}
					return value;
				}
			} else {
				return '';
			}
		};

		/**
	  * 아코디언 생성
	  */
		$utilService.createAccordion = function (obj, data, option) {
			var defaultOption = {
				items: data,
				collapsible: true,
				active: 0,
				animate: 200,
				event: "click",
				stateOptions: {
					key: 'id',
					expire: true,
					fold: true

				},
				onActivate: function onActivate(e, ui) {
					console.log('onActivate====================');
				},
				onSelected: function onSelected(e, a) {
					console.log('onSELECTED ============================== ');
				},
				onRender: function onRender(e, ui) {
					var $container = this.$container;
					$.each($container.find('span.leafMenu').parent(), function () {
						$(this).click(function (e) {
							e.preventDefault();
							console.log('', $(this).find('span.leafMenu').data('path'));
							console.log('', $(this).find('span.leafMenu').attr('id'));
							console.log('', $(this).find('span.leafMenu').text());

							if ($(this).parents('ul').length == 1) {
								$(this).parents('ul:eq(0)').children('li').not('.has-children,.opened').children('a').css('color', '');
								$(this).parents('ul:eq(0)').children('li.has-children').find('ul').find('a').css('color', '');
								$(this).parents('ul:eq(0)').children('li.opened').children('a').trigger('click');
							} else {
								$(this).parent().siblings().children('a').css('color', '');
								$(this).parents('ul:eq(0)').parent().siblings().children('a').css('color', '');
							}
							$(this).css('color', '#ea5406');

							if ($(this).find('span.leafMenu').data('path')) {
								$utilService.menuTitle = $(this).find('span.leafMenu').text();
								$utilService.go($(this).find('span.leafMenu').data('path'));
							}
						});
					});
				}
			};
			$.extend(defaultOption, option);

			if (obj && data) {
				obj.bxAccordion(defaultOption).render();
			}
		};

		/**
	  *앵귤러 text -> html로 출력 
	  */
		$utilService.getTextToHtml = function (value) {
			if (value) {
				value = $sce.trustAsHtml(value);
			}
			return value;
		};

		/**
	  * 페이지 로딩시 호출해야 할 스크립트 삽입 
	  */
		$utilService.setScript = function (value, time) {
			time = time ? time : 0;

			var defaultOption = {
				width: 400,
				confirmText: '확인',
				dimStyle: { color: 'clear' }
			};

			var nowDate = new Date().getMilliseconds();

			if (value) {
				$timeout(function () {
					var html = [];
					html.push('<script id="' + nowDate + '">');
					html.push('try { ');
					html.push(value);
					html.push(' }catch(e){');
					html.push('		$().bxDialog("' + defaultOption + '").alert({title : "알람",content : "스크립트 오류입니다!"});');
					html.push('}');
					html.push('</script>');
					$rootScope['script'] = html.join('');
				}, time);
			}
		};

		/**
	  * scope 변수을 초기화 한다.
	  */
		$utilService.clearParam = function (scopeParam, skipParam) {
			var flag = true;
			if (scopeParam) {
				$timeout(function () {
					switch (typeof scopeParam === 'undefined' ? 'undefined' : (0, _typeof3.default)(scopeParam)) {
						case 'object':
							if (skipParam) skipParam = ',' + skipParam;
							if (scopeParam instanceof Array == false) {
								$.each(scopeParam, function (key) {
									if (skipParam && skipParam.indexOf(',' + key) != -1) {
										flag = false;
									} else {
										flag = true;
									}
									if (flag) {
										switch ((0, _typeof3.default)(scopeParam[key])) {
											case 'object':
												if (scopeParam[key] instanceof Array) {
													scopeParam[key] = [];
												} else {
													scopeParam[key] = {};
												}
												break;
											case 'number':
												scopeParam[key] = 0;
												break;
											case 'string':
												scopeParam[key] = '';
												break;
											default:
												scopeParam[key] = null;
										}
									}
								});
							} else {
								scopeParam = [];
							}
							break;
						case 'number':
							scopeParam = 0;
							break;
						case 'string':
							scopeParam = '';
							break;
						default:
							scopeParam = null;
					}
				});
			}
		};

		$utilService.setAllMenuReLoadFun = function (callFun) {
			$rootScope.menuReLoadFun = $rootScope.menuReLoadFun ? $rootScope.menuReLoadFun : {};
			if (typeof callFun === 'function') {
				$rootScope.menuReLoadFun[$cmnUtil.getUUid()] = callFun;
			}
		};

		$utilService.callAllMenuReLoadFun = function (toState, formState, location, toParam, fromParam) {
			$.each($rootScope.menuReLoadFun, function (key) {
				if (typeof $rootScope.menuReLoadFun[key] === 'function') {
					$rootScope.menuReLoadFun[key](toState, formState, location, toParam, fromParam);
				}
			});
		};

		$utilService.notEmptyHtmlCheck = function (url, callFun) {
			$.ajax({
				url: url,
				method: 'get',
				dataType: 'html',
				async: false,
				success: function success() {
					console.log('=======================success  notEmptyHtmlCheck==================');
					if (typeof callFun === 'function') callFun();
				},
				error: function error(err) {
					console.log('=======================error  notEmptyHtmlCheck==================', err);
					$utilService.go(!$state.current.url.indexOf('/lon/') == 0 ? '/' + err.status : '/lon/' + err.status);
				}
			});
		};
