		//컬럼에 같은 데이터는 머지 시켜서 표현 테이블 구조로 생성
		$utilService.createDataMergeTabel = function (obj, data, options) {
			if (obj && data && data instanceof Array == true) {
				if (!obj.find('tbody').length) {
					obj.append('<tbody></tbody>');
				} else {
					obj.find('tbody').html('');
				}

				var defaultOptions = {
					trAttr: {}, //tr에 대한 속성 정의
					mergeCol: '', //병합할 컬럼 정의
					noMerge: false, //병합 여부
					numberViewFlag: false, //번호 보여줄지 여부
					tdAttr: {} //td에 대한 속성 정의
				};

				options = $.extend(true, defaultOptions, options);

				var rowPreDataMap = {};
				var colNmSort = {};
				var colCnt = 0;
				var trHtml = [];

				$.each(data, function (idx) {
					var colNmSortArray = [];
					var mergeFlag = true;

					trHtml = [];
					trHtml.push('<tr>');
					if (options.numberViewFlag) {
						trHtml.push('<td>' + (obj.find('tbody').find('tr').length + 1) + '</td>');
					}
					//행정의
					$.each(data[idx], function (key) {

						if (options['mergeCol']) {
							if ((',' + options['mergeCol']).indexOf(',' + key) === -1) {
								mergeFlag = false;
							}
						}

						if (mergeFlag && !options['noMerge']) {
							colNmSort[key] = colNmSortArray.length;
							colNmSortArray.push(key);

							if (rowPreDataMap[key]) {
								if (!rowPreDataMap[key]['value'] || rowPreDataMap[key]['value'] !== $.trim(data[idx][key])) {
									trHtml.push('<td class="' + key + '">');
									trHtml.push(data[idx][key]);
									trHtml.push('</td>');
									if (colNmSortArray.length > 1) {
										var preColNm = colNmSortArray[colNmSort[key] - 1];
										if (rowPreDataMap[preColNm]['cnt'] > 1) {
											rowPreDataMap[key] = { trIdx: idx, value: $.trim(data[idx][key]), cnt: 1 };
										} else {
											rowPreDataMap[key] = { trIdx: idx, value: $.trim(data[idx][key]), cnt: 1 };
										}
									} else {
										rowPreDataMap[key] = { trIdx: idx, value: $.trim(data[idx][key]), cnt: 1 };
									}
								} else {
									rowPreDataMap[key]['cnt'] = rowPreDataMap[key]['cnt'] + 1;
									if (rowPreDataMap[key]['cnt'] > 1) {
										obj.find('tbody tr').eq(rowPreDataMap[key]['trIdx']).find('.' + key).attr('rowspan', rowPreDataMap[key]['cnt']);
									} else {
										trHtml.push('<td class="' + key + '">');
										trHtml.push(data[idx][key]);
										trHtml.push('</td>');
										rowPreDataMap[key] = { trIdx: idx, value: $.trim(data[idx][key]), cnt: 1 };
									}
								}
							} else {
								rowPreDataMap[key] = { trIdx: idx, value: $.trim(data[idx][key]), cnt: 1 };
								trHtml.push('<td class="' + key + '">');
								trHtml.push(data[idx][key]);
								trHtml.push('</td>');
							}
						} else {
							trHtml.push('<td class="' + key + '">');
							trHtml.push(data[idx][key]);
							trHtml.push('</td>');
						}

						if (idx == 0) colCnt++;
					});

					trHtml.push('</tr>');
					obj.find('tbody').append(trHtml.join(''));
				});

				if (!options['noMerge']) {
					//열정의 rowspan영역이 아닌 row만 colspan정의
					$.each(obj.find('tbody').find('tr'), function (idx) {
						var mergeFlag = true;
						var trObj = obj.find('tbody').find('tr').eq(idx);
						console.log(obj.find('tbody').find('tr').eq(idx).find('td').length, colCnt);
						if (trObj.find('td').length === colCnt) {
							var colDataArray = [];
							var colValueKey = {};

							$.each(data[idx], function (key) {
								if (options['mergeCol']) {
									if ((',' + options['mergeCol']).indexOf(',' + key) === -1) {
										mergeFlag = false;
									}
								}

								if (mergeFlag) {
									colDataArray.push({ 'key': key, value: $.trim(data[idx][key]), 'cnt': 1 });
									if ($.trim(data[idx][key])) {
										if (colValueKey[$.trim(data[idx][key])]) {
											$.each(colDataArray, function (colIdx) {
												if (colDataArray[colDataArray.length - 2]['value'] === $.trim(data[idx][key])) {
													if (colDataArray[colIdx]['key'] === colValueKey[$.trim(data[idx][key])]) {
														colDataArray[colIdx]['cnt'] = colDataArray[colIdx]['cnt'] + 1;
													};
												}
											});
										} else {
											colValueKey[$.trim(data[idx][key])] = key;
										}
									}
								}
							});

							$.each(colDataArray, function (colIdx) {
								if (colDataArray[colIdx]['cnt'] > 1) {
									if (typeof trObj.find('.' + colDataArray[colIdx]['key']).attr('rowspan') === 'undefined') {
										trObj.find('.' + colDataArray[colIdx]['key']).attr('colspan', colDataArray[colIdx]['cnt']);
										var tdIdx = trObj.find('td').index(trObj.find('.' + colDataArray[colIdx]['key']));
										for (var i = 1; i < colDataArray[colIdx]['cnt']; i++) {
											trObj.find('td').eq(tdIdx + 1).remove();
										}
									}
								}
							});
						}
					});
				}

				if (data && data.length) {
					//tr에 대한 attr 설정
					$.each(options.trAttr, function (key) {
						$.each(options.trAttr[key], function (key2) {
							obj.find('tbody').find('tr').eq(key).attr(key2, options.trAttr[key][key2]);
						});
					});

					//td에 대한 attr 설정
					$.each(options.tdAttr, function (key) {
						$.each(options.tdAttr[key], function (key2) {
							obj.find('tbody').find('.' + key).attr(key2, options.tdAttr[key][key2]);
						});
					});
				}
			}
		};

		$utilService.isOutWhsnSqnoCheck = function (encodeStr, beforeOutWhsnSqno, afterOutWhshSqno) {
			var decOutWhshSqno = $cmnUtil.getNumberDecode(encodeStr, beforeOutWhsnSqno);
			return isNaN(decOutWhshSqno) || decOutWhshSqno == afterOutWhshSqno;
		};

		$utilService.isCnfmPwCheck = function (encodeStr, inputPw) {
			if (location.hostname === 'localhost') {
				return encodeStr == inputPw;
			} else {
				return $cmnUtil.getNumberEncode(inputPw) == encodeStr;
			}
			//return $cmnUtil.getNumberDecode(encodeStr, inputPw) == inputPw;
			// TODO 점유인증 배포전 올려야될때 위 주석, 아래 주석해제
			//return encodeStr == inputPw;
		};

		$utilService.isInternetExpVer = function () {
			var expVerFlg = false;
			var rv = -1;

			if (navigator.appName == 'Microsoft Internet Explorer') {
				var ua = navigator.userAgent;

				var re = new RegExp("MSIE ([0-9]{1,}[\.0-9]{0,})");

				if (re.exec(ua) != null) rv = parseFloat(RegExp.$1);

				console.log('rv : ' + rv);

				if (10 > rv) {
					expVerFlg = true;
				}
			}

			return expVerFlg;
		};

		$utilService.isMirtHero = function (lonGdsCd) {
			//OK히어로(P700190078) OK히어로_마이너스(P700190070)
			//OK히어로J(P700190108) OK히어로J_마이너스(P700190109)
			// 2020.07.20 상품코드, 상품명 추가
			// 김한라대리 추가요청 - OK한도우대론K_마이너스(P700190140)
			// OK한도우대론(P700190137)
			// OK한도우대론K(P700190139)
			// 금리우대론(P700190148)
			// 금리우대론_마이너스(P700190149)
			if (lonGdsCd && (lonGdsCd == 'P700190078' || lonGdsCd == 'P700190108' || lonGdsCd == 'P700190137' || lonGdsCd == 'P700190139' || lonGdsCd == 'P700190140' || lonGdsCd == 'P700190148' || lonGdsCd == 'P700190149')) {
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		};

		// S : 히어로 사잇돌
		// 2020.07.20 상품코드, 상품명 추가
		// OK한도우대론S(P700190104)
		$utilService.isMirtHeroS = function (lonGdsCd) {
			if (lonGdsCd && (lonGdsCd == 'P700190091' || lonGdsCd == 'P700190104')) {
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		};

		//이자 반환 이자반환
		$utilService.amtToIntr = function (amt, rti, type) {
			type = type || 'day';
			amt = Number(String(amt || '0').replace(/[^0-9]/gi, ''));
			rti = Number(rti || '0');

			if (type == 'day') {
				//하루 이자
				return Math.floor(rti / 100 * amt / 365 / 10) * 10;
			} else {
				return amt;
			}
		};

		//OK한도우대론,OK금리대론
		$utilService.isGdsPrfTrt = function (lonGdsCd) {
			//Ok한도우대론, OK금리우대론
			return ['0201004013', '0201004014'].indexOf(lonGdsCd || '') > -1;
		};

		// 억원 반환 + 콤마 추가
		$utilService.currencyUckWon = function (value) {

			value = String(value || '0');

			if (value.length < 9) {
				return this.currencyMan(value) + "만원";
			} else {
				var money = parseInt(value.replace(/[^0-9]/gi, ''), 10);
				var calcVal = Math.floor(money / 100000000) + ""; //억 단위 이하 절사
				var twosandVal = value.substr(calcVal.length) > 0 ? this.currencyMan(value.substr(calcVal.length)) + "만원" : '';
				return calcVal.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ",") + "억 " + twosandVal;
			}
		};

		// 백만원단위 + 콤마 추가
		$utilService.currencyBackMan = function (value) {

			value = String(value || '0');

			if (value.length <= 6) {
				return '0';
			} else {
				var money = parseInt(value.replace(/[^0-9]/gi, ''), 10);
				value = Math.floor(money / 1000000) + ""; //만단위 이하 절사
				return value.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ",");
			}
		};

		// 만원단위 + 콤마 추가
		$utilService.currencyMan = function (value, inputYn) {

			value = String(value || '0');

			if (value.length <= 4 && inputYn !== 'Y') {
				return '0';
			} else {
				var divNum = inputYn === 'Y' ? 1 : 10000;
				var money = parseInt(value.replace(/[^0-9]/gi, ''), 10);
				if (isNaN(money)) {
					return '';
				}
				value = Math.floor(money / divNum) + ""; //만단위 이하 절사
				return value.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ",");
			}
		};

		//원단위 + 콤마 추가
		$utilService.currencyWon = function (value) {
			value = String(value || '0');

			var isMinus = value.startsWith('-');

			value = value.replace(/[^0-9]/gi, '');

			if (isMinus) {
				if (value) value = '-' + value;
			}

			if (!!value == false) {
				return '';
			}

			return value.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ",");
		};

		//원단위 + 콤마 추가
		$utilService.currencyKr = function (value) {
			var hanA = new Array("", "일", "이", "삼", "사", "오", "육", "칠", "팔", "구", "십");
			var danA = new Array("", "십", "백", "천", "", "십", "백", "천", "", "십", "백", "천", "", "십", "백", "천");
			var result = "";
			if (value) {
				for (i = 0; i < value.length; i++) {
					var str = "";
					var han = hanA[value.charAt(value.length - (i + 1))];
					if (han != "") str += han + danA[i];
					if (i == 4) str += "만";
					if (i == 8) str += "억";
					if (i == 12) str += "조";
					result = str + result;
				}
				if (value != 0) {
					result = result + "원";
				}

				return result;
			} else {
				return '0원';
			}
		};

		$utilService.dayToString = function (value) {

			if (isNaN(value)) return '';
			var tempValue = '';
			tempValue = value + '';
			return tempValue.length < 2 && tempValue.length > 0 ? '0' + tempValue : tempValue;
		};

		$utilService.objectNullToStr = function (obj) {
			if (obj) {
				if (typeof obj === 'string') {
					return $operationUtil.defaultEmpty(obj, '');
				} else if ((typeof obj === 'undefined' ? 'undefined' : (0, _typeof3.default)(obj)) === 'object') {
					if (obj instanceof Array) {
						$.each(obj, function (idx, value) {
							obj[idx] = $utilService.objectNullToStr(value);
						});
					} else {
						$.each(obj, function (key, value) {
							obj[key] = $utilService.objectNullToStr(value);
						});
					}

					return obj;
				} else {
					return obj;
				}
			} else {
				return obj;
			}
		};

		$utilService.getCdNm = function (value, codeArray) {
			var cdNm = '';
			if (codeArray instanceof Array) {
				if (codeArray.length) {
					var codeMap = codeArray.filter(function (map) {
						return map.value === value;
					})[0];
					if (codeMap) cdNm = codeMap.label || '';
				}
			}
			return cdNm || value || '';
		};

		$utilService.getLonGdsType = function (lonGdsCd) {
			if (!lonGdsCd || lonGdsCd.length < 4) return '';

			var checkType = lonGdsCd.substring(0, 4);
			var lonGdsType = 'crda';

			switch (checkType) {
				case '0201':
					//신용
					if (lonGdsCd === '0202001002') {
						//내집으로
						lonGdsType = 'myhs';
					} else if (lonGdsCd.substring(0, 7) === '0201004' || lonGdsCd.substring(0, 7) === '0201005') //중금리
						{
							lonGdsType = "minrt";
						}
					break;
				case '0203':
					lonGdsType = 'sdst';break; //사잇돌
				case '0204':
					lonGdsType = 'snsn';break; //햇살론
				case '0205':
					lonGdsType = 'auto';break; //오토
				default:
					if (lonGdsCd.substring(0, 7) === '0206001') {
						//주택
						lonGdsType = "hs";
					}
			}

			return lonGdsType;
		};

		//주부여부
		$utilService.isHouseWife = function (data) {
			data = data || {};

			if (!data.gndrDvcd || !data.amrcAge) return false;

			if (data.gndrDvcd === '1') return false;

			return data.amrcAge > 29;
		};

		//공적지원제도 팝업 여부 
		$utilService.getPblySuptIstiAgrmYn = function (rcvObjcDvcd, gdsCodeLst) {
			var pblySuptIstiAgrmYn = 'N';
			gdsCodeLst = gdsCodeLst || [];

			//접수대상구분코드 (00001 : 청년, 00002 : 고령자, 00003 : 꺾기, 00004: 50f00만원 이상)	
			if (rcvObjcDvcd === '00001') pblySuptIstiAgrmYn = 'Y';

			if (pblySuptIstiAgrmYn === 'Y' && gdsCodeLst.length) {
				//상품이 햇살론 또는 사잇돌만 있을 경우 공적지원제도 받지 않음
				if (gdsCodeLst.filter(function (gdsCodeDto) {
					return ['sdst', 'snsn'].indexOf(gdsCodeDto.lonGdsType) > -1;
				}).length == gdsCodeLst.length) {
					pblySuptIstiAgrmYn = 'N';
				}
			}
			return pblySuptIstiAgrmYn;
		};

		$utilService.parseNumber = function (val) {
			if (!val) return 0;

			val = Number(val.replace(/[^0-9]/gi, ''));

			if (isNaN(val)) {
				return 0;
			}

			return val;
		};

		//이메일 검증 서비스
		$utilService.domainChk = function (val) {
			var properDomain = ['kr', 'com', 'net', 'gov', 'mil', 'biz', 'io', 'co', 'me', 'org', 'info', 'ai', 'edu', 'im'];
			var emailPattern = /^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+@[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}$/;
			var parts = val.split("@");
			var domainName = parts[0];
			var domainPart = parts[1];
			// 도메인 주소 입력해야함
			if (!domainPart || domainPart.trim() === "") {
				return { valid: false, errMsg: "이메일 주소를 모두 입력해주세요" };
			}
			//도메인 최소기준
			if (!emailPattern.test(val)) {
				return { valid: false, errMsg: "이메일 주소가 올바르지 않아요" };
			}
			//도메인 최소기준
			if (/[-_.]{2,}/.test(val)) {
				return { valid: false, errMsg: "이메일 주소가 올바르지 않아요" };
			}
			//@는 한번만 입력이 가능해야 함 
			if (parts.length !== 2) {
				return { valid: false, errMsg: "이메일 주소가 올바르지 않아요" };
			} else {
				if (domainPart.indexOf('-') === 0 || domainPart.indexOf('.') === 0 || domainPart.indexOf('_') === 0) {
					return { valid: false, errMsg: "이메일 주소가 올바르지 않아요" };
				}
				var domainParts = domainPart.split('.');
				var domainExt = domainParts.pop();
				// 도메인 확장자 검증
				if (!properDomain.includes(domainExt.toLowerCase())) {
					return { valid: false, errMsg: "." + domainExt + "와 같은 주소는 사용할 수 없어요" };
				}
			}
			return { valid: true, errMsg: "" };
		};

		/**
	   * bsDate : 기준 시작일 , 종료일이 포함되는지 체크
	   * sDate : 시작일
	   * date2 : 종료일
	   */
		$utilService.isDateInRange = function (sDate, eDate, bsDate) {

			if ($operationUtil.isEmpty(sDate) || $operationUtil.isEmpty(eDate) || $operationUtil.isEmpty(bsDate)) {
				return false;
			}

			var datePattern = /^(19|20)\d\d-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])$/;

			if (!datePattern.test(sDate)) {
				if (/^[0-9]*$/.test(sDate) && sDate.length == 8) {
					sDate = this.chgDate(sDate);
				} else {
					return false;
				}
			}

			if (!datePattern.test(eDate)) {
				if (/^[0-9]*$/.test(eDate) && eDate.length == 8) {
					eDate = this.chgDate(eDate);
				} else {
					return false;
				}
			}

			if (!datePattern.test(bsDate)) {
				if (/^[0-9]*$/.test(bsDate) && bsDate.length == 8) {
					bsDate = this.chgDate(bsDate);
				} else {
					return false;
				}
			}

			return new Date(bsDate) >= new Date(sDate) && new Date(bsDate) <= new Date(eDate);
		};

		/**
	     * 은행코드 교정
	     * @memberOf $utilService
	     * @param bnkCd(은행코드), acno(계좌번호)
	     * @return rtnBankCd(은행코드)
	     */
		$utilService.correctBankCd = function (bankCd, acno) {

			if (!bankCd || !acno) {
				return bankCd;
			}

			var rtnBankCd = $utilService.lpad(bankCd, 5, '0');

			var correctFunc = correctRules(rtnBankCd);
			if (correctFunc && typeof correctFunc === 'function') {
				rtnBankCd = correctFunc(acno);
			}

			return rtnBankCd.slice(-bankCd.length);

			function correctRules(bankCd) {

				// NH농협은행_농협회원조합
				correctRules.NH = function (acno) {

					var retnBankCd = void 0;
					var accNo = acno;
					var accNoLen = (accNo || '').length;
					switch (accNoLen) {
						case 10:
							//농축협
							retnBankCd = '00012';
							break;
						case 11:
						case 12:
							//NH농협은행
							retnBankCd = '00011';
							break;
						case 13:
							// 앞자리 028인 경우 두개다 해당 됨.
							var fstTwoCntNum = accNo.substr(0, 2);
							var fstThrdNum = accNo.substr(2, 1);
							var lstNum = accNo.substr(accNoLen - 1, 1);
							if (['35', '38'].indexOf(fstTwoCntNum) > -1 && fstThrdNum != '9' || ['3', '4', '7', '9'].indexOf(lstNum) > -1) {
								//농축협
								retnBankCd = '00012';
							} else {
								//NH농협은행
								retnBankCd = '00011';
							}
							break;
						case 14:
							var fstThrdCntNum = accNo.substr(0, 3);
							var fstSxthCntNum = accNo.substr(6, 2);
							if (fstThrdCntNum == '792' || ['51', '52', '55', '56', '66', '67'].indexOf(fstSxthCntNum) > -1) {
								//농축협
								retnBankCd = '00012';
							} else {
								//NH농협은행
								retnBankCd = '00011';
							}
							break;
						default:
							retnBankCd = '00011';
					}
					return retnBankCd;
				};

				// 수협은행_수산업협동조합중앙회
				correctRules.SH = function (acno) {

					var rtnBankCd = void 0;
					var acnoLen = acno.length;

					switch (acnoLen) {

						// 11자리
						case 11:
							{
								// 030 - 4, 5번째 자리가 "43~45", "47", "49", "59", "61~64", "66~68", "74", "75", "78", "81~85", "93" 인 경우
								var rule030_4To5 = ['43', '44', '45', '47', '49', '59', '61', '62', '63', '64', '66', '67', '68', '74', '75', '78', '81', '82', '83', '84', '85', '93'];
								var acno4To5 = acno.substr(3, 2);

								if (rule030_4To5.includes(acno4To5)) {
									rtnBankCd = '00030';
								}

								break;
							}

						// 12자리
						case 12:
							{
								//  030 - 1번째 자리가 "2", "7", "9" 인 경우
								var rule030_1 = ['2', '7', '9'];
								var acno1 = acno.charAt(0);

								if (rule030_1.includes(acno1)) {
									rtnBankCd = '00030';
								}

								break;
							}

						// 14자리 
						case 14:
							{
								// 030 - 1, 2, 3번째 자리가 "481~489", "493" 인 경우
								var rule030_1To3 = ['481', '482', '483', '484', '485', '486', '487', '488', '489', '493'];
								var acno1To3 = acno.substr(0, 3);

								if (rule030_1To3.includes(acno1To3)) {
									rtnBankCd = '00030';
								}

								break;
							}

						default:

					}

					return rtnBankCd || '00007'; // 기본값 '00007' - 수협은행
				};

				var correctRuleMap = {
					'00011': correctRules.NH // NH농협은행_농협회원조합
					, '00012': correctRules.NH // NH농협은행_농협회원조합
					, '00007': correctRules.SH // 수협은행_수산업협동조합중앙회
					, '00030': correctRules.SH // 수협은행_수산업협동조합중앙회
				};

				return correctRuleMap[bankCd];
			};
		};

		$operationUtil.assign(this, $dateUtil, $operationUtil, $cmnUtil);
	}

	  function chkPacketPoisoning(configHeader, dataHeader) {

	  function callInDto(data) {
	    var isSetData = location.hostname === 'localhost' ? true : false;

	    if (!isSetData) {
	      return data;
	    }

	    data = JSON.parse(data);
	    data = data || { header: {}, data: {} };

	    try {
	      if (typeof eval(data.header.operation || '') === 'function') {
	        return (0, _stringify2.default)(eval(data.header.operation)('IN', data));
	      } else {
	        return (0, _stringify2.default)(data);
	      }
	    } catch (e) {
	      return (0, _stringify2.default)(data);
	    }
	  }

	  function callOutDto(data, inData) {
	    var isSetData = location.hostname === 'localhost' ? true : false;

	    if (!isSetData) {
	      return data;
	    }

	    data = data || { header: {} };

	    try {
	      if (!data.header.operation) {
	        inData = JSON.parse(inData);
	        data.header.operation = inData.header.operation;
	      }
	      if (typeof eval(data.header.operation || '') === 'function') {
	        return eval(data.header.operation)('OUT', data);
	      } else {
	        return data;
	      }
	    } catch (e) {
	      return data;
	    }
	  }
	}

/***/ "./common/contDirective/cont_ctrl_directive.js":
/*!*****************************************************!*\
  !*** ./common/contDirective/cont_ctrl_directive.js ***!
  \*****************************************************/
/***/ function(module, exports, __webpack_require__) {

	'use strict';

	var md = __webpack_require__(/*! ../../app_module */ "./app_module.js");

	md.directive('contCtrlDirective', __directive);

	function __directive(env, $rootScope, $compile, $timeout, $commonService, $utilService, $templateRequest) {
		return {
			replace: true,
			scope: false,
			restrict: 'EA',
			templateUrl: 'app/common/contDirective/cont_ctrl.tpl.html',
			controller: function controller($scope, $element, $attrs) {
				/*
	    *	routeState
	    *		ㄴ templateUrl	: 탬플릿 URL
	    *		ㄴ controller	: 컨트로러 이름
	    */
				$attrs.$observe('routeState', function (val) {
					if (val) {
						var routeState = angular.fromJson(val);
						var templateUrl = routeState['templateUrl'];
						var controller = routeState['controller'];

						$templateRequest(templateUrl, true).then(function (response) {
							if ($scope.$$destroyed) {
								return;
							}

							var dom = [];

							if (controller) {
								dom.push('<div ng-controller="' + controller + '">');
							} else {
								dom.push('<div>');
							}
							dom.push(response); // 탬플릿 HTML
							dom.push('</div>');

							$element.html(dom.join(''));
							$compile($element.contents())($scope);
						});
					}
				});
			}
		};
	}

	module.exports = md;

/***/ "./common/dynamicRoute/dynamic_route_provider.js":
/*!*******************************************************!*\
  !*** ./common/dynamicRoute/dynamic_route_provider.js ***!
  \*******************************************************/
/***/ function(module, exports, __webpack_require__) {

	'use strict';

	var _getOwnPropertyNames = __webpack_require__(/*! babel-runtime/core-js/object/get-own-property-names */ "../../node_modules/babel-runtime/core-js/object/get-own-property-names.js");

	var _getOwnPropertyNames2 = _interopRequireDefault(_getOwnPropertyNames);

	function _interopRequireDefault(obj) { return obj && obj.__esModule ? obj : { default: obj }; }

	var md = __webpack_require__(/*! ../../app_module */ "./app_module.js");

	/**
	 * 참고 사항
	 *
	 * - config 단계 (app.config)에서 provider를 주입받을 경우, suffix로 Provider를 사용한다.
	 *   (ex. httpHeaderConfig -> httpHeaderConfigProvider)
	 * - 앱 기동 후, (app.run 이후) provider를 주입받을 경우, provider 명칭 그대로 사용한다.
	 *   (ex. httpHeaderConfig -> httpHeaderConfig)
	 * - 하위 프로바이더는 route 에 대해서 등록하는 부분이므로 반드시 config 에서 작성한다.
	 */
	md.provider('dynamicRoute', __provider);

	/* @ngInject */
	function __provider() {

	    var self = this;

	    self.data = {
	        requestUrl: '',
	        header: {}
	    };

	    /*
	     * route 정보 반환 함수.
	     * jquery ajax sync 속성을 통해 동기식으로 해당 데이터를 가져온다.
	     * 서버가 다른 경우 경로는 build.config 내부 proxyPattern 을 사용.
	     * 아래 예제는 localhost 를 이용해 상대 url 로 작성함.
	     * 아래 소스 코드에 대한 method 및 url 변경시 setting 에 대한 부분이 변경되어야 한다.
	     * */
	    function _requestRouteObjectUsingSync() {

	        var result;

	        $.ajax({
	            url: self.data.requestUrl,
	            method: 'post',
	            contentType: 'application/json',
	            dataType: 'json',
	            data: angular.toJson({
	                'header': self.data.header,
	                'data': { 'userAgent': navigator.userAgent }
	            }),
	            async: false,
	            success: function success(data) {
	                result = {};
	                console.log('--------------- ', data);
	                if (data) {
	                    data = angular.fromJson(data);
	                    if (data.SMaRouteInfo01OutDto && data.SMaRouteInfo01OutDto.sub) {
	                        var dataArray = data.SMaRouteInfo01OutDto.sub;
	                        $.each(dataArray, function (idx) {
	                            result[dataArray[idx].routeKey] = { params: { params: null } };
	                            $.each(dataArray[idx], function (key) {
	                                if ('routeKey' != key) {
	                                    result[dataArray[idx].routeKey][key] = dataArray[idx][key];
	                                }
	                            });
	                        });
	                    }
	                }
	            },
	            error: function error(err) {
	                result = _getLocalRouteInfo();
	                console.log('network fail:: return localRouteConfig');
	            }
	        });

	        return result;
	    }

	    return {
	        // dynamicRoute 요청을 위한 url setting 함수
	        setRequestUrl: function setRequestUrl(newUrl) {
	            self.data.requestUrl = newUrl;
	        },

	        // dynamicRoute 요청을 위한 url setting 함수
	        setHttpHeader: function setHttpHeader(httpHeader) {
	            httpHeader.$get()['setApplication']('OkbBeBiz');
	            httpHeader.$get()['setService']('SEtcMang2');
	            httpHeader.$get()['setOperation']('getPcRenewalDynamicRouteList');
	            self.data.header = httpHeader.$get()['getHeader']();
	        },

	        // stateProvider 에 등록할 route 객체 반환 함수
	        getRouteObject: function getRouteObject() {
	            return _requestRouteObjectUsingSync();
	        },

	        $get: {}
	    };
	}

	/*
	 *  네트워크 요청 실패시, 로컬에 있는 route config 정보를 통합해 반환하는 함수
	 */
	function _getLocalRouteInfo() {
	    var result = {};
	    var sample = __webpack_require__(/*! ./routeConfig/sample/sample_route_config */ "./common/dynamicRoute/routeConfig/sample/sample_route_config.js");

	    _assignData(result, sample);

	    return result;
	}

	 */

	'use strict';

	var _stringify = __webpack_require__(/*! babel-runtime/core-js/json/stringify */ "../../node_modules/babel-runtime/core-js/json/stringify.js");

	var _stringify2 = _interopRequireDefault(_stringify);

	function _interopRequireDefault(obj) { return obj && obj.__esModule ? obj : { default: obj }; }

	var md = __webpack_require__(/*! ../../app_module */ "./app_module.js");

	md.factory('testInfoFactory', __factory);

	function __factory($timeout, $sessionStorageService, $utilService) {
		var factory = {};
		var isSetData = location.hostname === 'localhost' ? true : false;
		//var isSetData	= false;


		factory.callInDto = callInDto;
		factory.callOutDto = callOutDto;
		factory.isSetData = isSetData;

		return factory;

		function callInDto(data) {
			if (!isSetData) {
				return data;
			}

			data = JSON.parse(data);
			data = data || { header: {}, data: {} };

			try {
				if (typeof eval(data.header.operation || '') === 'function') {
					return (0, _stringify2.default)(eval(data.header.operation)('IN', data));
				} else {
					return (0, _stringify2.default)(data);
				}
			} catch (e) {
				return (0, _stringify2.default)(data);
			}
		}

		function callOutDto(data, inData) {
			if (!isSetData) {
				return data;
			}

			data = data || { header: {} };

			try {
				if (!data.header.operation) {
					inData = JSON.parse(inData);
					data.header.operation = inData.header.operation;
				}
				if (typeof eval(data.header.operation || '') === 'function') {
					return eval(data.header.operation)('OUT', data);
				} else {
					return data;
				}
			} catch (e) {
				return data;
			}
		}
	}

/***/ "./common/factory/title_factory.js":
/*!*****************************************!*\

/***/ function(module, exports, __webpack_require__) {

	'use strict';

	var md = __webpack_require__(/*! ../../app_module */ "./app_module.js");

	md.factory('titleFactory', __factory);

	function __factory($localStorageService, $timeout, env) {
		var factory = {};

		factory.addSubTitle = addSubTitle;

		return factory;

		function addSubTitle(subTitle, isStep, time) {
			$timeout(function () {
				var strTitle = "";
				var lis = $('.title-wrap').find('div.location:last').find('li');
				//var lis = $('#content_wrap').find('div.location').find('li');
				var rootTitle = 'OK저축은행';

				if (env.getEnv() === 'T') {
					rootTitle = rootTitle + '_테스트';
				} else if (env.getEnv() === 'D') {
					rootTitle = rootTitle + '_개발';
				}

				if (!lis || lis.length == 0) {
					strTitle = rootTitle;
				} else {
					var titleArray = [rootTitle];
					for (var i = 1; i < lis.length; i++) {
						titleArray.push(lis.eq(i).text());
					}
					if (subTitle) {
						if (',test,vm,'.indexOf(subTitle.toLowerCase()) == -1) {
							if (isStep) {
								titleArray[titleArray.length - 1] = titleArray[titleArray.length - 1] + ' - ' + subTitle;
							} else {
								titleArray.push(subTitle);
							}
						}
					}

					strTitle = titleArray.reverse().join(' < ');
				}

				document.title = strTitle;
				console.log(" ==== titleFactory.addSubTitle ==== " + "[ '" + strTitle + "' ]");
			}, time || 0);
		}
	}

	module.exports = md;

			var utm_content = $utilService.getParamVal('utm_content');

/***/ function(module, exports, __webpack_require__) {

	'use strict';

	var md = __webpack_require__(/*! ../../app_module */ "./app_module.js");

	//split
	md.filter('split', function () {
		return function (value, splitChar, idx) {
			if (value) {
				if (value.indexOf(splitChar) != -1) {
					if (typeof idx === 'undefined') {
						return value.split(splitChar);
					} else {
						return value.split(splitChar)[idx];
					}
				} else {
					return [value];
				}
			} else {
				return '';
			}
		};
	});

	//천단위 콤마 추가
	md.filter('addComma', function () {
		return function (value) {
			if (value) {
				value = value + "";
				return value.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ",");
			} else {
				return value + "";
			}
		};
	});

	//date 포맷
	md.filter('formater', ['$utilService', function ($utilService) {
		return function (value, format) {
			if (value) {
				return $utilService.dataFormat2(value, format);
			} else {
				return '';
			}
		};
	}]);

	//text->html 코드로 변환
	md.filter('textToHtml', ['$utilService', function ($utilService) {
		return function (value, isNotReplace) {
			if (!isNotReplace) {
				value = $utilService.replaceAll(value, '\r\n', '</br>');
				value = $utilService.replaceAll(value, '\n', '</br>');
				value = $utilService.replaceAll(value, '▶', '</br>');
			}
			return $utilService.getTextToHtml(value);
		};
	}]);

	//검색된 문자로 포인트 처리
	md.filter('srchTextPoint', ['$utilService', function ($utilService) {
		return function (value, scope, paramNm, type) {
			console.log('========>', scope, paramNm);
			if (scope && paramNm) {
				var obj = $utilService.getNgModel(scope, paramNm, type);
				console.log('========> obj', obj);
				if (obj['model']) {
					var descVal = obj['model'][obj.lastStr] ? '<strong class="bold orange">' + obj['model'][obj.lastStr] + '</strong>' : '';
					return $utilService.replaceAll(value, obj['model'][obj.lastStr], descVal);
				} else {
					return value;
				}
			} else {
				return value;
			}
		};
	}]);

	//문자열 치환
	md.filter('replaceAll', ['$utilService', function ($utilService) {
		return function (value, replaceVal, descVal) {
			return $utilService.replaceAll(value, replaceVal, descVal);
		};
	}]);

	//코드명 반환.
	md.filter('getCdNm', ['$utilService', function ($utilService) {
		return function (value, scope, paramNm, type) {
			if (scope && paramNm) {
				var obj = $utilService.getNgModel(scope, paramNm, type);
				if (obj['model']) {
					var codeArray = obj['model'][obj.lastStr] ? obj['model'][obj.lastStr] : [];
					return $utilService.getCdNm(value, codeArray);
				} else {
					return value;
				}
			} else {
				return value;
			}
		};
	}]);

								that.athzEventProvDoneCheck(provTypeFunList, function (saveProvList) {
									scope.athzEvent.tlph.athzCall(saveProvList);
								});
							} else if (scope.athzSelector == '#tabs_2') {

								if (scope.isCradProvShow) {
									provTypeFunList.push(scope.athzEvent.crcd.cradProvDoneCheck);
								}
								if (scope.isProvView) {
									provTypeFunList.push(scope.athzEvent.crcd.etcProvDoneCheck);
								}

								that.athzEventProvDoneCheck(provTypeFunList, function (saveProvList) {
									scope.athzEvent.crcd.athzCall(saveProvList);
								});
							} else if (scope.athzSelector == '#tabs_3') {

								if (scope.isCradProvShow) {
									provTypeFunList.push(scope.athzEvent.xecure.cradProvDoneCheck);
								}
								if (scope.isProvView) {
									provTypeFunList.push(scope.athzEvent.xecure.etcProvDoneCheck);
								}

								that.athzEventProvDoneCheck(provTypeFunList, function (saveProvList) {
									scope.athzEvent.xecure.athzCall(saveProvList);
								});
							} else if (scope.athzSelector == '#tabs_4') {

								if (scope.isCradProvShow) {
									provTypeFunList.push(scope.athzEvent.yeskey.cradProvDoneCheck);
								}
								if (scope.isProvView) {
									provTypeFunList.push(scope.athzEvent.yeskey.etcProvDoneCheck);
								}

								that.athzEventProvDoneCheck(provTypeFunList, function (saveProvList) {
									scope.athzEvent.yeskey.athzCall(saveProvList);
								});
							} else {
								//
							}
						}
					}, scope.data);
				},

				athzEventProvDoneCheck: function athzEventProvDoneCheck(typeListFun, callback) {
					typeListFun = typeListFun || [];
					var saveProvList = [];

					if (typeListFun.length == 0) {
						callback();
					} else {
						callProv(typeListFun[0], saveProvList, provSuccessCallback);
					}

					function provSuccessCallback(saveProvList) {
						typeListFun.splice(0, 1);
						if (typeListFun.length == 0) {
							callback(saveProvList);
						} else {
							callProv(typeListFun[0], saveProvList, provSuccessCallback);
						}
					}

					function callProv(typeFun, saveProvList, provCallback) {
						if (typeof typeFun === 'function') {
							typeFun(function (isProv, provList) {
								if (!isProv) {
									return;
								}
								saveProvList = saveProvList.concat(provList || []);
								provCallback(saveProvList);
							});
						} else {
							provCallback(saveProvList);
						}
					}
				}
			};

			if (scope.athzAction) {
				scope.doneGroupVisible = false;
				scope.athzAction = function () {
					scope.athzEvent.doneClick();
				};
			}
		};

		athzCtrl.drawTab = function () {
			var athzType = '';
			if (attrs.athzDirective) {
				try {
					athzType = scope.$parent.$eval(attrs.athzDirective) || attrs.athzDirective;
				} catch (e) {
					athzType = attrs.athzDirective;

				});
			});

			if (athzTypes.length == 1) {
				$(form).find('#bxuip_tab_bind ul').hide();

				heightStyle: 'content',

				return 'rxef';
			} else {
				return 'lmt';
			}
		}

									attrMap[value] = key;
								}
							}
						});

						if (!classFlag) {
							$(iElement).attr('class', iAttrsType === 'radio' ? 'radio-thenet' : 'chk-thenet');
						}

						if (data != undefined) {
							var index = 0;
							var modelObj = getNgModel($scope, iAttrs['ngModel']);
							var flag = false;

							if ((0, _typeof3.default)(modelObj.model[modelObj.lastStr]) === 'object') {
								flag = true;
							}

							$(iElement).html('');

							_.forEach(data, function (item, itemK) {

								$(iElement).append('<bx-input></bx-input>');
								var bxObj = $(iElement).find('bx-input').last();

								if (classFlag) {
									bxObj.attr('class', iAttrs['class']);
								}

								_.forEach(attrMap, function (key, value) {
									if (!item[value]) {
										switch (key) {
											case 'ng-model':
												if (flag) {
													bxObj.attr(key, iAttrs[value] + '[' + index + ']');
												} else {
													bxObj.attr(key, iAttrs[value]);
												}

												break;
											case 'id':
												if (itemK == 0) {
													bxObj.attr(key, iAttrs[value]);
												} else {
													bxObj.attr(key, iAttrs[value] + '_' + itemK);
												}
												break;
											case 'type':
												if (iAttrs[value] === 'checkbox') {
													bxObj.attr('ng-true-value', "'" + item.value + "'");
												}
											default:
												bxObj.attr(key, iAttrs[value]);
												break;
										}
									}
								});

								_.forEach(item, function (key, value) {
									if (value == 'ng-checked' && key) {
										if (flag) {
											modelObj.model[modelObj.lastStr][index] = item.value;
										} else {
											modelObj.model[modelObj.lastStr] = item.value;
										}
									}
									bxObj.attr(value, key);
								});

								index++;
							});

							$().bxInput().initialize();
							$compile($(iElement))($scope.$parent);

							var array = [];
							$.each($(iElement).find('input'), function (idx) {

								array.push($(this));
								if (idx == $(iElement).find('input').length - 1) {
									setElement($scope, iAttrs['ngModel'] ? iAttrs['ngModel'] : null, array);
								}

								//2024년 하반기 웹접근성 심사 관련 추가소스
								if (iAttrs.name && iAttrs.name === 'agree_All') {
									$(this).parent().find('label').attr('title', '전체 약관 팝업 열림');
									//$(this).parent().find('label').attr('target' , 'blank ');
								}

								$(this).on('click.radio', function (e) {

									window.gaFactory.callEvent(this);

									var ngIndex = iAttrs['ngIndex'] || 0;

									if (!iAttrs['ngChange']) {
										if ($scope.fnChkCallback && typeof $scope.fnChkCallback === 'function') {
											$scope.fnChkCallback(iAttrs['ngModel'], $scope.$eval(iAttrs['ngModel']), this, ngIndex);
										}
									} else {
										if (typeof $scope.$parent.$eval(iAttrs['ngChange']) === 'function') {
											$scope.$parent.$eval(iAttrs['ngChange'])(iAttrs['ngModel'], $scope.$eval(iAttrs['ngModel']), this, ngIndex);
										}
									}
								});
							});

							var $inputs = $(iElement).find('input');

							if (iAttrs['ngReadonly']) {
								$scope.$watch(iAttrs['ngReadonly'], function () {
									var readonly = $scope.$parent.$eval(iAttrs['ngReadonly']);
									$inputs.attr('readonly', readonly);
									$inputs.prop('disabled', readonly);
								});
							}
						}
					});
					//}
				}
			}
		};

		function getNgModel($scope, modelStr) {
			var ngObject;
			var lastStr = '';

			if (modelStr.indexOf('.') > 0) {
				modelStr = modelStr.split('.');
				//console.log('======  modelStr  ',modelStr.length);
				for (var i = 0; i < modelStr.length; i++) {
					if (i == 0) {
						ngObject = $scope.$parent[modelStr[i]];
					} else if (i == modelStr.length - 1) {
						lastStr = modelStr[i];
					} else {
						ngObject = ngObject[modelStr[i]];
					}
				}
			} else {
				lastStr = modelStr;
				ngObject = $scope.$parent;
			}

			return { lastStr: lastStr, model: ngObject };
		}

		function setElement($scope, ngModel, element, isValidateMulti) {
			if ($scope && ngModel) {
				if (!$scope.$parent['element']) {
					$scope.$parent['element'] = {};
				}

				if (isValidateMulti) {
					if (!$scope.$parent['element'][ngModel]) {
						$scope.$parent['element'][ngModel] = [];
					}
					$scope.$parent['element'][ngModel].push(element);
				} else {
					$scope.$parent['element'][ngModel] = element;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	    getServerCall: function getServerCall(data, callFun, dimFlag) {

	          url: 'serviceEndpoint/httpService/request.json',

	    getCmnCdSubList: function getCmnCdSubList(groCd, callFun) {
	      if (typeof callFun !== 'function' || !groCd) {
	        return;
	      }
	      var resultMap = {};
	      var sesseionCmnCdGroMap = $sessionStorageService.get('cmnCdGro') || {};

	      var groCdArray = groCd.split(',');
	      var params = [];
	      $.each(groCdArray, function (idx, val) {
	        if (sesseionCmnCdGroMap[val]) {
	          if (val === 'K0670') {
	            //고용형태일 경우  주부/학생/무직 미노출 00010 자영업자
	            resultMap[val] = sesseionCmnCdGroMap[val].filter(function (map) {
	              return map.value != '00009' && map.value != '00010';
	            });
	          } else {
	            resultMap[val] = sesseionCmnCdGroMap[val];
	          }
	        } else {
	          params.push(val);
	        }
	      });

	      if (params.length) {
	        this.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({ groCd: params.join(',') }, { service: 'SEtcMang', operation: 'getMaCmnCdSubList' })).then(function (data) {
	          if (data.SMaCmnCd01OutDto.groCdList && data.SMaCmnCd01OutDto.groCdList.length) {
	            $.each(data.SMaCmnCd01OutDto.groCdList, function (idx, dto) {
	              sesseionCmnCdGroMap[dto.groCd] = dto.cdList;
	              if (dto.groCd === 'K0670') {
	                //고용형태일 경우  00009 주부/학생/무직 미노출 00010 자영업자
	                resultMap[dto.groCd] = dto.cdList.filter(function (map) {
	                  return map.value != '00009' && map.value != '00010';
	                });
	              } else {
	                resultMap[dto.groCd] = dto.cdList;
	              }
	            });
	            $sessionStorageService.set('cmnCdGro', sesseionCmnCdGroMap);
	          }
	          callFun(resultMap);
	        });
	      } else {
	        callFun(resultMap);
	      }
	    },

	function _interopRequireDefault(obj) { return obj && obj.__esModule ? obj : { default: obj }; }

	var md = __webpack_require__(/*! ../app_module */ "./app_module.js");

	md.service('$commonService', __service);

	function __service($http, $q, $utilService, $localStorageService, $sessionStorageService, $rootScope) {

	  var dim = $utilService.getDimmed($('.container1'));

	  return {
	    getPostServerAsync: function getPostServerAsync(data) {
	      var response = $.ajax({
	        url: 'serviceEndpoint/httpService/request.json',
	        method: 'post',
	        dataType: 'json',
	        contentType: 'application/json',
	        headers: {
	          'Timestamp': new Date().getTime()
	        },
	        data: data,
	        async: false
	      });
	      console.log('getPostServerAsync', response);
	      return response.responseJSON;
	    },

	    getServerCall: function getServerCall(data, callFun, dimFlag) {
	      dimFlag = typeof dimFlag == 'undefined' ? true : dimFlag;

	      if (data) {
	        if (dimFlag) {
	          dim.show();
	        }
	        var defer = $q.defer();
	        $http({
	          url: 'serviceEndpoint/httpService/request.json',
	          method: 'get',
	          headers: {
	            'Timestamp': new Date().getTime()
	          },
	          data: data
	        }).success(function (data, status, headers, config) {
	          console.log("!!!!!!!!!!!!성공:", data);
	          if (dimFlag) dim.hide();

	          try {
	            if (data['header'].sessionId) {
	              var sessionStorage = window.sessionStorage || window.localStorage;
	              sessionStorage.setItem("oksId", data['header'].sessionId);
	            }
	          } catch (e) {
	            console.log('oksId err', e);
	          }

	          if (!chkPacketPoisoning(config.headers, data.header)) {
	            // 위변조시 처리
	            // return;
	          }

	          if ($utilService.getErrorMsg(data, callFun)) {
	            defer.resolve(data);
	          } else {
	            switch (data['header'].msgCd) {
	              case 'AONCMM00004':
	                $utilService.openAlert(data['header'].msgCont, function () {
	                  $utilService.go('wrap_main.main', { exit: true });
	                });
	                break;
	              case 'AONCMM00003': //checkPermission 관련 메인 페이지로 보냄.
	              case 'AONBIZ00048':
	                //checkPermission 관련 메인 페이지로 보냄.
	                $utilService.openAlert(data['header'].msgCont, function () {
	                  $utilService.go('wrap_main.main', { exit: true });
	                });
	                break;
	              case 'AONBIZ00028':
	              case 'AONBIZ00000':
	                $utilService.openAlert(data['header'].msgCont, function () {
	                  $utilService.go('/lon/mbrLgin');
	                });
	                break;
	              case 'AONBIZ00038':
	              case 'AONBIZLGIN0':
	                $utilService.openAlert(data['header'].msgCont, function () {
	                  $sessionStorageService.set('lgin', undefined);
	                  $sessionStorageService.set('roles', undefined);
	                  $utilService.go('/main');
	                  $rootScope.$broadcast('sendBroadCastLgin', false);
	                });
	                break;
	              case 'AONBIZATHZ0':
	                if (['processMbrLginInfRegCi'].indexOf(data['header']['operation']) == -1) {
	                  $utilService.openAlert(data['header'].msgCont, function () {
	                    $sessionStorageService.set('lgin', undefined);
	                    $sessionStorageService.set('roles', undefined);
	                    $utilService.go('/main');
	                    $rootScope.$broadcast('sendBroadCastLgin', false);
	                  });
	                }
	                break;

	            }
	          }
	        }).error(function (data, status, headers, config) {
	          console.log("!!!!!!!!!!!!실패");
	          if (dimFlag) {
	            dim.hide();
	          }
	          if ($utilService.getErrorMsg(data)) {
	            defer.resolve(data);
	          }
	        });
	        return defer.promise;
	      } else {
	        return;
	      }
	    },

	    getPostServerCall: function getPostServerCall(inData, callFun, dimFlag) {
	      dimFlag = typeof dimFlag == 'undefined' ? true : dimFlag;
	      if (inData) {
	        inData = callInDto(inData);

	        if (dimFlag) {
	          dim.show();
	        }

	        var defer = $q.defer();
	        $http({
	          url: 'serviceEndpoint/httpService/request.json',
	          method: 'post',
	          headers: {
	            'Timestamp': new Date().getTime()
	          },
	          data: inData
	        }).success(function (outData, status, headers, config) {
	          console.log("!!!!!!!!!!!!성공:", outData);
	          if (dimFlag) {
	            dim.hide();
	          }

	          try {
	            if (outData['header'].sessionId) {
	              var sessionStorage = window.sessionStorage || window.localStorage;
	              sessionStorage.setItem("oksId", outData['header'].sessionId);
	            }
	          } catch (e) {
	            console.log('oksId outData', outData);
	            console.log('oksId status', status);
	            console.log('oksId headers', headers);
	            console.log('oksId config', config);
	            console.log('oksId err', e);
	          }

	          if (!chkPacketPoisoning(config.headers, outData.header)) {
	            // 위변조시 처리
	            // return;
	          }

	          outData = callOutDto(outData, inData);

	          if ($utilService.getErrorMsg(outData, callFun)) {
	            defer.resolve(outData);
	          } else {
	            switch (outData['header'].msgCd) {
	              case 'AONCMM00004':
	                $utilService.openAlert(outData['header'].msgCont, function () {
	                  $utilService.go('wrap_main.main', { exit: true });
	                });
	                break;
	              case 'AONCMM00003': //checkPermission 관련 메인 페이지로 보냄.
	              case 'AONBIZ00048':
	                //checkPermission 관련 메인 페이지로 보냄.
	                $utilService.openAlert(outData['header'].msgCont, function () {
	                  $utilService.go('wrap_main.main', { exit: true });
	                });
	                break;
	              case 'AONBIZ00028':
	              case 'AONBIZ00000':
	                $utilService.openAlert(outData['header'].msgCont, function () {
	                  $utilService.go('/lon/mbrLgin');
	                });
	                break;
	              case 'AONBIZ00038':
	              case 'AONBIZLGIN0':
	                $utilService.openAlert(outData['header'].msgCont, function () {
	                  $sessionStorageService.set('lgin', undefined);
	                  $sessionStorageService.set('roles', undefined);
	                  $utilService.go('/main');
	                  $rootScope.$broadcast('sendBroadCastLgin', false);
	                });
	                break;
	              case 'AONBIZATHZ0':
	                if (['processMbrLginInfRegCi'].indexOf(outData['header']['operation']) == -1) {
	                  $utilService.openAlert(outData['header'].msgCont, function () {
	                    $sessionStorageService.set('lgin', undefined);
	                    $sessionStorageService.set('roles', undefined);
	                    $utilService.go('/main');
	                    $rootScope.$broadcast('sendBroadCastLgin', false);
	                  });
	                }
	                break;

	            }
	          }
	        }).error(function (outData, status, headers, config) {
	          console.log("!!!!!!!!!!!!실패");
	          if (dimFlag) {
	            dim.hide();
	          }
	          if ($utilService.getErrorMsg(outData)) {
	            defer.resolve(outData);
	          }
	        });

	        return defer.promise;
	      } else {
	        return;
	      }
	    },

	    /*
	     * 공통 코드를 반환
	     */
	    getCmnCdSubList: function getCmnCdSubList(groCd, callFun) {
	      if (typeof callFun !== 'function' || !groCd) {
	        return;
	      }
	      var resultMap = {};
	      var sesseionCmnCdGroMap = $sessionStorageService.get('cmnCdGro') || {};

	      var groCdArray = groCd.split(',');
	      var params = [];
	      $.each(groCdArray, function (idx, val) {
	        if (sesseionCmnCdGroMap[val]) {
	          if (val === 'K0670') {
	            //고용형태일 경우  주부/학생/무직 미노출 00010 자영업자
	            resultMap[val] = sesseionCmnCdGroMap[val].filter(function (map) {
	              return map.value != '00009' && map.value != '00010';
	            });
	          } else {
	            resultMap[val] = sesseionCmnCdGroMap[val];
	          }
	        } else {
	          params.push(val);
	        }
	      });

	      if (params.length) {
	        this.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({ groCd: params.join(',') }, { service: 'SEtcMang', operation: 'getMaCmnCdSubList' })).then(function (data) {
	          if (data.SMaCmnCd01OutDto.groCdList && data.SMaCmnCd01OutDto.groCdList.length) {
	            $.each(data.SMaCmnCd01OutDto.groCdList, function (idx, dto) {
	              sesseionCmnCdGroMap[dto.groCd] = dto.cdList;
	              if (dto.groCd === 'K0670') {
	                //고용형태일 경우  00009 주부/학생/무직 미노출 00010 자영업자
	                resultMap[dto.groCd] = dto.cdList.filter(function (map) {
	                  return map.value != '00009' && map.value != '00010';
	                });
	              } else {
	                resultMap[dto.groCd] = dto.cdList;
	              }
	            });
	            $sessionStorageService.set('cmnCdGro', sesseionCmnCdGroMap);
	          }
	          callFun(resultMap);
	        });
	      } else {
	        callFun(resultMap);
	      }
	    },

	    /*
	     * 스크립트 관리에 등록된 페이지 로딩시 호출 스크립트
	     */
	    callCmnScript: function callCmnScript(toState, $location) {
	      $utilService.setScript('/***/');
	      this.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({ routeKey: toState.name.substring(toState.name.indexOf('wrap.') + 5) }, { service: 'SEtcMang2', operation: 'getRouteScrpList' }), null, false).then(function (data) {
	        if (data.SMaScrp01OutDto && data.SMaScrp01OutDto.sub && data.SMaScrp01OutDto.sub.length) {
	          var html = [];
	          var scrpStr = '';
	          $.each(data.SMaScrp01OutDto.sub, function (idx) {
	            html.push(data.SMaScrp01OutDto.sub[idx].scrpCont);
	          });
	          if (html.length) {
	            scrpStr = $utilService.replaceAll(html.join(''), '{routeKey}', toState.name);

	            $.each($location.$$search, function (key) {
	              scrpStr = $utilService.replaceAll(scrpStr, '{' + key + '}', $location.$$search[key]);
	            });
	            $utilService.setScript(scrpStr);
	          }
	        }
	      });
	    },

	    //파일업로드 관련
	    uploadFile: function uploadFile(url, data, option, dimFlag) {
	      dimFlag = typeof dimFlag == 'undefined' ? true : dimFlag;

	      var dim = null;
	      if (dimFlag) {
	        dim = $utilService.getDimmed($('.container1'));
	      }

	      if (option && option.noFile) {
	        $.ajax({
	          url: url,
	          type: 'post',
	          contentType: 'application/json',
	          dataType: 'json',
	          data: angular.toJson(data),
	          async: option && option.async ? true : false,
	          beforeSend: function beforeSend() {
	            console.log('beforeSend============================>');
	            if (dim) {
	              dim.show();
	            }
	          },
	          complete: function complete() {
	            console.log('complete============================>');
	            if (dim) {
	              dim.hide();
	            }
	          },
	          success: function success(data) {
	            option && option.success && option.success(data.result);
	          },
	          error: function error(data) {
	            option && option.error && option.error(data);
	          }
	        });
	      } else {
	        var formData = new FormData();
	        formData.append('uploadFile', data);

	        $.ajax({
	          url: url,
	          type: 'post',
	          processData: false,
	          contentType: false,
	          data: formData,
	          async: option && option.async ? true : false,
	          beforeSend: function beforeSend() {
	            console.log('beforeSend============================>');
	            if (dim) {
	              dim.show();
	            }
	          },
	          xhr: function xhr() {
	            //파일 업로드 구현시 퍼센트 값 마크업에 표시할때 사용
	            var xhr = $.ajaxSettings.xhr();
	            xhr.upload.addEventListener('progress', function (evt) {
	              if (evt.lengthComputable) {
	                var percentCompplete = evt.loaded / evt.total;
	                //console.log("upload", Math.round(percentCompplete*100) + "% complete");
	              }
	            }, false);
	            return xhr;
	          },
	          complete: function complete() {
	            console.log('complete============================>');
	            if (dim) {
	              dim.hide();
	            }
	          },
	          success: function success(data) {
	            option && option.success && option.success(data.result);
	          },
	          error: function error(data) {
	            option && option.error && option.error(data);
	          }
	        });
	      }
	    },

	    uploadFile: function uploadFile(url, data, option, dimFlag) {
	      dimFlag = typeof dimFlag == 'undefined' ? true : dimFlag;

	      var dim = null;
	      if (dimFlag) {
	        dim = $utilService.getDimmed($('.container1'));
	      }

	      if (option && option.noFile) {
	        $.ajax({
	          url: url,
	          type: 'post',
	          contentType: 'application/json',
	          dataType: 'json',
	          data: angular.toJson(data),
	          async: option && option.async ? true : false,
	          beforeSend: function beforeSend() {
	            console.log('beforeSend============================>');
	            if (dim) {
	              dim.show();
	            }
	          },
	          complete: function complete() {
	            console.log('complete============================>');
	            if (dim) {
	              dim.hide();
	            }
	          },
	          success: function success(data) {
	            option && option.success && option.success(data.result);
	          },
	          error: function error(data) {
	            option && option.error && option.error(data);
	          }
	        });
	      } else {
	        var formData = new FormData();
	        formData.append('uploadFile', data);

	        $.ajax({
	          url: url,
	          type: 'post',
	          processData: false,
	          contentType: false,
	          data: formData,
	          async: option && option.async ? true : false,
	          beforeSend: function beforeSend() {
	            console.log('beforeSend============================>');
	            if (dim) {
	              dim.show();
	            }
	          },
	          xhr: function xhr() {
	            //파일 업로드 구현시 퍼센트 값 마크업에 표시할때 사용
	            var xhr = $.ajaxSettings.xhr();
	            xhr.upload.addEventListener('progress', function (evt) {
	              if (evt.lengthComputable) {
	                var percentCompplete = evt.loaded / evt.total;
	                //console.log("upload", Math.round(percentCompplete*100) + "% complete");
	              }
	            }, false);
	            return xhr;
	          },
	          complete: function complete() {
	            console.log('complete============================>');
	            if (dim) {
	              dim.hide();
	            }
	          },
	          success: function success(data) {
	            option && option.success && option.success(data.result);
	          },
	          error: function error(data) {
	            option && option.error && option.error(data);

	    //첨부파일 DB 저장 성공시 file 서블릿으로 임시 파일 -> was 및 web으로 복사요청 호출
	    callFileSaveSuccess: function callFileSaveSuccess(fileGroKeyList) {
	      var msg = '';
	      var obj = this;

	      if (fileGroKeyList && fileGroKeyList.length) {
	        $.each(fileGroKeyList, function (idx) {
	          var groKey = fileGroKeyList[idx];
	          console.log(groKey);
	          if (groKey) {
	            var uploadData = {};
	            var groKeyArray = groKey.split(',');
	            var url = '';

	            $.each(groKeyArray, function (idx) {
	              switch (idx) {
	                case 0:
	                  uploadData['type'] = groKeyArray[idx];uploadData['savePath'] = groKeyArray[idx] + "/";break;
	                case 1:
	                  uploadData['objKey'] = groKeyArray[idx];break;
	                case 2:
	                  url = groKeyArray[idx] === 'web' ? '/fileMng/saveweb' : '/fileMng/savewas';break;
	              }
	            });

	            obj.uploadFile(url, uploadData, {
	              noFile: true,
	              async: true,
	              success: function success(data) {
	                console.log('success =============>', data);
	                if (data !== 'SUCCESS') {
	                  msg = "일부 파일이 저장에 실패 했습니다.\n목록 페이지로 이동하시겠습니까?";
	                  saveFlag = false;
	                }
	              },
	              error: function error(data) {
	                console.log('error =============>', data);
	                msg = "파일 저장에 실패 했습니다.\n목록 페이지로 이동하시겠습니까?";
	                saveFlag = false;
	              }
	            }, false);
	          }
	        });
	      }
	      return msg;
	    },

	    /*
	     * 전체 메뉴를 반환
	     */
	    getTotMenuMap: function getTotMenuMap(callFun) {
	      if (typeof callFun !== 'function') {
	        return;
	      }
	      var obj = this;

	      var serverCall = function serverCall(callFun) {
	        obj.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({}, { service: 'SMenuMang', operation: 'getPcTotMenuList' }), null, false).then(function (data) {
	          console.log('================================> getTotMenuMap ', data);
	          if (data.SMaMenu02OutDto) {

	            var totMenuMap = {};
	            var nowDate = new Date();

	            nowDate.setMinutes(nowDate.getMinutes() + 60);

	            totMenuMap['time'] = nowDate.getTime();

	            if (data.SMaMenu02OutDto['home']) {
	              totMenuMap['menuMap'] = totMenuMap['menuMap'] ? totMenuMap['menuMap'] : {};
	              totMenuMap['menuMap']['home'] = data.SMaMenu02OutDto['home'];
	            }

	            if (data.SMaMenu02OutDto['loan']) {
	              totMenuMap['menuMap'] = totMenuMap['menuMap'] ? totMenuMap['menuMap'] : {};
	              totMenuMap['menuMap']['loan'] = data.SMaMenu02OutDto['loan'];
	            }

	            if (totMenuMap['menuMap']) {
	              $localStorageService.set('totMenuMap', totMenuMap);
	            }

	            callFun(totMenuMap['menuMap']);

	            if (data['header'] && data['header']['reqRecvDtm']) {
	              $sessionStorageService.set('serverDate', $utilService.dataFormat2(data['header']['reqRecvDtm'], '########'));
	            }
	          }
	        });
	      };

	      if ($utilService.getParamVal('clearYn') == 'Y') {
	        serverCall(callFun);
	      } else {
	        if ($localStorageService.get('totMenuMap')) {
	          var totMenuMap = $localStorageService.get('totMenuMap');

	          if (Number(totMenuMap['time']) < new Date().getTime()) {
	            serverCall(callFun);
	          } else {
	            callFun(totMenuMap['menuMap']);
	          }
	        } else {
	          serverCall(callFun);
	        }
	      }
	    },

	    /*
	     * 공통 코드를 반환
	     */
	    getCmnCdSubList: function getCmnCdSubList(groCd, callFun) {
	      if (typeof callFun !== 'function' || !groCd) {
	        return;
	      }
	      var resultMap = {};
	      var sesseionCmnCdGroMap = $sessionStorageService.get('cmnCdGro') || {};

	      var groCdArray = groCd.split(',');
	      var params = [];
	      $.each(groCdArray, function (idx, val) {
	        if (sesseionCmnCdGroMap[val]) {
	          if (val === 'K0670') {
	            //고용형태일 경우  주부/학생/무직 미노출 00010 자영업자
	            resultMap[val] = sesseionCmnCdGroMap[val].filter(function (map) {
	              return map.value != '00009' && map.value != '00010';
	            });
	          } else {
	            resultMap[val] = sesseionCmnCdGroMap[val];
	          }
	        } else {
	          params.push(val);
	        }
	      });

	      if (params.length) {
	        this.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({ groCd: params.join(',') }, { service: 'SEtcMang', operation: 'getMaCmnCdSubList' })).then(function (data) {
	          if (data.SMaCmnCd01OutDto.groCdList && data.SMaCmnCd01OutDto.groCdList.length) {
	            $.each(data.SMaCmnCd01OutDto.groCdList, function (idx, dto) {
	              sesseionCmnCdGroMap[dto.groCd] = dto.cdList;
	              if (dto.groCd === 'K0670') {
	                //고용형태일 경우  00009 주부/학생/무직 미노출 00010 자영업자
	                resultMap[dto.groCd] = dto.cdList.filter(function (map) {
	                  return map.value != '00009' && map.value != '00010';
	                });
	              } else {
	                resultMap[dto.groCd] = dto.cdList;
	              }
	            });
	            $sessionStorageService.set('cmnCdGro', sesseionCmnCdGroMap);
	          }
	          callFun(resultMap);
	        });
	      } else {
	        callFun(resultMap);
	      }
	    },

	    /*
	     * 스크립트 관리에 등록된 페이지 로딩시 호출 스크립트
	     */
	    callCmnScript: function callCmnScript(toState, $location) {
	      $utilService.setScript('/***/');
	      this.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({ routeKey: toState.name.substring(toState.name.indexOf('wrap.') + 5) }, { service: 'SEtcMang2', operation: 'getRouteScrpList' }), null, false).then(function (data) {
	        if (data.SMaScrp01OutDto && data.SMaScrp01OutDto.sub && data.SMaScrp01OutDto.sub.length) {
	          var html = [];
	          var scrpStr = '';
	          $.each(data.SMaScrp01OutDto.sub, function (idx) {
	            html.push(data.SMaScrp01OutDto.sub[idx].scrpCont);
	          });
	          if (html.length) {
	            scrpStr = $utilService.replaceAll(html.join(''), '{routeKey}', toState.name);

	            $.each($location.$$search, function (key) {
	              scrpStr = $utilService.replaceAll(scrpStr, '{' + key + '}', $location.$$search[key]);
	            });
	            $utilService.setScript(scrpStr);
	          }
	        }
	      });
	    },

	    //파일업로드 관련
	    uploadFile: function uploadFile(url, data, option, dimFlag) {
	      dimFlag = typeof dimFlag == 'undefined' ? true : dimFlag;

	      var dim = null;
	      if (dimFlag) {
	        dim = $utilService.getDimmed($('.container1'));
	      }

	      if (option && option.noFile) {
	        $.ajax({
	          url: url,
	          type: 'post',
	          contentType: 'application/json',
	          dataType: 'json',
	          data: angular.toJson(data),
	          async: option && option.async ? true : false,
	          beforeSend: function beforeSend() {
	            console.log('beforeSend============================>');
	            if (dim) {
	              dim.show();
	            }
	          },
	          complete: function complete() {
	            console.log('complete============================>');
	            if (dim) {
	              dim.hide();
	            }
	          },
	          success: function success(data) {
	            option && option.success && option.success(data.result);
	          },
	          error: function error(data) {
	            option && option.error && option.error(data);
	          }
	        });
	      } else {
	        var formData = new FormData();
	        formData.append('uploadFile', data);

	        $.ajax({
	          url: url,
	          type: 'post',
	          processData: false,
	          contentType: false,
	          data: formData,
	          async: option && option.async ? true : false,
	          beforeSend: function beforeSend() {
	            console.log('beforeSend============================>');
	            if (dim) {
	              dim.show();
	            }
	          },
	          xhr: function xhr() {
	            //파일 업로드 구현시 퍼센트 값 마크업에 표시할때 사용
	            var xhr = $.ajaxSettings.xhr();
	            xhr.upload.addEventListener('progress', function (evt) {
	              if (evt.lengthComputable) {
	                var percentCompplete = evt.loaded / evt.total;
	                //console.log("upload", Math.round(percentCompplete*100) + "% complete");
	              }
	            }, false);
	            return xhr;
	          },
	          complete: function complete() {
	            console.log('complete============================>');
	            if (dim) {
	              dim.hide();
	            }
	          },
	          success: function success(data) {
	            option && option.success && option.success(data.result);
	          },
	          error: function error(data) {
	            option && option.error && option.error(data);
	          }
	        });
	      }
	    },

	    //첨부파일 DB 저장 성공시 file 서블릿으로 임시 파일 -> was 및 web으로 복사요청 호출
	    callFileSaveSuccess: function callFileSaveSuccess(fileGroKeyList) {
	      var msg = '';
	      var obj = this;

	      if (fileGroKeyList && fileGroKeyList.length) {
	        $.each(fileGroKeyList, function (idx) {
	          var groKey = fileGroKeyList[idx];
	          console.log(groKey);
	          if (groKey) {
	            var uploadData = {};
	            var groKeyArray = groKey.split(',');
	            var url = '';

	            $.each(groKeyArray, function (idx) {
	              switch (idx) {
	                case 0:
	                  uploadData['type'] = groKeyArray[idx];uploadData['savePath'] = groKeyArray[idx] + "/";break;
	                case 1:
	                  uploadData['objKey'] = groKeyArray[idx];break;
	                case 2:
	                  url = groKeyArray[idx] === 'web' ? '/fileMng/saveweb' : '/fileMng/savewas';break;
	              }
	            });

	            obj.uploadFile(url, uploadData, {
	              noFile: true,
	              async: true,
	              success: function success(data) {
	                console.log('success =============>', data);
	                if (data !== 'SUCCESS') {
	                  msg = "일부 파일이 저장에 실패 했습니다.\n목록 페이지로 이동하시겠습니까?";
	                  saveFlag = false;
	                }
	              },
	              error: function error(data) {
	                console.log('error =============>', data);
	                msg = "파일 저장에 실패 했습니다.\n목록 페이지로 이동하시겠습니까?";
	                saveFlag = false;
	              }
	            }, false);
	          }
	        });
	      }
	      return msg;
	    },

	  function chkPacketPoisoning(configHeader, dataHeader) {
	    if (configHeader && dataHeader) {
	      if (configHeader['Timestamp'] && dataHeader.authVl) {
	        if ($utilService.getNumberEncode(configHeader['Timestamp']) != dataHeader.authVl) {
	          //<p>변조된 데이타 신호가 감지되었습니다.<br>다시 시도해 주세요.</p>
	          //return false;
	        }
	      }
	    }

	    return true;
	  }

	            //파일 업로드 구현시 퍼센트 값 마크업에 표시할때 사용
	            var xhr = $.ajaxSettings.xhr();
	            xhr.upload.addEventListener('progress', function (evt) {
	              if (evt.lengthComputable) {
	                var percentCompplete = evt.loaded / evt.total;
	                //console.log("upload", Math.round(percentCompplete*100) + "% complete");
	              }
	            }, false);
	            return xhr;
	          },
	          complete: function complete() {
	            console.log('complete============================>');
	            if (dim) {
	              dim.hide();
	            }
	          },
	          success: function success(data) {
	            option && option.success && option.success(data.result);
	          },
	          error: function error(data) {
	            option && option.error && option.error(data);
	          }
	        });
	      }
	    },

	    //첨부파일 DB 저장 성공시 file 서블릿으로 임시 파일 -> was 및 web으로 복사요청 호출
	    callFileSaveSuccess: function callFileSaveSuccess(fileGroKeyList) {
	      var msg = '';
	      var obj = this;

	      if (fileGroKeyList && fileGroKeyList.length) {
	        $.each(fileGroKeyList, function (idx) {
	          var groKey = fileGroKeyList[idx];
	          console.log(groKey);
	          if (groKey) {
	            var uploadData = {};
	            var groKeyArray = groKey.split(',');
	            var url = '';

	            $.each(groKeyArray, function (idx) {
	              switch (idx) {
	                case 0:
	                  uploadData['type'] = groKeyArray[idx];uploadData['savePath'] = groKeyArray[idx] + "/";break;
	                case 1:
	                  uploadData['objKey'] = groKeyArray[idx];break;
	                case 2:
	                  url = groKeyArray[idx] === 'web' ? '/fileMng/saveweb' : '/fileMng/savewas';break;
	              }
	            });

	            obj.uploadFile(url, uploadData, {
	              noFile: true,
	              async: true,
	              success: function success(data) {
	                console.log('success =============>', data);
	                if (data !== 'SUCCESS') {
	                  msg = "일부 파일이 저장에 실패 했습니다.\n목록 페이지로 이동하시겠습니까?";
	                  saveFlag = false;
	                }
	              },
	              error: function error(data) {
	                console.log('error =============>', data);
	                msg = "파일 저장에 실패 했습니다.\n목록 페이지로 이동하시겠습니까?";
	                saveFlag = false;
	              }
	            }, false);
	          }
	        });
	      }
	      return msg;
	    },

	    /*
	     * 전체 메뉴를 반환
	     */
	    getTotMenuMap: function getTotMenuMap(callFun) {
	      if (typeof callFun !== 'function') {
	        return;
	      }
	      var obj = this;

	      var serverCall = function serverCall(callFun) {
	        obj.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({}, { service: 'SMenuMang', operation: 'getPcTotMenuList' }), null, false).then(function (data) {
	          console.log('================================> getTotMenuMap ', data);
	          if (data.SMaMenu02OutDto) {

	            var totMenuMap = {};
	            var nowDate = new Date();

	            nowDate.setMinutes(nowDate.getMinutes() + 60);

	            totMenuMap['time'] = nowDate.getTime();

	            if (data.SMaMenu02OutDto['home']) {
	              totMenuMap['menuMap'] = totMenuMap['menuMap'] ? totMenuMap['menuMap'] : {};
	              totMenuMap['menuMap']['home'] = data.SMaMenu02OutDto['home'];
	            }

	            if (data.SMaMenu02OutDto['loan']) {
	              totMenuMap['menuMap'] = totMenuMap['menuMap'] ? totMenuMap['menuMap'] : {};
	              totMenuMap['menuMap']['loan'] = data.SMaMenu02OutDto['loan'];
	            }

	            if (totMenuMap['menuMap']) {
	              $localStorageService.set('totMenuMap', totMenuMap);
	            }

	            callFun(totMenuMap['menuMap']);

	            if (data['header'] && data['header']['reqRecvDtm']) {
	              $sessionStorageService.set('serverDate', $utilService.dataFormat2(data['header']['reqRecvDtm'], '########'));
	            }
	          }
	        });
	      };

	      if ($utilService.getParamVal('clearYn') == 'Y') {
	        serverCall(callFun);
	      } else {
	        if ($localStorageService.get('totMenuMap')) {
	          var totMenuMap = $localStorageService.get('totMenuMap');

	          if (Number(totMenuMap['time']) < new Date().getTime()) {
	            serverCall(callFun);
	          } else {
	            callFun(totMenuMap['menuMap']);
	          }
	        } else {
	          serverCall(callFun);
	        }
	      }
	    },

	    /*
	      * 전체 메뉴(리뉴얼) 반환

	    getRenewalTotMenuMap: function getRenewalTotMenuMap(callFun) {

	      if (typeof callFun !== 'function') {
	        return;
	      }

	      var obj = this;
	      var serverCall = function serverCall(callFun) {

	        obj.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({}, { service: 'SMenuMang2', operation: 'getRenewalPcTotMenuList' }), null, false).then(function (data) {

	          if (data.SMaMenu02OutDto) {

	            var totMenuMap = {};
	            var nowDate = new Date();

	            nowDate.setMinutes(nowDate.getMinutes() + 60);

	            totMenuMap['time'] = nowDate.getTime();

	            if (data.SMaMenu02OutDto['home']) {
	              totMenuMap['menuMap'] = totMenuMap['menuMap'] ? totMenuMap['menuMap'] : {};
	              totMenuMap['menuMap']['home'] = data.SMaMenu02OutDto['home'];
	            }

	            if (data.SMaMenu02OutDto['loan']) {
	              totMenuMap['menuMap'] = totMenuMap['menuMap'] ? totMenuMap['menuMap'] : {};
	              totMenuMap['menuMap']['loan'] = data.SMaMenu02OutDto['loan'];
	            }

	            if (totMenuMap['menuMap']) {
	              $localStorageService.set('totMenuMap', totMenuMap);
	            }

	            callFun(totMenuMap['menuMap']);

	            if (data['header'] && data['header']['reqRecvDtm']) {
	              $sessionStorageService.set('serverDate', $utilService.dataFormat2(data['header']['reqRecvDtm'], '########'));
	            }
	          }
	        });
	      };

	      if ($utilService.getParamVal('clearYn') == 'Y') {
	        serverCall(callFun);
	      } else {

	        if ($localStorageService.get('totMenuMap')) {

	          if (Number(totMenuMap['time']) < new Date().getTime()) {

	          } else {
	            callFun(totMenuMap['menuMap']);
	          }
	        } else {
	          serverCall(callFun);
	        }
	      }
	    }

	  };

	  function chkPacketPoisoning(configHeader, dataHeader) {
	    if (configHeader && dataHeader) {
	      if (configHeader['Timestamp'] && dataHeader.authVl) {
	        if ($utilService.getNumberEncode(configHeader['Timestamp']) != dataHeader.authVl) {
	          //<p>변조된 데이타 신호가 감지되었습니다.<br>다시 시도해 주세요.</p>
	          //return false;
	        }
	      }
	    }

	    return true;
	  }

	  function callInDto(data) {
	    var isSetData = location.hostname === 'localhost' ? true : false;

	    if (!isSetData) {
	      return data;
	    }

	    data = JSON.parse(data);
	    data = data || { header: {}, data: {} };

	    try {
	      if (typeof eval(data.header.operation || '') === 'function') {
	        return (0, _stringify2.default)(eval(data.header.operation)('IN', data));
	      } else {
	        return (0, _stringify2.default)(data);
	      }
	    } catch (e) {
	      return (0, _stringify2.default)(data);
	    }
	  }

	  function callOutDto(data, inData) {
	    var isSetData = location.hostname === 'localhost' ? true : false;

	    if (!isSetData) {
	      return data;
	    }

	    data = data || { header: {} };

	    try {
	      if (!data.header.operation) {
	        inData = JSON.parse(inData);
	        data.header.operation = inData.header.operation;
	      }
	      if (typeof eval(data.header.operation || '') === 'function') {
	        return eval(data.header.operation)('OUT', data);
	      } else {
	        return data;
	      }
	    } catch (e) {
	      return data;
	    }
	  }
	}
