/***/ "./common/contDirective/cont_ctrl_directive.js":
/*!*****************************************************!*\
  !*** ./common/contDirective/cont_ctrl_directive.js ***!
  \*****************************************************/
/***/ function(module, exports, __webpack_require__) {

	'use strict';

	var md = __webpack_require__(/*! ../../app_module */ "./app_module.js");

	md.directive('contCtrlDirective', __directive);

	function __directive(env, $rootScope, $compile, $timeout, $commonService, $utilService, $templateRequest) {
		return {
			replace: true,
			scope: false,
			restrict: 'EA',
			templateUrl: 'app/common/contDirective/cont_ctrl.tpl.html',
			controller: function controller($scope, $element, $attrs) {
				/*
	    *	routeState
	    *		ㄴ templateUrl	: 탬플릿 URL
	    *		ㄴ controller	: 컨트로러 이름
	    */
				$attrs.$observe('routeState', function (val) {
					if (val) {
						var routeState = angular.fromJson(val);
						var templateUrl = routeState['templateUrl'];
						var controller = routeState['controller'];

						$templateRequest(templateUrl, true).then(function (response) {
							if ($scope.$$destroyed) {
								return;
							}

							var dom = [];

							if (controller) {
								dom.push('<div ng-controller="' + controller + '">');
							} else {
								dom.push('<div>');
							}
							dom.push(response); // 탬플릿 HTML
							dom.push('</div>');

							$element.html(dom.join(''));
							$compile($element.contents())($scope);
						});
					}
				});
			}
		};
	}

	module.exports = md;

/***/ function(module, exports, __webpack_require__) {

	'use strict';

	var md = __webpack_require__(/*! ../../app_module */ "./app_module.js");

	md.directive('contInfoDirective', __directive);

	function __directive(env, $rootScope, $compile, $timeout, $commonService, $utilService, $location) {
	  return {
	    replace: true,
	    scope: {
	      contModeCd: '=',
	      contCd: '=',
	      contTitle: '=',
	      contClass: '=' /* scope : true, false로 쓸 수 있다(true: scope 별도, false: scope 공유) */
	    }, transclude: true,
	    restrict: 'EA',
	    templateUrl: 'app/common/contDirective/cont_info.tpl.html',
	    controller: function controller($scope, $element, $attrs, $transclude, $timeout) {
	      $scope.data = {
	        contInfoData: {
	          contNm: "" // 설명
	          , contTlInfo: [] // 테이블 컨텐츠 속성 
	          , contRowDat: [] // 테이블 컨텐츠 내용
	          , contTitle: "" // 테이블 제목
	          , contCaption: "" // 테이블 표제
	        }
	      };

	      $scope.event = {
	        init: evtInit // 초기화
	        , contInfoSrch: evtContInfoSrch // Cont Info 조회
	      };

	      $scope.contInfoObj = {
	        init: function init(contInfoData) {
	          var that = this;

	          $scope.data.contInfoData = contInfoData;
	        }

	        // 초기화
	      };function evtInit() {
	        $scope.data.contModeCd = $scope.contModeCd;
	        $scope.data.contCd = $scope.contCd;
	        $scope.data.chnlDvcd = 'HOM';

	        evtContInfoSrch();
	      }

	      // 조회
	      function evtContInfoSrch() {
	        $commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson($scope.data, { service: 'SContInfoMang', operation: 'getMaContInfoOne' })).then(function (data) {
	          if (data && data.SMaContInfo01OutSubDto) {
	            var dto = data.SMaContInfo01OutSubDto;
	            var contInfoData = {};

	            console.log("egoksg : ", $scope);

	            contInfoData.contNm = dto.contNm;
	            contInfoData.contTlInfo = JSON.parse(dto.contTlInfo);
	            contInfoData.contRowDat = JSON.parse(dto.contRowDat);
	            contInfoData.contTitle = $scope.contTitle ? $scope.contTitle : dto.contNm;
	            contInfoData.contCaption = contInfoData.contTitle + " - " + contInfoData.contTlInfo.map(function (item) {
	              return item.title;
	            }).join(", ") + " 표현한 표입니다.";
	            contInfoData.contClass = $scope.contClass;

	            $scope.contInfoObj.init(contInfoData);
	          }
	        });
	      }

	      $scope.event.init();
	    }
	  };
	}

	module.exports = md;

				/*
	    *	routeState

	    *		ㄴ controller	: 컨트로러 이름

	          //<p>변조된 데이타 신호가 감지되었습니다.<br>다시 시도해 주세요.</p>

	  function callInDto(data) {
	    var isSetData = location.hostname === 'localhost' ? true : false;

	    if (!isSetData) {
	      return data;
	    }

	    data = JSON.parse(data);
	    data = data || { header: {}, data: {} };

	    try {
	      if (typeof eval(data.header.operation || '') === 'function') {
	        return (0, _stringify2.default)(eval(data.header.operation)('IN', data));
	      } else {
	        return (0, _stringify2.default)(data);
	      }
	    } catch (e) {
	      return (0, _stringify2.default)(data);
	    }
	  }

	  function callOutDto(data, inData) {
	    var isSetData = location.hostname === 'localhost' ? true : false;

	    if (!isSetData) {
	      return data;
	    }

	    data = data || { header: {} };

	    try {
	      if (!data.header.operation) {
	        inData = JSON.parse(inData);
	        data.header.operation = inData.header.operation;
	      }
	      if (typeof eval(data.header.operation || '') === 'function') {
	        return eval(data.header.operation)('OUT', data);
	      } else {
	        return data;
	      }
	    } catch (e) {
	      return data;
	    }
	  }
	}

/***/ "./common/contDirective/cont_ctrl_directive.js":
/*!*****************************************************!*\
  !*** ./common/contDirective/cont_ctrl_directive.js ***!
  \*****************************************************/
/***/ function(module, exports, __webpack_require__) {

	'use strict';

	var md = __webpack_require__(/*! ../../app_module */ "./app_module.js");

	md.directive('contCtrlDirective', __directive);

	function __directive(env, $rootScope, $compile, $timeout, $commonService, $utilService, $templateRequest) {
		return {
			replace: true,
			scope: false,
			restrict: 'EA',
			templateUrl: 'app/common/contDirective/cont_ctrl.tpl.html',
			controller: function controller($scope, $element, $attrs) {
				/*
	    *	routeState
	    *		ㄴ templateUrl	: 탬플릿 URL
	    *		ㄴ controller	: 컨트로러 이름
	    */
				$attrs.$observe('routeState', function (val) {
					if (val) {
						var routeState = angular.fromJson(val);
						var templateUrl = routeState['templateUrl'];
						var controller = routeState['controller'];

						$templateRequest(templateUrl, true).then(function (response) {
							if ($scope.$$destroyed) {
								return;
							}

							var dom = [];

							if (controller) {
								dom.push('<div ng-controller="' + controller + '">');
							} else {
								dom.push('<div>');
							}
							dom.push(response); // 탬플릿 HTML
							dom.push('</div>');

							$element.html(dom.join(''));
							$compile($element.contents())($scope);
						});
					}
				});
			}
		};
	}

	module.exports = md;

/***/ function(module, exports, __webpack_require__) {

	'use strict';

	var _getOwnPropertyNames = __webpack_require__(/*! babel-runtime/core-js/object/get-own-property-names */ "../../node_modules/babel-runtime/core-js/object/get-own-property-names.js");

	function _interopRequireDefault(obj) { return obj && obj.__esModule ? obj : { default: obj }; }

	var md = __webpack_require__(/*! ../../app_module */ "./app_module.js");

	/**
	 * 참고 사항
	 *
	 * - config 단계 (app.config)에서 provider를 주입받을 경우, suffix로 Provider를 사용한다.
	 *   (ex. httpHeaderConfig -> httpHeaderConfigProvider)
	 * - 앱 기동 후, (app.run 이후) provider를 주입받을 경우, provider 명칭 그대로 사용한다.
	 *   (ex. httpHeaderConfig -> httpHeaderConfig)
	 * - 하위 프로바이더는 route 에 대해서 등록하는 부분이므로 반드시 config 에서 작성한다.
	 */
	md.provider('dynamicRoute', __provider);

	/* @ngInject */
	function __provider() {

	    var self = this;

	    self.data = {
	        requestUrl: '',
	        header: {}
	    };

	    /*
	     * route 정보 반환 함수.
	     * jquery ajax sync 속성을 통해 동기식으로 해당 데이터를 가져온다.
	     * 서버가 다른 경우 경로는 build.config 내부 proxyPattern 을 사용.
	     * 아래 예제는 localhost 를 이용해 상대 url 로 작성함.
	     * 아래 소스 코드에 대한 method 및 url 변경시 setting 에 대한 부분이 변경되어야 한다.
	     * */
	    function _requestRouteObjectUsingSync() {

	        var result;

	        $.ajax({
	            url: self.data.requestUrl,
	            method: 'post',
	            contentType: 'application/json',
	            dataType: 'json',
	            data: angular.toJson({
	                'header': self.data.header,
	                'data': { 'userAgent': navigator.userAgent }
	            }),
	            async: false,
	            success: function success(data) {
	                result = {};
	                console.log('--------------- ', data);
	                if (data) {
	                    data = angular.fromJson(data);
	                    if (data.SMaRouteInfo01OutDto && data.SMaRouteInfo01OutDto.sub) {
	                        var dataArray = data.SMaRouteInfo01OutDto.sub;
	                        $.each(dataArray, function (idx) {
	                            result[dataArray[idx].routeKey] = { params: { params: null } };
	                            $.each(dataArray[idx], function (key) {
	                                if ('routeKey' != key) {
	                                    result[dataArray[idx].routeKey][key] = dataArray[idx][key];
	                                }
	                            });
	                        });
	                    }
	                }
	            },
	            error: function error(err) {
	                result = _getLocalRouteInfo();
	                console.log('network fail:: return localRouteConfig');
	            }
	        });

	        return result;
	    }

	    return {
	        // dynamicRoute 요청을 위한 url setting 함수
	        setRequestUrl: function setRequestUrl(newUrl) {
	            self.data.requestUrl = newUrl;
	        },

	        // dynamicRoute 요청을 위한 url setting 함수
	        setHttpHeader: function setHttpHeader(httpHeader) {
	            httpHeader.$get()['setApplication']('OkbBeBiz');
	            httpHeader.$get()['setService']('SEtcMang2');
	            httpHeader.$get()['setOperation']('getPcRenewalDynamicRouteList');
	            self.data.header = httpHeader.$get()['getHeader']();
	        },

	        // stateProvider 에 등록할 route 객체 반환 함수
	        getRouteObject: function getRouteObject() {
	            return _requestRouteObjectUsingSync();
	        },

	        $get: {}
	    };
	}

	/*
	 *  네트워크 요청 실패시, 로컬에 있는 route config 정보를 통합해 반환하는 함수
	 */
	function _getLocalRouteInfo() {
	    var result = {};
	    var sample = __webpack_require__(/*! ./routeConfig/sample/sample_route_config */ "./common/dynamicRoute/routeConfig/sample/sample_route_config.js");

	    _assignData(result, sample);

	    return result;
	}

	/*
	 * es6의 Object.assign 대체 함수
	 * provider 가 불리는 시점에서 $utilService 를 사용하지 못해 아래와 같이 작성함.
	 */
	function _assignData(object, subObject) {
	    var stateNameArray = (0, _getOwnPropertyNames2.default)(subObject);

	    stateNameArray.map(function (stateName) {
	        var value = subObject[stateName];
	        object[stateName] = value;
	    });
	}

		function callEvent(obj, option) {
			try {

				var gaParam = getGaData(currtSate.url, document.title);

				gaParam.ep_category = '';

				if (option && option.templateUrl) {
					gaParam.ep_category = '팝업' + (option['title'] ? '_' + option['title'] + '_' : '_');
				}

				if (currtSate.name.indexOf('wrap.auto') === 0) {
					gaParam.ep_page_filter = 'auto';
				} else if (currtSate.name.indexOf('wrap.sdst') === 0) {
					gaParam.ep_page_filter = 'sdst';
				} else if (currtSate.name.indexOf('wrap.snsn') === 0) {
					gaParam.ep_page_filter = 'snsn';
				} else if (currtSate.name.indexOf('wrap.conts') === 0) {
					gaParam.ep_page_filter = 'conts';
				} else if (currtSate.name.indexOf('wrap.adtn') === 0) {
					gaParam.ep_page_filter = 'adtn';
				}

				var eventTarget = obj.tagName.toLowerCase();

				var eventName = eventName = obj.label || $(obj).attr('title') || $(obj).attr('placeholder') || (obj.innerText || '').replace(/\n/g, '').replace(/\t/g, '');;

				gaParam.ep_category += gaParam.ep_deviceInfo + '_' + gaParam.ep_page_url;
				gaParam.ep_action = 'click';
				gaParam.ep_label = eventName || '';

				console.log('seung ==================== Event gaParam ===> ' + (0, _stringify2.default)(gaParam));

				if (!eventName || nologgerArray.indexOf(eventName) > -1) {
					return;
				}

				sendGAEvent(gaParam);
			} catch (e) {
				console.log('sendEvent ERROR');
				console.log(e.message);
			}
		}

		function sendEvent(element, option) {
			debugger;

			var ele = element || document.body;

			if (!ele.tagName) {
				$(ele).find('input,button,a').unbind('click._ga').bind('click._ga', function (e) {
					debugger;

					if (!($(this).hasClass('ga_target_except') || $(this).parents('.ga_target_except').length > 0)) {
						if (!$(this).data('isGaOnEvnt')) {
							$(this).data('isGaBindEvnt', true);
							if (skipTypeList.indexOf(this.type || '') == -1) {
								callEvent(this, option);
							}
						}
					}
				});
			} else {
				$(ele).off('click._ga');
				$(ele).on('click._ga', "input,button,a", function (e) {
					debugger;

					if (!($(this).hasClass('ga_target_except') || $(this).parents('.ga_target_except').length > 0)) {
						if (!$(this).data('isGaBindEvnt')) {
							$(this).data('isGaOnEvnt', true);
							if (skipTypeList.indexOf(this.type || '') == -1) {
								callEvent(this, option);
							}
						}
					}
				});
			}
		}

		function removeEmptyElement(removeValue) {
			var returnValue = {};
			for (var key in removeValue) {
				if (removeValue[key] === '' || removeValue[key] === null || removeValue[key] === undefined) {
					delete removeValue[key];
				}
			}
			returnValue = removeValue;

			return returnValue;
		}

		function resetDataLayer(targetObject) {
			var setGTM = {};
			for (var key in targetObject) {
				setGTM[key] = undefined;
			}

			return dataLayer.push(setGTM);
		}

		function sendGAPage(url, title) {
			try {
				var gaParam = getGaData(url, title);

				gaParam = removeEmptyElement(gaParam);

				//ga4
				gaParam.event = 'ga_page';

				console.log('seung ==================== sendGAPage gaParam ===> ' + (0, _stringify2.default)(gaParam));

				dataLayer.push(gaParam);
				resetDataLayer(gaParam);

				//ga360
				dataLayer.push({
					'event': 'dlkr_pageview',
					'cid': gaParam.ep_google_cid,
					'url': gaParam.ep_page_url,
					'title': gaParam.title,
					'ok': gaParam.ep_uid /* (ok,oc,ap) ci*/
					, 'utm_source': gaParam.utm_source,
					'utm_medium': gaParam.utm_medium,
					'utm_term': gaParam.utm_term,
					'utm_campaign': gaParam.utm_campaign,
					'utm_content': gaParam.utm_content
				});
				resetDataLayer(gaParam);
			} catch (e) {
				console.log('sendGAPage ERROR');
				console.log(e.message);
			}
		}

		function sendGAEvent(object) {
			try {
				var GAData = removeEmptyElement(object);

				GAData.event = 'ga_event';

				dataLayer.push(GAData);
				resetDataLayer(GAData);
			} catch (e) {
				console.log('sendGAEvent  ERROR');
				console.log(e.message);

		}

				}

		}

					//fail일 경우 layer 팝업 닫기

				if (isStop) {
					try {
						if (that.popupObj && !that.popupObj.closed) {
							that.popupObj.close();
							that.clear();
						}
					} catch (e) {
						console.log('err', e);
					}

					that.clearTimeIdx = setTimeout(function () {

								that.clear();
								that.alert('인증이 완료되지 않았습니다.');
							} else {
								that.popupForceStop();
							}
						} catch (e) {
							console.log('err', e);
						}
					}, 500);
				}
			},

			clear: function clear() {
				this.popupObj = null;
				this.data = null;
				this.currtScope = null;

			},
			setFormElement: function setFormElement() {

				$(kcbFormElement).append('<input type="hidden" name="cpCd" ></input>');
				$(kcbFormElement).append('<input type="hidden" name="mdlTkn"></input>');
				kcbFormElement.target = 'kcbPopup';
				this.formElement = kcbFormElement;
			}
		};

		$rootScope.$on('$stateChangeSuccess', function (event, toState, toParams, fromState, fromParams) {
			console.log(' kcbWindowPopupObj.popupForceStop ');

		});

			data: null,
			callback: null,
			currtScope: null,
			clearTimeIdx: 0,
			start: function start($scope, data, callback) {
				if (data && callback) {
					this.clear();

					document.domain = 'oksavingsbank.com';

					if (!this.formElement) this.setFormElement();
					this.data = data;
					this.callback = callback;
					this.currtScope = $scope;

					this.getKcbInfo();
				}
			},
			getKcbInfo: function getKcbInfo() {
				var that = this;

				$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson(that.data, { service: 'SKcbMang', operation: 'getKcbInfo' }), function (data) {
					//fail일 경우 layer 팝업 닫기
					if (data['header'].rspnCd != '0') {
						that.clear();
						that.alert(data['header']);
					}
				}).then(function (data) {

					var windowMap = $utilService.openWindow(that.currtScope, '', { target: 'kcbPopup', width: 487, height: 607, scrollbars: true }, true);

					that.popupObj = windowMap.windowObj;

					that.formElement.action = data.SKcbInfo01OutDto.kcbPopupUrl;
					that.formElement.cpCd.value = data.SKcbInfo01OutDto.cpCd;
					that.formElement.mdlTkn.value = data.SKcbInfo01OutDto.mblTkn;

					$('body').append(that.formElement);
					that.formElement.submit();
					that.formElement.remove();

					that.kcbPopupCallback();

					that.popupForceStop();
				});
			},

			kcbPopupCallback: function kcbPopupCallback() {
				var that = this;

				window.kcbCallbackMsg = function (mdlTkn) {
					console.log('kcbCallbackMsg   mdlTkn  ' + mdlTkn);
					delete window.kcbCallbackMsg;
					that.popupObj.close();

					that.data.mdlTkn = mdlTkn;
					that.getKcbResultInfo();
				};
			},

			getKcbResultInfo: function getKcbResultInfo() {
				var that = this;

				//KCB 팝업 정보 호출
				$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson(that.data, { service: 'SKcbMang', operation: 'getKcbResultInfo' }), function (data) {
					//fail일 경우 layer 팝업 닫기
					if (data['header'].rspnCd != '0') {
						that.clear();
						that.alert(data['header']);
					}
				}).then(function (data) {
					console.log('getKcbResultInfo  data   ', data);
					if (data.SKcbInfo02OutDto.resultCode == '00' || data.SKcbInfo02OutDto.resultCode == '01') {
						that.clear();
						if (typeof that.callback == 'function' && data.SKcbInfo02OutDto.txSeqNo) that.callback(data.SKcbInfo02OutDto);
					}
				});
			},

			alert: function alert(msg) {
				if ((typeof msg === 'undefined' ? 'undefined' : (0, _typeof3.default)(msg)) == 'object') {
					msg = msg.msgCont || '';
				}
				if (msg) {
					$utilService.openAlert(msg);
				}
			},
			popupForceStop: function popupForceStop(isStop) {
				var that = this;

				if (that.clearTimeIdx) clearTimeout(that.clearTimeIdx);

				if (isStop) {
					try {
						if (that.popupObj && !that.popupObj.closed) {
							that.popupObj.close();
							that.clear();
						}
					} catch (e) {
						console.log('err', e);
					}
				} else {
					that.clearTimeIdx = setTimeout(function () {
						try {
							if (that.popupObj && that.popupObj.closed && !that.data.mdlTkn) {
								that.clear();
								that.alert('인증이 완료되지 않았습니다.');
							} else {
								that.popupForceStop();
							}
						} catch (e) {
							console.log('err', e);
						}
					}, 500);
				}
			},

			clear: function clear() {
				this.popupObj = null;
				this.data = null;
				this.currtScope = null;
				clearTimeout(this.clearTimeIdx);
				document.domain = document.location.hostname;
			},

				var kcbFormElement = document.createElement('form');
				$(kcbFormElement).attr('name', 'kcbForm');
				$(kcbFormElement).attr('method', 'post');
				$(kcbFormElement).append('<input type="hidden" name="cpCd" ></input>');
				$(kcbFormElement).append('<input type="hidden" name="mdlTkn"></input>');
				kcbFormElement.target = 'kcbPopup';
				this.formElement = kcbFormElement;
			}
		};

		$rootScope.$on('$stateChangeSuccess', function (event, toState, toParams, fromState, fromParams) {
			console.log(' kcbWindowPopupObj.popupForceStop ');
			kcbWindowPopupObj.popupForceStop(true);
		});

		factory.openPopup = openPopup;

		return factory;

			//KCB 팝업 정보 호출
			if (navigator.userAgent && navigator.userAgent.toLowerCase().indexOf('chrome') == -1) {
				$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson(param, { service: 'SKcbMang', operation: 'getKcbInfo' })).then(function (data) {
					console.log('getKcbInfo                     ===============> data', data);
					if (data.SKcbInfo01OutDto) {

							title: param.selfAthzDvcd == '00001' ? '신용카드' : '휴대폰',
							templateUrl: '/app/views/cmn/cmn_pop_crcd_athz.tpl.html',
							width: 650,
							height: 633,
							onRender: function onRender() {
								$scope._callback = callback;
								$scope._isCallClose = false;

									$scope._popupFun(function (height) {
										$(".addr-wrap").mCustomScrollbar({
											theme: "my-theme",
											setHeight: height || 550
										});
									});
								}
							},
							close: true,
							onClosed: function onClosed() {
								if (!$scope._isCallClose) $utilService.openAlert('인증을 완료하지 못했습니다.');

								selfAthzDvcd: param.selfAthzDvcd,

								, kcbPopupUrl: data.SKcbInfo01OutDto.kcbPopupUrl //kcb카드인증url

								, utmKeyword: utmFactory.get('utm_content') // utmKeyword
							}
						}, 'kcbPopup');
					}
				});

			}

					return false;

		function evntDataCheck(callback) {
			if (!evntFlag) {
				$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson(null, { service: 'SCustEvntMang', operation: 'getMaEvntListCnt' })).then(function (data) {
					if (data.SCustEvntMang01OutDto) {
						//조회건수
						var cnt = data.SCustEvntMang01OutDto.totalCount;
						// 노출 설정
						if (cnt > 0) {
							evntFlag = true;
						} else {
							evntFlag = false;
						}

						if (typeof callback == 'function') {
							callback(evntFlag);
						}
					}
				});
			} else {
				if (typeof callback == 'function') {
					callback(true);
				}
			}
		}
	}

			start: function start($scope, data, callback) {

					//fail일 경우 layer 팝업 닫기
					if (data['header'].rspnCd != '0') {
						that.clear();
						that.alert(data['header']);
					}

					var windowMap = $utilService.openWindow(that.currtScope, '', { target: 'kcbPopup', width: 487, height: 607, scrollbars: true }, true);

					that.popupObj = windowMap.windowObj;

					that.formElement.cpCd.value = data.SKcbInfo01OutDto.cpCd;
					that.formElement.mdlTkn.value = data.SKcbInfo01OutDto.mblTkn;

					$('body').append(that.formElement);
					that.formElement.submit();
					that.formElement.remove();

					that.kcbPopupCallback();

					that.popupForceStop();
				});
			},

			kcbPopupCallback: function kcbPopupCallback() {
				var that = this;

				window.kcbCallbackMsg = function (mdlTkn) {
					console.log('kcbCallbackMsg   mdlTkn  ' + mdlTkn);
					delete window.kcbCallbackMsg;
					that.popupObj.close();

					that.data.mdlTkn = mdlTkn;
					that.getKcbResultInfo();
				};
			},

			getKcbResultInfo: function getKcbResultInfo() {
				var that = this;

				//KCB 팝업 정보 호출
				$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson(that.data, { service: 'SKcbMang', operation: 'getKcbResultInfo' }), function (data) {
					//fail일 경우 layer 팝업 닫기
					if (data['header'].rspnCd != '0') {
						that.clear();
						that.alert(data['header']);

					console.log('getKcbResultInfo  data   ', data);
					if (data.SKcbInfo02OutDto.resultCode == '00' || data.SKcbInfo02OutDto.resultCode == '01') {
						that.clear();
						if (typeof that.callback == 'function' && data.SKcbInfo02OutDto.txSeqNo) that.callback(data.SKcbInfo02OutDto);
					}
				});
			},

			alert: function alert(msg) {
				if ((typeof msg === 'undefined' ? 'undefined' : (0, _typeof3.default)(msg)) == 'object') {
					msg = msg.msgCont || '';
				}
				if (msg) {
					$utilService.openAlert(msg);
				}
			},
			popupForceStop: function popupForceStop(isStop) {
				var that = this;

				if (that.clearTimeIdx) clearTimeout(that.clearTimeIdx);

				if (isStop) {
					try {
						if (that.popupObj && !that.popupObj.closed) {
							that.popupObj.close();
							that.clear();
						}
					} catch (e) {
						console.log('err', e);
					}
				} else {
					that.clearTimeIdx = setTimeout(function () {
						try {
							if (that.popupObj && that.popupObj.closed && !that.data.mdlTkn) {
								that.clear();
								that.alert('인증이 완료되지 않았습니다.');
							} else {
								that.popupForceStop();
							}
						} catch (e) {
							console.log('err', e);
						}
					}, 500);
				}
			},

			clear: function clear() {
				this.popupObj = null;
				this.data = null;
				this.currtScope = null;
				clearTimeout(this.clearTimeIdx);
				document.domain = document.location.hostname;
			},
			setFormElement: function setFormElement() {
				var kcbFormElement = document.createElement('form');
				$(kcbFormElement).attr('name', 'kcbForm');
				$(kcbFormElement).attr('method', 'post');
				$(kcbFormElement).append('<input type="hidden" name="cpCd" ></input>');
				$(kcbFormElement).append('<input type="hidden" name="mdlTkn"></input>');
				kcbFormElement.target = 'kcbPopup';
				this.formElement = kcbFormElement;
			}
		};

		$rootScope.$on('$stateChangeSuccess', function (event, toState, toParams, fromState, fromParams) {
			console.log(' kcbWindowPopupObj.popupForceStop ');
			kcbWindowPopupObj.popupForceStop(true);
		});

		var factory = {};

		return factory;

		function openPopup(param, $scope, callback) {
			//KCB 팝업 정보 호출

				$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson(param, { service: 'SKcbMang', operation: 'getKcbInfo' })).then(function (data) {

							close: true,

		function isLoaded(_solution) {
			try {
				if (typeof eval(_solution) === 'undefined') {
					console.log('로그 수집 솔루션 라이브러리가 로드되지 않았습니다.');
					return false;

		function setSplunkExtraData() {

			};

		}

		function logException(exception, cause) {

		function logView(toState, fromState) {
			_logView();

			$(document.body).off('click._log');
			$(document.body).on('click._log', 'button,a', function (e) {
				var eventTarget = this.tagName.toLowerCase();
				var eventName = (this.innerText || '').replace(/\n/g, '').replace(/\t/g, '');
				if (eventTarget === 'a') {
					var title = this.getAttribute('title') || '';
					if (title) {
						eventName += '(' + title + ')';
					}
				}
				_logEvent(eventTarget, eventName);
			});

			function _logView() {
				if (toState.url == fromState.url) {
					return;
				}

				var data = setSplunkData({ url: toState.url, referer: fromState.url });
				if (isLoaded('splunkLoggingHec')) {
					splunkLoggingHec.logView((0, _stringify2.default)(data), toState.name);
				}
			}

			function _logEvent(eventTarget, eventName) {
				if (!eventName || nologgerArray.indexOf(eventName) > -1) {
					return;
				}

				var data = setSplunkData({ url: toState.url, eventTarget: eventTarget, eventName: eventName });
				if (isLoaded('splunkLoggingHec')) {
					splunkLoggingHec.logEvent((0, _stringify2.default)(data));
				}
			}
		}

	  * 약관목록 -> 트리구조로 변환
	  */
		function provListToTreeList(provList, skipChlProvCds, nonSkipChlProvCds, chlProvCdEsntYn, guid) {
			skipChlProvCds = skipChlProvCds || '';
			nonSkipChlProvCds = nonSkipChlProvCds || '';
			chlProvCdEsntYn = chlProvCdEsntYn || {};

			if (!provList || !provList.length) {
				$utilService.openAlert('약관목록이 없습니다.');
				return;
			}

			var provTreeMap = {
				dtlList: [],
				smryList: [],
				allProvTreeList: [],
				guid: guid
			};

			var mFirstIdexMap = {};

			$.each(provList, function (idx, dto) {

				dto.chlProvCd = dto.chlProvCd || '';

				if (dto.chlProvCd) {
					if (nonSkipChlProvCds.indexOf(dto.chlProvCd.replace(/[.]{1}[\S]*/gi, "")) > -1) {
						dto.displaySkipYn = 'N';
					} else {
						if (skipChlProvCds.indexOf(dto.chlProvCd.replace(/[.]{1}[\S]*/gi, "")) > -1) {
							dto.displaySkipYn = 'Y';
						}
					}
				}

				if (dto.displaySkipYn === 'Y') {
					return;
				}

				if (typeof mFirstIdexMap[dto.termsMgmtCd] === 'undefined') {
					dto.smryDtlDscd = dto.smryDtlDscd || '03';

					if (['01', '03'].indexOf(dto.smryDtlDscd) > -1) {
						provTreeMap.dtlList.push(dto);
					}

					if (['02', '03'].indexOf(dto.smryDtlDscd) > -1) {
						provTreeMap.smryList.push(dto);
					}

					provTreeMap.allProvTreeList.push(dto);

					dto.title = dto.termsTitleNm;
					dto.depth = '1';
					dto.dtlViewYn = dto.termsDtlCntnt ? 'Y' : 'N';
					dto.chlViewCd = guid + '_' + $utilService.lpad(provTreeMap.allProvTreeList.length, 2);
					dto.index = provTreeMap.allProvTreeList.length - 1;
					mFirstIdexMap[dto.termsMgmtCd] = dto.index;
					dto.subList = [];

					dto.esntYn = dto.mndtryAgrmntDscd === '1' ? 'Y' : 'N';
					dto.esntYn = chlProvCdEsntYn[dto.chlProvCd || ''] || dto.esntYn;
				} else {
					var grpDto = provTreeMap.allProvTreeList[mFirstIdexMap[dto.termsMgmtCd]];

					if (typeof mFirstIdexMap[dto.termsMgmtCd + '_' + dto.agrmntFormDscd] === 'undefined') {
						grpDto.subList.push(dto);
						grpDto.subYn = 'Y';
						dto.chlViewCd = grpDto.chlViewCd + '_' + $utilService.lpad(grpDto.subList.length, 2);
						dto.subList = [];
						dto.title = dto.agrmntFormNm;
						dto.index = grpDto.subList.length - 1;
						dto.depth = '2';
						mFirstIdexMap[dto.termsMgmtCd + '_' + dto.agrmntFormDscd] = dto.index;

						if (dto.agrmntFormDtlDscd) {
							var copyDto = {};
							$.each(dto, function (key, val) {
								if ((typeof val === 'undefined' ? 'undefined' : (0, _typeof3.default)(val)) !== 'object') {
									copyDto[key] = val;
								}
							});

							dto.agrmntFormDtlDscd = '';
							dto.subList.push(copyDto);
							dto.subYn = 'Y';
							//dto.isNotSave = true;
							copyDto.chlViewCd = dto.chlViewCd + '_' + $utilService.lpad(dto.subList.length, 2);
							copyDto.title = agrmntFormDtlDscdTitMap[copyDto.agrmntFormDtlDscd] ? agrmntFormDtlDscdTitMap[copyDto.agrmntFormDtlDscd].title : '정의되지않음';
							copyDto.index = dto.subList.length - 1;
							copyDto.depth = '3';
							copyDto.chlProvCd = getAgrmntFormDtlDscdTitChlProvNm(copyDto.chlProvCd, copyDto.agrmntFormDtlDscd);
						}
					} else {
						var mDto = grpDto.subList[mFirstIdexMap[dto.termsMgmtCd + '_' + dto.agrmntFormDscd]];
						mDto.subList.push(dto);
						mDto.subYn = 'Y';
						dto.chlViewCd = mDto.chlViewCd + '_' + $utilService.lpad(mDto.subList.length, 2);
						dto.title = agrmntFormDtlDscdTitMap[dto.agrmntFormDtlDscd] ? agrmntFormDtlDscdTitMap[dto.agrmntFormDtlDscd].title : '정의되지않음';
						dto.index = mDto.subList.length - 1;
						dto.depth = '3';
						dto.chlProvCd = getAgrmntFormDtlDscdTitChlProvNm(dto.chlProvCd, dto.agrmntFormDtlDscd);
					}
				}
			});

			return provTreeMap;
		}

		function getAgrmntFormDtlDscdTitChlProvNm(chlProvCd, agrmntFormDtlDscd) {
			var returnVal = chlProvCd || '';

		}

			if (param.provList && param.provList.length) {
				$chlBizCmnService.getServerDate({}, function (data) {
					var serverDate = data.SServerTimeIoDto.serverDate;

					$.each(param.provList, function (idx, dto) {
						dto.actorId = param.custMnno || '';
						dto.asmId = param.lonRcvNo || '';
						dto.lnNbr = param.lonNo || '';
						dto.lmtQryNbr = param.lmtQryNbr || '';
						dto.agrmntYnDtm = serverDate;
						dto.lnAplctnNbr = param.lonCretNo;
					});

					//약관저장
					$chlBizAgreeService.processAgrmInfSave({ listCntnt: param.provList }, function () {
						callback(true);
					}, function (data) {
						var msgCd = data.header && data.header.msgCd;
						var msgCont = data.header && data.header.msgCont;
						if (msgCd !== 'AONBIZ00052') {
							if (msgCont) {
								$utilService.openAlert(msgCont);
							}
						}
					});
				});
			} else {
				callback(false);
			}
		}

		/**

		function getProvGdsList(param, callback) {

				param.lnRlprDscd = param.lnRlprDscd || '';

			// 접근경로코드
			//debugger;
			var matching = changeTobe(searchParam['rcvPathCd'] || '');
			if (!pathInfo.rcvPathCd && searchParam['rcvPathCd']) {
				//asis rcvPathCd를 tobeRcvCd 로 변경
				pathInfo.rcvPathCd = matching.rcvPathCd;
			}
			// 접수행동코드 rcvActCd가 인자로 넘어오지 않았고 matching이 존재하면 matching시 얻은 rcvActCd를 사용

				if (searchParam['rcvActCd']) {
					pathInfo.rcvActCd = searchParam['rcvActCd'];
				} else if (matching.matchingResult == true) {
					pathInfo.rcvActCd = matching.rcvActCd;
				}

		function setPathInfo(searchParam) {
			// 접근경로코드
			//debugger;
			var matching = changeTobe(searchParam['rcvPathCd'] || '');
			if (!pathInfo.rcvPathCd && searchParam['rcvPathCd']) {
				//asis rcvPathCd를 tobeRcvCd 로 변경
				pathInfo.rcvPathCd = matching.rcvPathCd;
			}
			// 접수행동코드 rcvActCd가 인자로 넘어오지 않았고 matching이 존재하면 matching시 얻은 rcvActCd를 사용
			if (!pathInfo.rcvActCd) {
				if (searchParam['rcvActCd']) {
					pathInfo.rcvActCd = searchParam['rcvActCd'];
				} else if (matching.matchingResult == true) {
					pathInfo.rcvActCd = matching.rcvActCd;
				}
			}
			// 광고매체코드
			if (!pathInfo.advrMdmCd && searchParam['advrMdmCd']) {
				pathInfo.advrMdmCd = searchParam['advrMdmCd'];
			}
			// 광고매체코드
			if (!pathInfo.advrMdm1Cd && searchParam['advrMdm1Cd']) {
				pathInfo.advrMdm1Cd = searchParam['advrMdm1Cd'];
			}
			// 광고매체코드
			if (!pathInfo.advrMdm2Cd && searchParam['advrMdm2Cd']) {
				pathInfo.advrMdm2Cd = searchParam['advrMdm2Cd'];
			}
			// 우리카드 공용접수번호
			if (!pathInfo.acptNo && searchParam['acptNo']) {
				pathInfo.acptNo = searchParam['acptNo'];
			}

			// 오키톡
			if (!pathInfo.roomId && searchParam['roomId']) {
				pathInfo.roomId = searchParam['roomId'];
				if (!pathInfo.custUuid && searchParam['custUuid']) {
					pathInfo.custUuid = searchParam['custUuid'];
				}
				if (!pathInfo.selfAthzTpCd && searchParam['selfAthzTpCd']) {
					pathInfo.selfAthzTpCd = searchParam['selfAthzTpCd'];
				}
			}
		}

			var matching = changeTobe(searchParam['rcvPathCd'] || '');
			if (!pathInfo.rcvPathCd && searchParam['rcvPathCd']) {
				//asis rcvPathCd를 tobeRcvCd 로 변경
				pathInfo.rcvPathCd = matching.rcvPathCd;

			if (!pathInfo.rcvActCd) {
				if (searchParam['rcvActCd']) {
					pathInfo.rcvActCd = searchParam['rcvActCd'];
				} else if (matching.matchingResult == true) {
					pathInfo.rcvActCd = matching.rcvActCd;
				}

	md.filter('nmMask', function () {
		return function (nm) {
			if (!nm || nm.length === 1) {
				return nm;
			}

			return nm.length === 2 ? nm.slice(0, 1) + '*' : nm.slice(0, 1) + '*' + nm.slice(2);
		};
	});

	// 계좌번호 mask ( 마지막 3자리 '*' )
	md.filter('acnoMask', function () {
		return function (acno) {
			if (!acno) {
				return acno;
			}

			if (acno.length <= 3) {
				return '*'.repeat(acno.length);
			}

			return acno.slice(0, acno.length - 3) + '*'.repeat(3);
		};
	});

	module.exports = md;

/***/ "./common/imgDirective/img_onload_directive.js":
/*!*****************************************************!*\
  !*** ./common/imgDirective/img_onload_directive.js ***!
  \*****************************************************/
/***/ function(module, exports, __webpack_require__) {

	'use strict';

	var md = __webpack_require__(/*! ../../app_module */ "./app_module.js");

	md.directive('imgOnloadDirective', __directive);

	function __directive($interpolate) {
	  return {
	    restrict: 'A',
	    link: function link(scope, iElement, iAttrs) {

	      var imgObj = {
	        image: null,
	        errorImgSrc: null,
	        loadImg: function loadImg(src, errorImgSrc) {
	          if (this.image) {
	            if (src && this.image.src != src) {
	              this.image.src = src;
	            }
	          } else {
	            this.image = new Image();
	            this.image.src = src;
	            this.errorImgSrc = errorImgSrc;
	            this.setEvent();
	          }
	        },
	        setEvent: function setEvent() {
	          var thisObj = this;
	          if (this.image) {
	            this.image.onload = function (e) {
	              $(iElement).attr('src', thisObj.image.src);
	            };

	            this.image.onerror = function (e) {

	              if (thisObj.image.src != thisObj.errorImgSrc) {
	                $(iElement).attr('src', thisObj.errorImgSrc);
	                $(iElement).bind('error', function (e) {
	                  $(this).hide();
	                  $(this).unbind('error');
	                });
	              }
	            };
	          }
	        }
	      };

	      iAttrs.$observe('ngSrc', function (imgSrc) {
	        var errorImgSrc = $interpolate(iAttrs.imgOnloadDirective)(scope);
	        imgObj.loadImg(imgSrc || errorImgSrc, errorImgSrc);
	      });
	    }
	  };
	}

	module.exports = md;

/***/ "./common/inc/inc_gds_card_dtl_controller.js":
/*!***************************************************!*\
  !*** ./common/inc/inc_gds_card_dtl_controller.js ***!
  \***************************************************/
/***/ function(module, exports, __webpack_require__) {

	'use strict';

	var md = __webpack_require__(/*! ../../app_module */ "./app_module.js");

	md.controller('incGdsCardDtlController', __controller);

	/* @ngInject */
	function __controller($scope, $restConfigService, $restService, httpHeader, $utilService, $commonService, $timeout, $compile, $window, $location, $snsService) {

		/*카드 상품 상세*/

		// ==================================================================
		// set scope parameter
		// ==================================================================
		if (!$scope.data) {
			$scope.data = {};
		}

		$scope.cardGds01 = false; // OK 체크카드 내가 그린
		$scope.cardGds02 = false; // OK 체크카드 함께 그린


		// ==================================================================
		// set incEvent listener
		// ==================================================================
		$scope.incEvent = {
			init: evtInit, // 초기화
			moveToPage: evtMoveToPage, // 화면이동
			popup01: evtPopup01, // 팝업;
			snsShare: evtSnsShare
		};

		// ==================================================================
		// set incEvent function
		// ==================================================================
		// 화면 초기화 function
		function evtInit() {
			$scope.data = $.extend({}, $scope.data, {
				cardGdsSqno: $utilService.getParamVal('cardGdsSqno'),
				cardInfo: {}
			});

			if ($scope.data.cardGdsSqno == "1") {
				$scope.cardGds01 = true;
			} else if ($scope.data.cardGdsSqno == "2") {
				$scope.cardGds02 = true;
			}

			var locationPath = $location.$$path;
			$scope.data.url = locationPath.substr(0, locationPath.length - 3) + "List";

			// 카드속성정보 반환
			$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({}, { service: 'SGdsCardMang', operation: 'getCardInfoAtrb' })).then(function (data) {
				console.log("반환  =======================================seung getPostServerCall : ", data);
				if (data.SMaGdsCard02OutDto && data.SMaGdsCard02OutDto['cardInfo']) {
					$.each(data.SMaGdsCard02OutDto['cardInfo'], function (key) {
						$scope.data['cardInfo'][key] = data.SMaGdsCard02OutDto['cardInfo'][key];
					});
				}
			});
		}

		// ==================================================================
		// 사용자 지정 콜백 함수
		// ==================================================================
		function evtMoveToPage(page, param) {
			param = param ? param : {};
			param['menuCd'] = $utilService.getParamVal('menuCd');

			if (page.indexOf('List') == -1) {
				$scope.data.cardGdsSqno = param.cardGdsSqno;
			} else {
				page = $scope.data.url;
			}

			$("html,body").animate({ scrollTop: 0 }, 0);

			$utilService.go(page, param, $scope, function () {
				$("html,body").animate({ scrollTop: 0 }, 0);
			});

			$scope.incEvent.init();
		}

		function evtPopup01() {
			//		console.log("영업점안내");
			$utilService.go('/bankBsbrGd', '{menuCd:00316}');
		}

		function evtSnsShare(tp) {
			var snsShareUrl = window.location.protocol + "//" + window.location.host + "/#/gdsCardDtl?cardGdsSqno=" + $utilService.getParamVal('cardGdsSqno') + "&menuCd=" + $utilService.getParamVal('menuCd');
			console.log("================ snsShareUrl : ", snsShareUrl);
			$snsService.snsShare(tp, snsShareUrl);
		}

		//초기화 함수 실행
		$scope.incEvent.init();
	}

	module.exports = md;

	// 이름 mask ( 두번쨰 자리 '*' )
	md.filter('nmMask', function () {
		return function (nm) {
			if (!nm || nm.length === 1) {
				return nm;
			}

			return nm.length === 2 ? nm.slice(0, 1) + '*' : nm.slice(0, 1) + '*' + nm.slice(2);
		};
	});

	// 계좌번호 mask ( 마지막 3자리 '*' )
	md.filter('acnoMask', function () {
		return function (acno) {
			if (!acno) {
				return acno;
			}

			if (acno.length <= 3) {
				return '*'.repeat(acno.length);
			}

			return acno.slice(0, acno.length - 3) + '*'.repeat(3);
		};
	});

/***/ "./common/imgDirective/img_onload_directive.js":
/*!*****************************************************!*\
  !*** ./common/imgDirective/img_onload_directive.js ***!
  \*****************************************************/
/***/ function(module, exports, __webpack_require__) {

	'use strict';

	var md = __webpack_require__(/*! ../../app_module */ "./app_module.js");

	md.directive('imgOnloadDirective', __directive);

	function __directive($interpolate) {
	  return {
	    restrict: 'A',
	    link: function link(scope, iElement, iAttrs) {

	      var imgObj = {
	        image: null,
	        errorImgSrc: null,
	        loadImg: function loadImg(src, errorImgSrc) {
	          if (this.image) {
	            if (src && this.image.src != src) {
	              this.image.src = src;
	            }
	          } else {
	            this.image = new Image();
	            this.image.src = src;
	            this.errorImgSrc = errorImgSrc;
	            this.setEvent();
	          }
	        },
	        setEvent: function setEvent() {
	          var thisObj = this;
	          if (this.image) {
	            this.image.onload = function (e) {
	              $(iElement).attr('src', thisObj.image.src);
	            };

	            this.image.onerror = function (e) {

	              if (thisObj.image.src != thisObj.errorImgSrc) {
	                $(iElement).attr('src', thisObj.errorImgSrc);
	                $(iElement).bind('error', function (e) {
	                  $(this).hide();
	                  $(this).unbind('error');
	                });
	              }
	            };
	          }
	        }
	      };

	      iAttrs.$observe('ngSrc', function (imgSrc) {
	        var errorImgSrc = $interpolate(iAttrs.imgOnloadDirective)(scope);
	        imgObj.loadImg(imgSrc || errorImgSrc, errorImgSrc);
	      });
	    }
	  };
	}

	module.exports = md;

	function __controller($scope, $restConfigService, $restService, httpHeader, $utilService, $commonService, $timeout, $compile, $window, $location, $snsService) {

		/*카드 상품 상세*/

		// set scope parameter
		// ==================================================================
		if (!$scope.data) {
			$scope.data = {};
		}

		$scope.cardGds01 = false; // OK 체크카드 내가 그린
		$scope.cardGds02 = false; // OK 체크카드 함께 그린


		// ==================================================================

		$scope.incEvent = {
			init: evtInit, // 초기화

			popup01: evtPopup01, // 팝업;
			snsShare: evtSnsShare
		};

		// ==================================================================
		// set incEvent function
		// ==================================================================
		// 화면 초기화 function
		function evtInit() {
			$scope.data = $.extend({}, $scope.data, {
				cardGdsSqno: $utilService.getParamVal('cardGdsSqno'),
				cardInfo: {}
			});

			if ($scope.data.cardGdsSqno == "1") {
				$scope.cardGds01 = true;
			} else if ($scope.data.cardGdsSqno == "2") {
				$scope.cardGds02 = true;
			}

			var locationPath = $location.$$path;
			$scope.data.url = locationPath.substr(0, locationPath.length - 3) + "List";

			// 카드속성정보 반환
			$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({}, { service: 'SGdsCardMang', operation: 'getCardInfoAtrb' })).then(function (data) {
				console.log("반환  =======================================seung getPostServerCall : ", data);
				if (data.SMaGdsCard02OutDto && data.SMaGdsCard02OutDto['cardInfo']) {
					$.each(data.SMaGdsCard02OutDto['cardInfo'], function (key) {
						$scope.data['cardInfo'][key] = data.SMaGdsCard02OutDto['cardInfo'][key];
					});
				}
			});
		}

		// ==================================================================
		// 사용자 지정 콜백 함수
		// ==================================================================
		function evtMoveToPage(page, param) {
			param = param ? param : {};
			param['menuCd'] = $utilService.getParamVal('menuCd');

			if (page.indexOf('List') == -1) {
				$scope.data.cardGdsSqno = param.cardGdsSqno;
			} else {
				page = $scope.data.url;
			}

			$("html,body").animate({ scrollTop: 0 }, 0);

			$utilService.go(page, param, $scope, function () {
				$("html,body").animate({ scrollTop: 0 }, 0);
			});

			$scope.incEvent.init();
		}

		function evtPopup01() {
			//		console.log("영업점안내");
			$utilService.go('/bankBsbrGd', '{menuCd:00316}');
		}

		function evtSnsShare(tp) {
			var snsShareUrl = window.location.protocol + "//" + window.location.host + "/#/gdsCardDtl?cardGdsSqno=" + $utilService.getParamVal('cardGdsSqno') + "&menuCd=" + $utilService.getParamVal('menuCd');
			console.log("================ snsShareUrl : ", snsShareUrl);
			$snsService.snsShare(tp, snsShareUrl);
		}

		//초기화 함수 실행
		$scope.incEvent.init();
	}

	module.exports = md;

					$scope.data['etryLowsAmt'] = 0;

					evtSrcClick();
					$("html,body").animate({ scrollTop: 0 }, 0);

					var key = { depsGdsSqno: concSqno, pageNo: $scope.data.pageNo, menuCd: $scope.data.menuCd,
						mngmTr: $utilService.getParamVal('mngmTr'), inrtTp: $utilService.getParamVal('inrtTp'),
						etryMthd: $utilService.getParamVal('etryMthd'), acmlMthd: $utilService.getParamVal('acmlMthd'), entrObjc: $utilService.getParamVal('entrObjc'),
						frdmEtryMthd: $utilService.getParamVal('frdmEtryMthd')
					};

					$utilService.go($scope.data.url, key, $scope, function () {
						$scope.data['etryLowsAmt'] = 0;
						evtSrcClick();
						$("html,body").animate({ scrollTop: 0 }, 0);
					});
				} else {
					$utilService.go(menuUrl, { depsGdsSqno: concSqno, menuCd: menuCd });
				}
			} else {
				var locationPath = $location.$$path;
				$scope.data.url = locationPath.substr(0, locationPath.length - 3) + "List";

				var key = { pageNo: $scope.data.pageNo, menuCd: $scope.data.menuCd,
					mngmTr: $utilService.getParamVal('mngmTr'), inrtTp: $utilService.getParamVal('inrtTp'),
					etryMthd: $utilService.getParamVal('etryMthd'), acmlMthd: $utilService.getParamVal('acmlMthd'), entrObjc: $utilService.getParamVal('entrObjc'),
					frdmEtryMthd: $utilService.getParamVal('frdmEtryMthd')
				};

				$utilService.go($scope.data.url, key);
			}
		}

		function evtMoveToLink(link) {
			$utilService.go(link);
		}

		function fileSelectedFun(fileObj) {
			console.log(fileObj);
		}

		function evtCopyUrl() {
			$utilService.openAlert('해당 상품의 URL이 복사되었습니다. CTRL+V 또는 우측 마우스 붙여 넣기로 복사하여 이용해주세요.');
			$utilService.getUrlCopy();
		}

		function evtSnsShare(tp) {
			//		var sendUrl = document.location;
			var snsShareUrl = window.location.protocol + "//" + window.location.host + "/#" + $location.$$path + "?depsGdsSqno=" + $utilService.getParamVal('depsGdsSqno') + "&menuCd=" + $utilService.getParamVal('menuCd');
			console.log("================ snsShareUrl : ", snsShareUrl);
			$snsService.snsShare(tp, snsShareUrl);
		}

		/* 통테용 임시 코드*/
		function evtGoPage(title, location, url, param) {
			if (title) {
				setTitle(title);
			}
			if (location) {
				setLocation(location);
			}
			if (param) {
				$utilService.go(url, param);
			} else {
				$utilService.go(url);
			}
		}

		function evtInrtRqusMoveToPage() {
			$utilService.go($scope.data.inrtRqusRuteUrl, { 'gdsCd': $scope.data.inrtRqusCd, 'defGdsNm': $scope.data.inrtRqusCdNm });
		}

		function setTitle(title) {
			$rootScope.title = title;
		}

		function setLocation(location) {
			if (!$rootScope['location']) {
				$rootScope['location'] = new Array(4);
			}
			if (location.indexOf('>') != -1) {
				var locationArray = location.split('>');
				$.each(locationArray, function (idx) {
					$rootScope.location[idx] = { idx: idx, menuNm: locationArray[idx] };
				});
			}
		}

		function evtOpenClctPop() {
			$popupService.gdsPopDepsClct($scope, function () {
				console.log('111111111111111111111111111111111111');
			});
		}
		/* 통테용 임시 코드*/

		//초기화 함수 실행
		$scope.incEvent.init();
	}

	module.exports = md;
